message.jaymoskingdoms.needs_axe: Wood needs an axe. Knap flint on stone into shards, cut grass with a primitive knife for fiber, twist it into plant string, and bind a flint hatchet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trunk_built_on: Something's built on this trunk. It stays where it is.
message.jaymoskingdoms.trunk_too_heavy: Too heavy to shift on your own.
message.jaymoskingdoms.avatar.silent: The avatar's eyes burn past you. It has no words for anyone who isn't Emberborn.
message.jaymoskingdoms.omen.seen: The people of %s see the omen on you. Whatever good name you had here is gone: you've brought a raid to their door.
message.jaymoskingdoms.omen.grudge: %s survived the raid you brought. They will almost never forget it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.omen.forgiven: After all this time, %s has finally let go of its grudge against you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.blood: The Blood Moon rises. The dead stir thick and strong tonight, and no one will sleep.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.super_blood: A Super Blood Moon fills the sky. Bar the doors: tonight the dark empties itself onto you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.harvest: The Harvest Moon rises, gold and heavy. Fields and orchards ripen through the night.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.blue: A Blue Moon rises. Fortune favours those out under it tonight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.moon.no_sleep: You can't sleep under the Blood Moon.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reputation.hostil: %s now counts you an enemy. Its guards will attack you on sight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reputation.forgiv: %s no longer counts you an enemy.
message.jaymoskingdoms.audience: The court of %s regards you as %s (%s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.left: You have renounced %s. It won't forget it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.deposited: You give %s emeralds to the treasury of %s (now %s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.withdrew: You draw %s emeralds from the treasury of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.none: No kingdoms or villages yet: find a village.
message.jaymoskingdoms.already_sworn: You are already sworn to a kingdom. Leave it first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.not_sworn: You aren't sworn to any kingdom.
message.jaymoskingdoms.not_welcome: %s won't take your pledge: earn its trust first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lords_only: Only a lord of the kingdom may draw on its treasury.
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_rallies: %s rallies! His guards rush to his side.
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_fallen: The King of %s has fallen to %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.king: The King of %s has died peacefully in his sleep, at a great age. His heir will take the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.lord: The Lord of %s has died peacefully in his sleep, at a great age. His heir will take the seat by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor: %s mourns its king. An heir will take the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.vassal: %s bends the knee: it is now a fiefdom of %s, and a lord will rule it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.ruin: %s falls into ruin. Its people scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession: A new king takes the throne of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.build.rebuilding: %1$s's builders begin to put up the %2$s again
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_demoted: %s sets aside his crown: he is %s now, sworn to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.audience.fief: %s is a fiefdom: its ruler holds it for %s and pays tribute.
message.jaymoskingdoms.info.storage_unlo: Its storehouse is too far away to take stock of.
message.jaymoskingdoms.info.economy: Economy: %s of %s food in stock; short for its next building: %s; %s free slots
message.jaymoskingdoms.info.personnel: Personnel: %s of %s needed (%s to replace); %s villagers, a crew of %s builders
message.jaymoskingdoms.no_pledge: %s takes no pledges: only kingdoms and fiefdoms do.
message.jaymoskingdoms.elder_died: The elder of %s is dead. The village mourns.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lord_fallen: The Lord of %s has fallen to %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor_lo: %s mourns its lord. Another will take his seat by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession.lord: A new lord takes the seat of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.barbarian.spared: %s lets you be: an outlaw to the realm nearby is welcome here. Kill their own and the welcome won't last.
message.jaymoskingdoms.barbarian.disguis: %s takes you for one of its own. Don't strike any of them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.announce: War horns! A war party from %s marches on %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.beaten: The war party of %s is beaten off.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.withdraw: The war party of %s withdraws with its plunder.
message.jaymoskingdoms.camp.cleared: The chief of %s has fallen to %s! The camp scatters.
message.jaymoskingdoms.camp.thanks: Word of the chief's death spreads: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.build.finished: The builders of %s have finished a %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.not_land: Plots can only be marked in a kingdom's or village's land.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.lords_only: Only a lord of %s may mark its plots.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.outside: That plot would reach outside the land of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.marked: Plot %s marked (%s x %s). The builders of %s may clear it and build there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.none_here: You aren't standing on a plot.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.unknown: The builders don't know how to build a %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.busy: The builders are already at work on plot %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.chosen: Plot %s: the builders will put up a %s when they can.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.design.how: Use the rod on two opposite corners of something you built (take in its floor), then save it with /kingdom design save <name>.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.plot.how: Use the rod on two opposite corners of the ground the builders may build on.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.field.how: Use the rod on two opposite corners of a field. A farmer is taken on to harvest and sow it.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.quarry.how: Use the rod on two opposite corners on the ground; click lower down for the second corner to set how deep. Miners dig it out layer by layer.
surveyor.jaymoskingdoms.storage.how: Use the rod on a chest or barrel to add it to the settlement's storage, or to take it out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.surveyor.design: Corners set: %s x %s, %s high. Save it with /kingdom design save <name>.
message.jaymoskingdoms.plot.size: A plot of %s x %s won't do: each side must be %s to %s blocks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.bad_name: A design's name may only use lower-case letters, digits, _ and - (up to 32).
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.size: That's %s x %s, %s high: a design can be at most %s across and %s high, and at least 2 across.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.taken: Someone else already saved a design called %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.in_use: Builders are using the design %s. Wait until they finish it, or clear its plot.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.too_many: You already have %s designs. Delete one first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.too_many_b: That has more than %s blocks: too much for builders.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.failed: The design %s couldn't be saved or deleted (see the server log).
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.saved: Saved design %s (%s x %s, %s high, %s blocks). On a plot, /kingdom plot build %s has the builders put it up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.not_yours: The design %s isn't yours to delete.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.no_selecti: Mark two corners with a surveyor's rod in Design mode first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.none: Nobody has saved a design yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.design.line_bad: %s: can't be read or too big for builders
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.overlap: That would overlap the %s already there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.field_size: A field of %s x %s won't do: each side must be %s to %s blocks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.field_marked: Field marked (%s x %s). A farmer of %s will keep it: till it and sow a row, and he'll do the rest.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.farmer_hired: %s takes on a farmer for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.quarry_size: A quarry of %s x %s won't do: each side must be %s to %s blocks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.quarry_marke: Quarry marked (%s x %s, %s deep). The miners of %s will dig it out, leaving a stair along its north side.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.miner_hired: %s takes on a miner for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.not_containe: That isn't a chest or a barrel.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.storage_keep: %s's workers need that one: it's where they load.
message.jaymoskingdoms.area.none_here: You aren't standing in a field or quarry.
message.jaymoskingdoms.project.nothing: nothing (the town has all it needs for its size)
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.rummage: Those aren't yours to rifle through!
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.assault: Hey! They're beating on one of us!
A brawler! Don't let them get away with it!
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.pickpoc: Hands out of my pockets! Thief!
message.jaymoskingdoms.pickpocket.caught: %s turns round and catches your hand in their pocket!
message.jaymoskingdoms.pickpocket.liftin: Your hand's in %s's pocket... [%s] keep holding, stay behind them
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.level: Your %s rises to level %s. Press K to spend the point.
Each rank makes the hold 8% shorter: you're in and out of a pocket faster.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.deep_pockets.d: Each rank takes 15% more of what a mark carries, and gives you another try at a pocket that turns up empty.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.soft_step.desc: Each rank lets you sneak closer to onlookers before they see what you're up to.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.quick_hands.de: Reach in from the side, not only from behind, and marks must turn further round before they see you.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.lockpicking.de: Each rank widens a lock's sweet spots by 15% and puts 20% less strain on your pick. From rank 2 your pick feels the binding pin or the gate; at rank 3 the first slip of every try is forgiven.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lock.no_pick.pin: Locked: a %s pin lock. You'll need a lockpick.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lock.no_pick.rota: Locked: a %s rotary lock. You'll need a lockpick.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lock.unbreakable: It's locked fast and banded with iron. Pick the lock first.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lock.pin.help: A/D or the mouse: pick a pin. Hold W or the mouse button to push it up, let go to set it. Pins must be set in their binding order: the binding pin pushes stiff and trembles. Push it past the line and the pick strains.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lock.rotary.help: A/D, the arrow keys or the scroll wheel: turn the dial the way the arrow points (hold Shift to go slowly). The pick trembles near a gate; press W, Space or click to set it. Turning back undoes the last gate, and a miss strains the pick.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.ghost.desc: Guards take no longer to rob than anyone else, and a theft nobody saw is never missed.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shadowed.desc: Monsters see you 10% less far per rank in the dark, in proportion to how dark it is where you stand. A torch in your hand shows zombies 20% less far per rank.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.quiet_step.des: Sneaking hides you from monsters better: they see you half as far (rank 2: two fifths) instead of three fifths. The noise you make sneaking carries a third as far (rank 2: a fifth) instead of half.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.slip_the_net.d: Monsters that lose sight of you give up the chase twice as fast, and the blood you spill stops drawing zombies twice as soon.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.sneak_attack.d: A blow on a monster that hasn't noticed you (from behind, or while it searches) does 2.5 times the damage instead of double (rank 2: triple).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.assassinate.de: A full-strength hidden blade stab on a monster that hasn't noticed you does ten times the damage, like one on a crippled foe. Without this it is only a sneak attack.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.climber.desc: A stronger grip. Anyone can jump at a tall wall holding forward to cling and climb it (not ice, glass or leaves) for 3 s before slipping (hold forward to climb, strafe to shimmy, sneak to let go). Rank 1: your grip lasts 6 s. Rank 2: 8 s, and you climb faster on walls and poles. Rank 3: your grip never gives out, and you climb faster still.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.freerunner.des: Sprint and jump at anything waist-high (up to a block and a half: a fence, a wall, a block) to vault it without losing speed. Rank 2: wall kick. In the air beside or facing a wall, jump to kick off it, once per wall until you land. Everyone breaks into a fast run after 2 s of sprinting; Freerunner makes it faster (rank 1: +40% instead of +30%) and rank 2 gets you there in 1.25 s.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.sure_footing.d: Roll as you land: dodge just before or just after you hit the ground and the fall does you no harm. Costs the dodge's feathers.
From any height, a landing in a hay bale, water or leaves takes no fall damage. Fall looking down and you dive head first.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bar_swing.desc: Jump at a fence, iron bar or chain lying above your head to catch it and hang, swinging. Jump to let go and fly forward with the swing; sneak to drop.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.wall_runner.de: Sprint and jump alongside a wall to run along it for 1.5 s (rank 2: 2.5 s), barely falling. Then drop, or jump to kick off it (with Freerunner rank 2). Wall Runner also lets you sprint at a wall and jump to run up it: 3 blocks (rank 2: 4), without it only in a fast run (2.5 blocks). At the top you grab the ledge or cling to the wall.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.forager.desc: Each rank gives an 8% chance of an extra harvest from ripe crops and nether wart. You also know butchering: you can judge a butcher's skill from their cuts.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.second_wind.de: Under 30% health you start to heal (Regeneration, longer each rank), at most every 20 seconds.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.weathered.desc: Each rank: you burn 20% shorter, and powder snow freezes you a quarter slower.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.iron_stomach.d: Rotten flesh, raw chicken and the like never give you Hunger.
Falls hurt 30% less (but they always hurt). Powers that cancel fall damage work as before.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.last_stand.des: Once a day, a blow that would kill you leaves you on half a heart instead.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.meditation.des: Hold the Meditate key (I) standing still to sit and meditate: it earns mastery toward your power's next move. Each rank after the first makes it quicker. Z Fighters shadowbox instead, and that's how they train in a Gravity user's Immense Field.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.weapon_forms.d: Learn every weapon's full combo: twirls, spins, flips and every attack of its string. Until then each weapon has only one or two plain swings. Opens the Combat Arts.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.make_do.desc: Out here, anything's ammo. Hold any item in your off hand and load it into a crossbow: snowballs freeze, slime balls bounce, TNT flies lit, a fishing rod becomes a grappling hook.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.heavy_blows.de: Each rank adds 4% to your melee damage.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.brace.desc: Each rank: you're knocked back 10% less.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bulldozer.desc: Each rank: your blows knock foes back further.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.packhorse.desc: Sprinting, mining and fighting tire you a quarter less: hunger drains slower.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.titans_grip.de: A full-strength blow has a 1 in 5 chance to stagger what it hits (slowed and weakened for 2 seconds).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.momentum.desc: Blows landed within 2 seconds of each other make a combo. Each rank: every hit in the combo makes the next 4% heavier (up to 5 hits).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.cleave.desc: Each rank: a full-strength blow carries 20% of its damage into up to 3 foes beside what you hit.
Finisher for axes, maces, two-handed and blunt weapons: every 4th hit of a combo, if it's full strength, cracks the ground. Foes round the target take half the blow and are thrown into the air.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.executioner.de: Weapon finishers: sneak + hold left-click on a downed foe with a weapon to finish them with that weapon's move (sword, axe, mace, spear, bow and more). Without it, a weapon or tool only has the basic finish: a blade stabs through, anything else slams. Bare hands snap the neck (hold at the head).
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.rend.desc: Finisher for swords, knives and spears: every 4th hit of a combo, if it's full strength, makes the target bleed for 5 seconds.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.charge.desc: Press the Combat Art key (mouse side button 1) to shoulder-charge forward. The first foe you hit takes 1.5x your attack damage, is shoved back and staggered. 12 second wait.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.war_cry.desc: Sneak and press the Combat Art key (or just the key, if you don't know Charge) to roar. Foes within 10 blocks are weakened and slowed for 6 seconds; you and nearby players get Strength for 8. 45 second wait.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.shield_throw.d: With a shield in hand, press the Combat Art key to hurl it. It strikes the first thing in its way, ricochets on to the next foe (or off a wall) and flies back to you. If a wall stops it on the way back, it drops there; relic shields always find their way home. Each rank: one more ricochet. Press it again to call it back early. 5 second wait.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bladestorm.des: Every 8th hit of a combo, if it's full strength, you whirl round and strike every foe around you for the full blow.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.steady_hands.d: Each rank: every treatment (bandage, splint, stitch, searing, cleaning, salts, leeches, poppy) and every revive of a downed one takes 15% less time.
Each rank: the bandages and rags you tie heal 35% more.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.bonesetter.des: A splint you put on mends a heart and a half into the broken limb at once. Your stitches and searings hurt half as much.
The Nightfall plague goes easier on you: you catch it for half as long and never worse than its first stage, and its pricks and weakness take you only half as often. Only your leeches draw the bad blood out: the plague and poison leave whoever you put them on.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.lifesaver.desc: Anyone you bring round from being downed (a revive or smelling salts) gets up with half their health and their bleeding stopped. Your smelling salts always wake a player who has passed out.
skill.jaymoskingdoms.perk.self_revive.de: Once a day, when you're downed (and awake), hold use with food in hand to eat it and get back up on your own. Steady Hands makes the eating quicker, Lifesaver gets you up on half health.
Survival goes on to level 25 to pay for these. Every treatment you finish and every downed one you bring round teaches a little (at most every 10 s).
Strength goes on to level 25 to pay for these.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.hint.stealth.1: Stealth goes on to level 25 to pay for these. Every freerun move teaches a little (at most every 20 s).
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.hint.stealth.2: Stealth goes on to level 25 to pay for these. Monsters see you less in the dark, sneaking, standing still and from behind; a blow they never saw coming hurts. A sneak attack teaches a little (at most every 20 s), an assassination more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.combat_art.none: Learn Charge, War Cry or Shield Throw in the Strength tree (K, Combat Arts) to use this key.
key.jaymoskingdoms.combat_art: Combat Art (Charge or Shield Throw; sneak: War Cry)
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.hint.survival: Harvest, eat, and live through the night. Each level slows your hunger.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.hint.strength: Fight, fell monsters, mine and chop. Each level hits a little harder.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.alignment.none: No alignment yet: get one pillar to level %s, ahead of the others.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.night: You lived through the night. (+%s Survival)
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.last_stand: Last Stand! You cling on with half a heart.
message.jaymoskingdoms.downed.nothing: There's nothing left in their hands to take.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.respec.bot: You drink the bottle o' enchanting. What you'd learned slips away; your points are yours to spend again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.respec.wiz: The wizard's spell unmakes what you'd learned. Your points are yours to spend again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.disarmed.3: Curse it, where did it go?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.wizard.respec: I can unmake what you've learned, so you may learn again. It'll cost you %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.you.stealth.0: Word is %s has light fingers. I'm keeping a hand on my purse.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.you.stealth.1: They say purses go missing wherever %s turns up. Funny, that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.you.stealth.2: A cutpurse, the miller says. %s, a cutpurse! Well, I never.
Heard %s can fell an ox with one blow. Is it true?
Folk say %s cleared a whole nest of monsters alone. Glad you're on our side.
The smith says %s has an arm like a battering ram.
They say %s sleeps under the stars and never goes hungry.
Word is %s walked out of a blizzard without a scratch.
Heard %s knows every berry in the woods. Could teach my lot a thing or two.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.title: Skills
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.blocked.requir: Learn the perk above it first.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.hint.stealth: Pick pockets, steal unseen, and sneak past monsters without being spotted. Each level makes the hold shorter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.riot: The folk of %s drop what they're doing and come at you! Hit back to scatter them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.scatter: You struck back. The crowd scatters.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.start: They hit back! Stop swinging and they'll cool off, or pay them off: use one with emeralds in hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.price: They want %s emeralds in your hand to let it go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.paid: You paid %s emeralds. That one lets it go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.paid_: You paid off the one you struck. The rest let it go too.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.downe: You're down. They leave you lying there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.coole: They've cooled off and go back about their day.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.squar: You want a fight? You've got one!
Hit me, will you? Come here!
That's it. Help! Someone help me sort this one out!
Please, I've done nothing to you!
...Fine. We'll call it even. This time.
Hm. That'll buy some bandages. Get out of my sight.
I'll take your coin. I won't forget your fist.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retaliation.refus: You think emeralds wash that off? Never.
Not for all the emeralds in the realm.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.seen.light: You were seen. %s thinks a little less of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.seen.medium: You were seen! %s's guards are after you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.seen.heavy: You were seen! %s will not forget this.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.outlaw: You are an outlaw in %s for %s days: its guards will hunt you on sight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.noticed: Word goes round %s that goods are missing from its stores. Strangers are eyed warily.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.declared: %s has declared war on %s! The armies muster: the war begins in %s minutes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.begun: War! %s and %s are at war. Their builders down tools, and their soldiers march.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.not_realm: Only kingdoms and fiefdoms go to war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.already: There is already a war with %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.lords_only: Only a lord of a kingdom or fiefdom can speak for it in war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.not_at_war: Your realm is not at war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.which: Your realm is in more than one war: name the enemy.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.no_offer: They have offered no peace to accept.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.offer_standin: Your offer of peace still stands.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.ended_fallen: The war is over: %s stands, %s has fallen.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.ended_joined: The war between %s and %s is over: they are one realm now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.ended_op: The war between %s and %s has been called off.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.party: A war party of %s marches on %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.party_arrives: The soldiers of %s lay siege to the seat of %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.party_beaten: The war party of %s is beaten.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.join_unsworn: Pledge yourself to a realm before you march to its wars.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.join_seat: No war party of yours is in the field. Go to the seat of %s to call one up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.join_none: %s isn't at war, or has no enemy to march on.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.joined: You march with the war party of %s against %s. It's near %s, %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.called: %s calls up its soldiers! You march with them on %s, at %s, %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.seized: The seat of %s is sacked: %s emeralds and %s goods seized. Bring the spoils home!
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.seized_no_car: The seat of %s is sacked, but with no cart to haul the goods the soldiers take only the %s emeralds they can carry.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.cart_lost: Your war party's spoils cart is lost at %s, %s. Whatever you sack now, only the soldiers can carry.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.spoils_home: The spoils are home in %s: %s emeralds to its treasury, %s to you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.cart: The spoils cart of %s, laden with %s emeralds and %s goods.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.cart_empty: The spoils cart of %s, empty for now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.spoils_spille: The spoils cart is broken open! Its spoils lie on the ground near %s, %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.plunder: You carry off %s goods from the stores of %s: plunder, in war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.peace: Peace between %s and %s (%s). The score stood %s to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.terms.white: A white peace: nothing changes hands.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.terms.vassal: %s bends the knee: it is a fiefdom of %s now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.terms.cede.pr: %s would take tribute and land from %s
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.peace.offered: %s offers peace to %s. As things stand: %s. The offer stands for %s minutes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.peace.unanswe: %s let the peace %s offered go unanswered.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.peace.npc_acc: The ruler of %s accepts the offer of peace.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.peace.npc_ref: The ruler of %s refuses the peace %s offered.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.seat_changes: The seat of %s has fallen: it goes over to %s as its fiefdom.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.status.warmup: the armies muster, war in %s min
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.status.active: at war for %s min, %s min at most left
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.status.side: %s: score %s (kills %s, leaders %s, chunks %s, plunder %s), army %s, with %s
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.status.banner: Banner of %s at %s in %s's land: %s%% held
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.pledged: That realm is pledged to another's war and fights only that one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.war.status.great: A GREAT WAR. The attacker fights for %s (%s).
creed.jaymoskingdoms.crown.about: the king's word is law, and every realm should kneel to one
creed.jaymoskingdoms.chivalry.about: honour, oaths and mercy; it never takes land, and keeps long truces
creed.jaymoskingdoms.conquest.about: the sword makes the realm; it takes twice the land
creed.jaymoskingdoms.faith.about: one true faith; the realms it beats take it up
creed.jaymoskingdoms.coin.about: trade above all; it fights rich rivals for markets and takes heavy tribute
creed.jaymoskingdoms.blood.about: the old blood and its lands; it reclaims land and clashes with every other blood
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.rivals: %s (%s) and %s (%s) can no longer abide each other: they are rivals now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.inevitable: It has come to this: %s, sworn to %s, will not suffer %s and its %s any longer.
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.tensions: Tension between realms (war at the second number):
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.no_tension: No realms are at odds yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.unknown: No such creed: crown, chivalry, conquest, faith, coin or blood.
message.jaymoskingdoms.creed.not_yours: Only the lords of a free players' realm at peace may choose its creed.
message.jaymoskingdoms.great_war.begun: A GREAT WAR! %s, for %s, and %s, for %s: two rich realms throw everything into it. Others will take sides.
message.jaymoskingdoms.great_war.mercs: %s opens its war chest: %s sellswords hired for %s emeralds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.great_war.pledge: %s, of %s, pledges its swords to %s against %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.great_war.broke: %s's war chest is empty: its sellswords leave, and it sues for peace.
message.jaymoskingdoms.great_war.rebelli: Rebellion! %s rises for %s against %s, crowns its lord and goes over to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.great_war.ally_sp: %s takes %s emeralds of %s's purse for its part.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wager.made: %s emeralds on %s, then. If they win, you get %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wager.closed: Wagers on this war are closed: it's been under way too long.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wager.other_side: You've already wagered on the other side of this war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wager.most: You can wager at most %s emeralds on one war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wager.paid: The bookie's runner finds you: %s emeralds.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.greet.1: The book's open. What do you fancy?
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.greet.2: Wars and fists, I take money on both.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.how: Hold the emeralds you mean to stake (up to %s) and click a line.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.nothing: Nothing on the book right now: no war young enough to bet on, and no bout called. (Up to %s a bet when there is.)
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.hover: Stakes the emeralds in your hand
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.none: There's no bookie close enough to take your bet.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.hold: Hold the emeralds you mean to stake.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.card.0: Next bout! %s against %s! Bets with me, the bell rings in %s seconds!
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.card.1: Gather round! %s takes on %s! Get your money down, %s seconds to the bell!
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.card.2: In this corner, %s! In that one, %s! Book closes in %s seconds!
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.win.1: Pay up, the lot of you!
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.retire: That's my last. I'm rich enough, I'm out of here.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.bet.closed: No bout taking bets right now. Wait for the next card.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.bet.won: %s won the bout: your bet pays %s emeralds.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.bet.lost: %s lost the bout: your %s emeralds stay with the bookie.
bookie.jaymoskingdoms.fight: [Step into the ring yourself: %s emeralds to enter]
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.enter.no_pit: This den has no pit to fight in.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.enter.later: Not now, there's a bout on. Ask me again after.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.enter.fee: It's %s emeralds to step into the ring. Hold them out.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.enter.called: You're on! You take on %s. Empty hands, sneak to cover up, and don't step out of the ring. Bell's soon.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.you.held: Your gear's held at the ropes until it's over. Fists only, and the blows are real.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.you.returned: Your gear's handed back over the ropes.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.rag.0: Rags is what we've got. Want me to see to that?
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.rag.1: Clean-ish rag, if you'll have it. Don't ask what it wiped last.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.rag.2: I can rag that up for you. Or see to yourself, your call.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.bandage.0: Your lucky night: a proper bandage. Hold still?
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.bandage.1: Linen, for once. Want it wrapped?
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.bandage.2: Last good bandage in the box. Shall I?
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.offer.rag: The attendant offers to patch you up with a rag.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.offer.band: The attendant offers to patch you up with a linen bandage.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.gone: Nobody's offering to patch you up now.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.declined.1: Bleed on your own floor, then.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.nothing: Nothing there a rag can help.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.done.rag.0: There. Rags round the worst, and anything broken's splinted.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.done.rag.1: Hold still... done. It'll stop the bleeding, not much else.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.done.rag.2: Ragged up. See a proper healer if it opens.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.done.banda: Linen, wrapped tight, and anything broken's set.
Proper bandage, proper knot. Better than most get.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.seen_to.ra: The attendant rags up your wounds and splints anything broken.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.patch.seen_to.ba: The attendant bandages your wounds and splints anything broken.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.you.won: You beat %s! The purse is yours: %s emeralds.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.you.lost.points: Neither of you went down, but %s had more left. The bout's theirs.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.you.lost.foul: You picked something up: a foul. The bout goes to %s.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.you.lost.out: You stepped out of the ring: the bout goes to %s.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.you.lost.fled: You left the fight: the bout goes to %s.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.talk.champion.0: Seen me in the pit under %3$s, %4$s? %1$s wins, and I'm still the champion.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.talk.champion.1: Champion of the pit, that's me. %1$s wins and only %2$s losses. Fancy your chances?
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.talk.champion.2: Nobody's taken my belt yet, %4$s. %1$s wins. Come down and bet on me.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.talk.retired.0: I was champion of the pit under %3$s once. %1$s wins, then I hung up my fists, rich.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.talk.retired.1: Before I settled here I fought bare-knuckle. %1$s wins, %2$s losses. Never lost my title, I retired with it.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.talk.retired.2: See these knuckles, %4$s? %1$s wins in the pit. Paid for everything I own.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.talk.winner.0: I won a bout in the pit under %3$s, you know. %1$s win(s)! Felt good.
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.talk.winner.1: %1$s wins and %2$s losses in the pit. Not bad for someone like me, eh?
fightpit.jaymoskingdoms.talk.winner.2: If you ever go down to the pit, %4$s, tell them you know me. %1$s wins.
message.jaymoskingdoms.banner.colour: That banner claims nothing: plant the banner of %s (%s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.banner.not_fronti: That banner claims nothing: only chunks bordering land your side holds, or on the enemy's frontier, can be taken.
message.jaymoskingdoms.banner.already: A banner of your war already stands there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.banner.planted: The banner of %s is planted in the land of %s at %s! Hold it for %s seconds to take the land.
message.jaymoskingdoms.banner.siege: The banner of %s is planted before the seat of %s at %s! Held for %s seconds, the seat falls.
message.jaymoskingdoms.banner.seat_taken: The banner of %s flies over the seat of %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.banner.torn: The banner of %s at %s is torn down.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warlord_rallies: %s sounds the horn! His illagers close in.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.announce.ill: Raid horns! The illagers of %s ride on %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.illager_camp.clea: The warlord of %s has fallen to %s! The illagers scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.illager_camp.than: Word of the warlord's death spreads: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grim.fiefdom: The lord of %s raises the banner of %s over an old ruin: a new fiefdom.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grim.camp: Barbarians have taken an old ruin near %2$s: the camp of %1$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grim.camp_wild: Barbarians have taken an old ruin in the wild: the camp of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grim.cleared: The builders of %s have cleared the rubble from their hold.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grim.erect: The builders of %s begin raising a new hall beside their hold.
message.jaymoskingdoms.overnight: While you slept, the builders of %s laid %s blocks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.bear: Something heavy is crashing through the brush toward you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.lion: Tawny shapes are slinking through the grass. You're being stalked.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.tiger: Something striped is watching you from the undergrowth.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.alligat: Something low and scaled slides out of the reeds toward you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.komodo_: A forked tongue flicks. Something has caught your scent.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.rhino: The ground shakes. Something big is about to charge.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.desert_: Pincers click in the sand around you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.jungle_: Pincers click in the leaf litter around you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.boar: Tusked shapes are grunting and coming your way.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.snake: A rattle, or a hiss? Something is coiled close by.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.feral_w: A howl, then another, closer. The pack has your scent.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.coyote: Yips and cackles in the dark, all around you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.tarantu: Something hairy is scuttling over the ground toward you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.moose: A bellow, and the crack of antlers on wood. Something big doesn't want you here.
message.jaymoskingdoms.overnight_gathere: While you slept, %s dug %s blocks of its mine, and its miners and woodcutters brought in %s items.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mine.done.cave: The builders of %s have dug their mine down into a cave. Miners are taking it over.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mine.done.deep: The builders of %s have dug their mine as deep as it goes. Miners are taking it over.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mine.done.water: The builders of %s stopped their mine short of water. Miners are taking it over.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warden.confined: %s: "With but %s guards left to me, I dare not leave this hall."
message.jaymoskingdoms.warden.offer: %s: "You have the look of someone I could trust. Will you serve me as %s, and keep me safe?"
message.jaymoskingdoms.warden.no_offer: No such offer stands for you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warden.sworn: %s has sworn to keep the ruler of %s safe, as %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warden.failed: The ruler of %s fell while in your keeping. Your good name with the realm and its allies is gone.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.forgiven: The guards of %s will let you back in now.
%s's guard shoves you back: "Keep your distance from the king!"
%s's guards are watching you now. They think you mean the king harm: keep away from him.
%s's guards have had enough of you hanging about the king. They're seeing you out of %s, and you're not to come back for %s minutes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.tyrant.cl: %s's guard glares at you: kneel (sneak) before the king, or answer for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.tyrant.wa: You stand tall before %s. His guards take it as insolence.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.tyrant.fi: You're fined %s emerald for your insolence to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.tyrant.ba: %s has had enough of your insolence. His guards are throwing you out of %s; don't come back for %s minutes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.warlord.c: %s's guard puts a hand on your arm: "Steel away from the king." (Put your weapon away.)
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.warlord.w: %s's guards take your drawn weapon as a challenge. Put it away or they'll see you off.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.warlord.b: You kept a blade drawn by %s. His guards are marching you out of %s; you're barred for %s minutes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.noble.war: %s's guards ask you, politely, to give the king some room.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.reveler.w: %s's guards have had about enough of your antics.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.purist.cl: %s's guard bars your way with his spear: "Back. The king doesn't breathe the same air as %s."
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.purist.wa: %s's guards have noticed you aren't of his %s blood, and they don't like you hanging about him.
message.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.purist.ba: %s will not suffer your kind under his nose any longer. His guards are throwing you out of %s; you're not to come back for %s minutes.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.out1: Keep walking. You're not welcome here.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.out3: Show your face here again and see what happens.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.paranoid.s: Guards! Get that one out of my city!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.paranoid.w: I've got my eye on you.
One more step toward the king and you'll regret it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.tyrant.clo: On your knees before the king!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.tyrant.sei: Throw this wretch out of my city!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.tyrant.wat: Lower your eyes before the king.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.warlord.ha: Hands where I can see them, soldier.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.warlord.se: March that one out of my city.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.warlord.fa: Now there's a fighter. At ease.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.warlord.wa: You want a fight? Put it away.
Try it and you'll find out why we win wars.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.noble.hand: Easy, friend. The king has a lot of hands to shake.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.noble.favo: Welcome, traveller. Be at peace in my city.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.noble.watc: If you'd give His Majesty a little room.
Pardon me, friend. A step back, please.
The king will see you another time.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.reveler.fa: A friend! Here, have something sweet!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.reveler.wa: Ha! That's enough out of you!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.purist.han: Get your %1$s hands off the king!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.purist.sei: Get that mongrel out of my city.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.purist.fav: Pure %1$s blood. That's what this realm is built on. Take this, %2$s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.purist.wat: Step aside. This street was built by %2$s hands.
Look at it. A %1$s, right up by the king. Shameful.
Go and stand with your own kind. Wherever they are.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feast: %s throws a feast in %s! Bread and music for all.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.purist.of: a purist, proud of his %s blood
temper.jaymoskingdoms.tyrant.line1: You call that a bow? Grovel properly.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.tyrant.line2: Your bread is the crown's bread.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.tyrant.line3: Work harder, or the stocks await.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.noble.line0: Good day to you! How fare your fields?
temper.jaymoskingdoms.noble.line1: Take this, and feed your little ones.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.noble.line2: If the roof leaks, my builders will see to it.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.noble.line3: Our realm is only as strong as its people.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.warlord.line1: Can you hold a spear? Good.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.reveler.line2: Why so glum? Sing with me!
temper.jaymoskingdoms.purist.line1: A %1$s, in my street? Whoever let you settle here will answer for it.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.purist.line2: Don't look at me. %2$s blood built this realm; yours only lives in it.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.purist.line3: Hmph. Another %1$s. My city fills up with your sort.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.purist.kin0: Good, strong %1$s blood. This realm is yours, %2$s.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.purist.kin1: Take this, kinsman, and raise many children. We need more of our own.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.purist.kin2: You stand like a true %1$s. Never forget what you are.
temper.jaymoskingdoms.purist.kin3: Our blood, our walls, our crown. Proud of you, %2$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job_no_settlement: %s has no settlement here to work for.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job_nothing.farme: %2$s has no farm for %1$s to keep yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job_nothing.miner: %2$s has no mine for %1$s to work yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job_nothing.woodc: %2$s has no tree farm for %1$s to work yet.
focus.jaymoskingdoms.mining: mining: it sends stone and ore to its overlord
focus.jaymoskingdoms.farming: farming: it sends food to its overlord
wealth.jaymoskingdoms.wealthy: wealthy (mounted guards and archers, the king's carriage)
message.jaymoskingdoms.roaming.merchant_: You struck a merchant under %s's protection. Its guards will remember it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.roaming.broken: The pillager caravan is broken. Its pack animals are free for the taking.
message.jaymoskingdoms.roaming.broken_th: The pillager caravan is broken. Word reaches %s, and they think the better of you.
commands.jaymoskingdoms.roaming.no_room: No open ground for a caravan near you (it needs dry land outside any realm, 64-96 blocks away).
commands.jaymoskingdoms.roaming.spawned: A %s caravan is on its way past you.
commands.jaymoskingdoms.roaming.line: %s at %s, bound for %s: %s fighters, %s pack animals
message.jaymoskingdoms.caravan.robbed: You broke open a cart of %s's caravan. They won't forget it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.carriage.bought: %s has bought its king a carriage.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job_nothing.pulle: %2$s has no road and storehouse for %1$s to pull a rickshaw between yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job_nothing.stabl: %2$s has no stable for %1$s to work in yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job_nothing.farri: %2$s has no stable for %1$s to shoe horses in yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.greet: %1$s, stablehand of %2$s: "Boarding's %3$s emeralds a week, paid when you take your horse back. Or buy one of ours."
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.none_near: There's no stablehand near enough to talk to.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.no_horse: You've no horse of your own close by.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.boarded: %1$s is in a stall now. %2$s will feed, water and brush it; %3$s emeralds for each week begun, paid when you take it back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.pay_first: %1$s is boarded. Settle up with the stablehand first (%2$s emeralds).
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.cant_pay: That's %s emeralds, and you don't have them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.market: Horses for sale at %s's stable today:
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.sold_out: Nothing left for sale today. Come back tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.gone: That horse has already been sold.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.bought: The %1$s is yours (%2$s emeralds). Treat it well and it will learn to trust you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.too_poor: %1$s shakes their head: the stable can't find %2$s emeralds for it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.sold: You sold %1$s to the stable for %2$s emeralds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.destrier_l: The knight's %s breaks loose, still in its war tack. Earn its trust and it's yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stable.pony_loose: The raider's %s bolts free. Break it in and it's yours.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.title: %s, stablehand of %s
gui.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.title: %s, farrier of %s
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.subtitle: Boarding %s emeralds a week · Your purse: %s emeralds
gui.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.subtitle: Shoeing %s emeralds · Your purse: %s emeralds
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.yours_none: None of your horses are nearby.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.kept_none: You have no horses boarded here.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.locked.prospe: Only a prosperous kingdom stocks this
gui.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.locked.wealth: Only a wealthy kingdom stocks this
message.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.greet: %1$s, farrier of %2$s: "Shoes, tack, whatever your horse needs."
message.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.none_near: There's no farrier near enough to talk to.
message.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.shod: %1$s fits %2$s with new shoes and trims its hooves (%3$s emeralds).
message.jaymoskingdoms.caravan.bags_empt: These saddlebags have already been emptied.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stable.break_in.tex: The stable at %1$s is short of horses, and the ones we buy cost the earth. Catch a wild one, break it in yourself, and bring it to me. Not one you bought, mind: I'll know.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stable.stud.title: A Fine %s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stable.stud.text: I want to breed better %1$s. Bring me one of your own that's good enough for it: %2$s%% quality or better. You'll be paid what it's worth and more.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.break_in.title: A Horse for the King
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.break_in.text: My stables at %1$s are full of horses bred to the saddle. I want one with the wild still in it, that nobody but you has ridden. Catch one, break it in, and bring it to me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.race.title: The Ride to %s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.race.text: My stablemaster swears no horse in the realm can reach %1$s in under %2$s seconds. Prove him wrong: ride there (%3$s, %4$s) before your time is up, then come back and tell me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stablehand.wheat.te: The horses eat more than the whole town. Bring me %1$s %2$s before the stalls go hungry.
Nothing settles a nervous horse like a carrot. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.stablehand.wolves.t: Wolves have been circling the paddock at night and the horses won't settle. Kill %1$s of them.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.iron.title: Iron for Shoes
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.iron.text: Every horse in town needs shoes and I've run out of iron. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.coal.title: Coal for the Forge
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.coal.text: My forge is going cold. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farrier.leather.tex: Bridles and saddles don't stitch themselves. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.break_in: Break in a wild horse and bring it to %s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.stud: Bring %3$s a %1$s of %2$s%% quality or better.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.race.won: You rode into %s with %s seconds to spare! Go back and tell the king.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.race.lost: Time's up: you didn't reach %s in time. The race is lost.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.offer: %s will take you to (click one; you pay in emeralds):
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.busy: %s is busy just now. Try again when the rickshaw's back at its rank.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.nowhere: There's nowhere near enough for %s to take you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.too_far: Stand by the rickshaw to hire it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.cant_pay: The fare is %s emeralds, and you don't have them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.off: %s takes you to %s for %s emeralds. Turn back on the way and you get them back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.take_the: %s carries goods and townsfolk. %s keeps a carriage for travellers: it waits across the bell.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rickshaw.worn_out: %s looks worn out. It'll be a slow ride.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cab.off: %s drives you to %s for %s emeralds. Turn back on the way and you get them back.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.rabbits.text: Rabbits have been at my carrots every night this week. Thin them out for me: %1$s of them should do.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.zombies.text: The dead come up out of the dark and trample my rows flat. Put down %1$s %2$s before they ruin the harvest.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.bones.title: Bones for the Soil
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.bones.text: Nothing feeds a field like bone meal. Bring me %1$s %2$s and I'll grind them myself.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.seeds.title: Grandfather's Seed Pouch
quest.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.seeds.text: My grandfather's seed pouch was lost when his camp was overrun, out at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. The seed in it came from the old country. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.beef.title: Beef for the Larder
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.beef.text: The larder's nearly bare and folk are asking. Bring me %1$s %2$s, fresh as you can.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.pork.title: Pork for the Smokehouse
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.pork.text: I've a smokehouse with nothing in it. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.mutton.text: There's a feast coming and not enough mutton. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.chicken.tex: Bring me %1$s %2$s and there'll be stew for the whole street.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.rabbit.text: Rabbit pie is what they want and rabbit is what I lack. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.cleaver.tex: My master's cleaver was taken by bandits who camped at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Fetch the %1$s back; no blade has ever cut so clean.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.shepherd.wolves.tex: Wolves have been circling the flock at dusk. Drive them off for good: %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.shepherd.spiders.te: Spiders creep into the pasture and spook the sheep half to death. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.shepherd.string.tex: The loom is hungry. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.shepherd.shears.tex: The golden shears my family has kept for generations were lost at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Please, bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.leatherworker.leath: The tanning vats sit empty. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.leatherworker.hides: A lady wants a rabbit-fur cloak. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
Travellers pay well for a lucky charm. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.leatherworker.saddl: The finest saddle I ever stitched was left at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s when its rider fell. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.cod.title: A Catch of Cod
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.cod.text: The boats came back empty. Bring me %1$s %2$s for the market.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.salmon.te: The salmon are running and I'm laid up. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.ink.title: Ink from the Deep
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.ink.text: The scribes pay well for ink. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.drowned.t: Drowned things climb onto the jetty at night. Put %1$s %2$s back under the water.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fisherman.compass.t: My brother's ship went down at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. His %1$s is all I ask back.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fletcher.feathers.t: I can't fletch arrows without feathers. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fletcher.flint.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; the guards go through arrows like water.
Skeletons have been shooting at the woodcutters. Put down %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fletcher.bow.title: Grandsire's Bow
quest.jaymoskingdoms.fletcher.bow.text: My grandsire's bow was lost when he fought at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.iron.title: Iron for the Forge
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.iron.text: The forge is cold for want of iron. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.coal.title: Coal for the Forge
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.coal.text: No coal, no steel. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.pillagers.t: Pillagers have been robbing the roads. Kill %1$s %2$s and I'll see you plated for it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.helm.title: The Ancestral Helm
quest.jaymoskingdoms.armorer.helm.text: My grandfather's helm was taken by raiders to the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Win back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.weaponsmith.zombies: I need to know my blades bite. Slay %1$s %2$s and tell me how they held.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.weaponsmith.pillage: Pillagers rob every cart that leaves. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.weaponsmith.iron.te: Bring me %1$s %2$s and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.weaponsmith.blade.t: The blade my master forged for the old king broke at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring me the %1$s so I can mend it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.toolsmith.iron.text: The miners keep breaking picks. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.toolsmith.coal.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; the bellows are wheezing on nothing.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.toolsmith.pick.text: Old Hrolf dropped his pick fleeing the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s; it's the best I ever made.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.librarian.tome.text: A tome of great learning is said to lie in the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring me the %1$s and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.librarian.paper.tex: The archive needs copying. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.librarian.ink.title: Ink for the Scribes
quest.jaymoskingdoms.librarian.ink.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; the scribes have run dry.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.undead.title: Lay the Dead to Rest
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.undead.text: The dead walk too close to the village. Lay %1$s %2$s to rest.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.eyes.title: Spider Eyes
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.flesh.title: Rotten Flesh
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.relic.title: The Holy Relic
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.relic.text: A holy relic was carried off to the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s before something worse finds it.
A chart of the coast went down with a ship at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring me the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cartographer.map.te: An old map of these lands was left at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring me the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cartographer.phanto: Phantoms dive at anyone travelling by night. Bring down %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.clay.title: Clay for Bricks
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.clay.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; the kiln is waiting.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.quartz.title: Quartz for the Chapel
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.quartz.text: The chapel needs quartz. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.silverfish.te: Silverfish have got into the quarry stone. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.chisel.title: The Master's Chisel
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mason.chisel.text: My master's chisel lies at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s, where he carved his last. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.logs.title: Timber for the Works
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.logs.text: We're short of timber for the new houses. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.cobble.text: The walls won't build themselves. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.plans.title: The Lost Plans
quest.jaymoskingdoms.builder.plans.text: The plans for the new hall were lost at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.spiders.title: Spiders in the Tunnels
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.spiders.text: Cave spiders have nested in the tunnels. Clear out %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.creepers.text: Creepers keep wandering into the mine. Kill %1$s %2$s before they bring the roof down.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.torches.title: Light for the Mine
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.torches.text: The tunnels are black as pitch. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.lantern.title: The Lost Lantern
quest.jaymoskingdoms.miner.lantern.text: A lantern was left burning deep in the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Fetch the %1$s.
Spiders drop on us from the branches. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.woodcutter.saplings: For every tree we fell, two should grow. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.woodcutter.axe.text: My father's felling axe was left at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.monsters.text: Monsters prowl the roads at night. Slay %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.skeletons.tex: Skeletons have been shooting at the watch. Put down %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.pillagers.tex: Pillager patrols have been sighted. Kill %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.blade.title: A Comrade's Blade
quest.jaymoskingdoms.guard.blade.text: My comrade fell at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s so we can bury it with honour.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.berries.title: Sweet Berries
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.berries.text: I've a mind to bake. Bring me %1$s %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.flowers.title: Flowers for a Sweetheart
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.flowers.text: Bring me %1$s %2$s; I've someone to court.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.heirloom.title: The Family Heirloom
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none.heirloom.text: Our family's heirloom was lost at the %2$s near %3$s, %4$s. Bring back the %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mail.near.title: A Letter for %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mail.near.text: Would you carry this letter to %1$s? They're here in %2$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mail.far.title: A Letter to %2$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.mail.far.text: Would you carry this letter to %1$s? It's a long road: %2$s lies at %3$s, %4$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.chief.title: The Chief of %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.chief.text: The barbarians of %1$s raid my villages and laugh at my guards. Go to their camp at %2$s, %3$s and bring me word their chief is dead. Go well armed: he does not die easily, and his people will fight for him.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.hint.oath: Sworn to him when he dies: +%s%% emeralds
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.hint.round: Slain out on his round: +%s%% emeralds
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.cunning.oa: You broke your oath with the blow. His realm will not forget it, but the one who sent you will pay well.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.cunning.ro: He died among his own people, his bread still warm. The one who sent you will pay well.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.alms: You look tired, friend. Take this, and go well.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.regicide.alms.near: %s stops for you, close enough to touch.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.tyran: The king of %1$s laughed at my envoy. No one laughs at me. Kneel to him, swear him your sword, and he will let you near his throne at %2$s, %3$s. Then end him. An oath to a dead man binds no one.

The king of %1$s is loved, and that offends me. Each day he leaves his throne at %2$s, %3$s to hand out bread with few swords at his back. He stops for any stranger who looks hungry. Look hungry, and let his kindness kill him.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.warlo: I would rather take the crown of %1$s on the field, but its king hides behind his walls and will not come out to fight me. Swear yourself his man, get near his throne at %2$s, %3$s, and finish what he is too craven to face me for.

The king of %1$s will not meet me in the field; he is too busy feeding peasants. Each day he walks out from his throne at %2$s, %3$s with bread and few guards. If he will not fight me, let him die among his loaves.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.paran: The king of %1$s plots against me. His spies are everywhere; I hear them at night. Strike first. Swear to him, let him trust you as I never trust anyone, reach his throne at %2$s, %3$s, and kill him before he kills me.

The king of %1$s smiles and hands out bread, and everyone loves him. It is a mask: he plots my end, I am sure of it. Each day he walks out from his throne at %2$s, %3$s with hardly a guard. Kill him before he moves against me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.revel: The king of %1$s refused my feast and called my court a tavern. Drink to his health, swear to his crown, and get close to his throne at %2$s, %3$s. Then make him the last guest of a very short party.

The king of %1$s plays the saint and makes my feasts look like gluttony. Each day he leaves his throne at %2$s, %3$s with bread for the poor and few guards. Take his bread, then take his life. We will drink to it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.puris: The king of %1$s lets every stray blood under the sun settle in his city and calls it strength. It is rot, and it spreads. Swear to him, get near his throne at %2$s, %3$s, and cut the rot out at the root.
The king of %1$s walks among mongrels and hands them bread as if they were his own. Each day he leaves his throne at %2$s, %3$s with few guards at his back. Let him die among the rabble he loves.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.warband.title: The Host Against %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.warband.text: I do not send knives in the dark. I send armies. Take my soldiers and my spoils cart against %1$s, sack its seat at %2$s, %3$s, and bring the cart home. If we are not at war with them yet, we will be the moment you say yes.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.warband: Lead %1$s's war party to sack %2$s: once the war is on, stand at %1$s's seat and use /kingdom war join.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.warband.cannot: War on %s can't be declared now (a truce, an alliance, or the same side).
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.warlord.title: The Warlord of %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.warlord.text: The illager camp of %1$s grows bolder by the day. Go to %2$s, %3$s and slay its warlord. His axe has felled better than you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.warch: A warchief of the illagers has taken the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s and gathers raiders for a war on my realm. Slay %1$s before the war comes to us. My best knights did not come back.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.tomb_: Something old has woken in the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s. My scouts call it %1$s. End it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.stalk: A thing of bone and moss haunts the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s, and its arrows never miss. Hunt down %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.frost: Travellers freeze on the road by the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s. %1$s lairs there. Destroy it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.bone_: Deep in the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s, %1$s raises an army of the dead. Go down and break it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.brute: A brute of the Nether came through the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s and has made it a fortress. Kill %1$s before more follow.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.beast: A beast the size of a barn has made its lair by the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s, and it has eaten a village's herds. Kill %1$s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.champion.plagu: A knight who died in plate walks again at the %2$s at %3$s, %4$s, and the sick follow him. Put %1$s in the ground for good.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.letter.delivered: Letter delivered. Go back to %s for your pay.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.dig: Brush %s out of the suspicious gravel in the %s at %s, %s.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.none: They have no work to give.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.gone: %s has moved on. Find them and talk again.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.nothing: Nothing for you today. Come back tomorrow.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.nothing.king: The king has no task for you today.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.refuse: Begone. I've nothing for the likes of you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.king: You dare show your face here?
quest.jaymoskingdoms.untrusted: %s wants nothing to do with you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.untrusted.king: The king of %s will not trust you with his work until your name is better here.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.full: You carry %s quests already. Finish or give one up first.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.full.royal: You already carry out a king's decree. Finish it first.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cache_near: %s is somewhere close by, in the ruin.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.dig_near: %s lies buried here, in the suspicious gravel nearest the ruin's heart. Dig down and brush it out.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.accept: Thank you! I knew I could count on you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.accept.king: Go, and do not fail me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.thanks: Thank you, truly. Here, this is yours.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.thanks.king: The realm is in your debt. Take these, with my thanks.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.said.letter: A letter? For me? Thank you, friend.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.name: %s %s
relic.jaymoskingdoms.royal_gift: Given by %s, for service to the crown
relic.jaymoskingdoms.bloodthirst.desc: Heals you for a fifth of the damage you deal.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.frostbite.desc: Chills and slows whatever it strikes.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.stormcaller.desc: Now and then calls lightning down on its target.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.executioner.desc: Strikes harder at foes near death.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.second_wind.desc: When you're badly hurt, you heal quickly for a while (once a minute).
relic.jaymoskingdoms.retribution.desc: Sends back a quarter of the blows you take.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.bulwark.desc: Blows sometimes shield you with extra hearts.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.fleetfoot.desc: You move faster while you wear it.
relic.jaymoskingdoms.flameward.desc: Fire can't hurt you once you're burning.
item.jaymoskingdoms.hidden_blade.lore.1: A leather bracer with a spring blade, worn on the wrist.
item.jaymoskingdoms.hidden_blade.lore.2: Needs Stealth level %s; in lesser hands it jams.
item.jaymoskingdoms.hidden_blade.lore.3: Leap from %s+ blocks onto a foe: the fall hurts them, not you, and cripples them.
item.jaymoskingdoms.hidden_blade.lore.4: Every full-strength stab at a crippled foe deals %sx the damage.
item.jaymoskingdoms.hidden_blade.lore.5: Use to strap it on a wrist. With that hand empty, use springs the blade; Sneak + use at the sky takes it off.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hidden_blade.jams: The blade's spring jams in your clumsy hands. (Needs Stealth level %s)
message.jaymoskingdoms.hidden_blade.both: Both wrists already wear a hidden blade.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hidden_blade.stab: A crippled foe: the blade goes in deep.
message.jaymoskingdoms.hidden_blade.assa: Assassination: the blade goes in deep.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crippled.over: The pain eases; you can walk again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_village.cl: The goblin king of %s has fallen to %s! The goblins scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_village.th: Word of the goblin king's death spreads: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.welcome: The goblins of %s take you for one of their own.
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.exposed: The goblins of %s see through your disguise!
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.cry.murder: Murder! It's a big'un in a mask!
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.mutter.0: You're a tall one, ain't ya...
message.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.mutter.3: Back off from the boss, you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.horse_throws: Your mount panics and throws you!
message.jaymoskingdoms.scroll_no_target: Nothing in sight to read it at.
message.jaymoskingdoms.caster_none: No kingdom or camp within 400 blocks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.skills.respec.not: %s has nothing of yours to unmake: you've learned no perks.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wizard_none: Stand by a grown villager to make them the court wizard.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/1: I wasn't born here, you know. My family came all the way from %2$s.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/2: Folk here still call me the stranger. I grew up in %2$s, a long way from this place.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/3: Some nights I miss %2$s. It's a long road back.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/4: My grandmother crossed half the world from %2$s to settle here. I've never seen it myself.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.immigrant/5: Back in %2$s we did things differently, %1$s. I'm still getting used to this place.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/1: We moved here from %2$s, just over the hills. Not so different, really.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/2: I grew up in %2$s, not far from here. I still visit my kin when I can.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/3: My folks are in %2$s, a few days' walk away. They think I'm mad for living here.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.newcomer/4: Came over from %2$s a few winters back. The weather took some getting used to.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_scho: I raised this rock to study the stars without the smoke of the towns, %1$s. The spell to bring it down again... I'm still working on that part.
Twelve years of notes, all up here. If the island ever comes down, the books come down with it, so I stay.
The clouds pass right through the garden some mornings. Wonderful for my research, terrible for my laundry.
I came up for one night of stargazing. That was, oh, a good few winters ago now.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_retr: Kings kept asking me to curse their neighbours. Up here nobody asks me anything, %1$s. Present company excepted.
I served three courts before I'd had enough of them. The wind is better company than any king.
A mage needs quiet to think. There's nothing quieter than a rock floating in the sky.
If any kingdom sent you to fetch me back, tell them you couldn't find the way up.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_ward: The island stays up because I keep it up, %1$s. Each morning I renew the spell. Miss a day and down it goes.
My master held this island before me, and her master before her. One day someone will hold it after me.
There's a village under us. I'd rather they never found out what keeps this rock off their roofs.
I can't leave for long. The spell holding us up gets thin when I'm not here.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_exil: I was a court wizard once, %1$s. One spell went wrong in front of the king, and they sent me as far from the ground as they could.
The crown said never to set foot in the realm again. They never said anything about floating above it.
I still keep the robe. They took the title, but they couldn't take what I know.
Some nights I can see the castle lights from here. I don't miss the place. Mostly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.scholar.0: A visitor! I raised this island to watch the stars, and I've not managed to bring it down since. Here, for your trouble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.scholar.1: Mind the edge. I'm a scholar, stuck up here by my own spell. Take a scroll for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.scholar.2: Oh! Nobody comes up here. I study the sky, and the sky is very close. Have this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.retreat.0: You found my retreat. I left the courts for some peace up here. Take this, and don't tell the kings.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.retreat.1: A guest, at this height? I came up here to get away from kingdoms. A scroll, for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.retreat.2: Quiet up here, isn't it? That's why I stay. Here, something for your trouble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.warden.0: Careful where you step. I'm the warden of this island; my spell keeps it in the sky. Take this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.warden.1: Welcome, traveller. Without me this rock would fall. A scroll, for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.warden.2: You climbed all this way? Then you've earned this. I keep the island up; you keep your footing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.exile.0: I was a court wizard, once. Banished up here. It's good to see a face. Have this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.exile.1: The king sent me as far from the ground as he could. You found me anyway. A scroll, for the climb.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit.exile.2: An exile's hospitality isn't much, but take this. I've plenty of time to write them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant: Stop. By the king's command, every stranger's pack is searched. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.noble: Pardon the trouble, traveller. There's been thieving, and we're asked to look in strangers' packs. Would you mind?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.warlord: You. Pack open. The commander wants to know what strangers carry into his city.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid: Hold still. The king believes someone means him harm. Let's see what's in your pack.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reveler: Ho there! Spot check, friend. What've you got in the pack? Anything for the feast?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.plain: Mind if I look in your pack? There's been things going missing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant.more: Open it, or we open you. Those are the king's words, not mine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.noble.more: We'll be quick, and anything that's yours stays yours. It's only that goods have gone missing from the stores.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.warlord.more: Steel, powder, poison. A soldier knows what to look for. Show me and you can go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid.more: Knives, poison, letters to his enemies. You'd be amazed what we find. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reveler.more: Honestly it's mostly to see if anyone's brought cake. Go on, let's have a look.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.plain.more: Just a look, then you're on your way. Folk have lost things lately.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist: You. %2$s. Your sort steals; everyone knows it. Open your pack.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist_kin: Ah, %3$s blood, like mine. A formality, brother. Just open the pack and we're done.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist.more: Anyone not of %3$s blood is searched coming in. The king's orders. Open it, or turn around.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist_kin.mo: We only bother our own when there's been thieving. One look, and you're on your way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.tyrant: Halt. Strangers pay the king's toll to walk his streets. %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.noble: Good day. There's a small toll for the upkeep of the roads, %s emerald, if you can spare it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.warlord: City toll: %s emeralds. It pays for the walls you're standing behind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.paranoid: Toll. %s emeralds. And your name, and where you've come from.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reveler: A coin for the king's feast! %s emerald, and you're welcome at the table.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.plain: There's a toll for using our road. %s emerald.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.tyrant.more: %s emeralds, into the king's coffers. Strangers who don't pay don't walk free.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.noble.more: %s emerald for the roads and the bridges. Nobody's turned away for being poor, mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.warlord.more: %s emeralds for the garrison. Walls don't build themselves, and soldiers don't eat stone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.paranoid.more: %s emeralds. Everyone pays. Everyone is written down. That's how we keep him safe.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reveler.more: %s emerald, and there's cake and ale for everyone tonight. The king insists!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.plain.more: %s emerald to keep the road mended. It's the same for everyone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.purist: Your kind pays to walk these streets. %1$s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.purist_kin: Kinsman! The toll's %1$s emerald for our own. Next to nothing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.purist.more: %1$s emeralds. %3$s folk walk free. %2$s folk pay. That's how it is here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.purist_kin.more: %1$s emerald, for the walls that keep our blood safe. Outsiders pay four times that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.tyrant: You look soft. %s emeralds says I put you on the ground. Or are you a coward as well?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.noble: Would you care for a friendly bout? %s emeralds on it, all in good sport.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.warlord: You carry yourself like a fighter. A bout, %s emeralds to the winner. Let's see what you've got.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.paranoid: You. Show me how you fight. %s emeralds on it. I want to know what you're capable of.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reveler: A wrestle! Best of one! %s emeralds, and the loser buys the next round!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.plain: Fancy a bout? %s emeralds says I'll have you on your back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.tyrant.more: Hands and feet, no blades. If you win, I'll be surprised. Put up %s emeralds or walk on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.noble.more: Bare hands, first to yield. %s emeralds each, and no hard feelings, whoever wins.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.warlord.more: Bare hands, first one down loses. %s emeralds. Better armour helps, so does a strong arm.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.paranoid.more: A bout, %s emeralds. If you're an assassin, I'd rather find out now than later.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.reveler.more: No weapons, just a friendly scrap! %s emeralds! Everyone's watching, come on!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.plain.more: No weapons. %s emeralds. Armour and a strong arm will help you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.purist: Let's see what %2$s blood is good for. %1$s emeralds says you go down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.purist_kin: A bout between kin? %1$s emeralds, and let the best of us win.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bout.purist.more: Bare hands. %1$s emeralds. I want everyone to watch %3$s blood beat yours.
