talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.risen.3: A cousin of mine lives %s blocks %s. Says a dead woman sells bread there now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.risen.4: Don't go %s blocks to the %s. The dead keep house there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.risen.5: %s blocks %s, a man who died last week still tends his fields. Cold as stone, they say.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.risen.6: There's a village %s blocks to the %s where one of the dead goes to market every morning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.risen.7: Heard of the one %s blocks %s? Died, got up, went home for supper.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.risen.8: %s blocks to the %s, the priest won't go near a house where the dead one lives.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.risen.9: Somebody %s blocks %s came back from the ground with no shadow of their own.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.risen.10: The dead don't stay down %s blocks to the %s. One of them's working the forge.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.risen.11: %s blocks %s of here the dogs howl at a villager every night. They died, you know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.6: Get the guards! No, get ALL the guards!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.7: It's not from here! It's not from anywhere!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.8: Don't look in its eyes! Any of them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.9: It came out of a falling star, I saw it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.alien.11: What does it want? WHAT DOES IT WANT?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.0: A tail! It's got a TAIL! Werewolf!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.1: That's no traveller, look behind them! Run!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.2: Beast! A beast in a man's clothes!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.3: Lock the doors, there's a tailed thing in the street!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.4: It's one of those wolf-folk! Get the children in!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.5: Gods, that tail's moving on its own!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.7: I knew it, I KNEW something was wrong with that one!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.8: Is it a werewolf? Is it worse? I'm not staying to find out!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.9: Don't let it near you, the tail's how they get you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.tail.11: Mother warned me about tailed folk. RUN!
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.tail_explai: So you're not a werewolf... you were just born that way? Well, %1$s, I suppose you've never bitten anyone. I'm sorry I ran.
A warrior's tail, from a people far away? I don't quite follow, %1$s, but you're a friend. It doesn't frighten me now.
Oh! I thought you were some sort of monster. Thank you for telling me, %1$s. Your secret's safe with me.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.ember_hug_y: Careful, %1$s! I'm Emberborn, you'll burn yourself. Drink something for the fire first.
No, no, don't! My skin's hot as an ember. Are you alright, %1$s?
Oh, %1$s, I'm sorry! Nobody holds an Emberborn without fire in their own blood, or a potion against it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.ember_hug_m: Ow! %1$s, you're burning hot! Keep your Emberborn arms to yourself!
Ah! My shirt's smoking! A wave would do, %1$s.
Hot! Hot! I'd hug you, %1$s, if you weren't on fire inside.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.tail_explai: That explains a great deal. I'll stop hiding behind the well whenever you pass, %1$s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.not_tod: They already turned your hand down today.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.ruler: Rulers don't shake hands. Seek an audience instead.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.village: They shake your hand and tell you their name: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.greet.waved: They give you a wave instead.
I am %s %s, and %3$s is mine to rule.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.name_refuse: My name is none of your business.
message.jaymoskingdoms.introduce.none: Look at the player you want to introduce yourself to.
message.jaymoskingdoms.introduce.masked: Not behind a mask: that would give your face away.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.offered: You hold out your hand to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.handshake.offer: %s holds out a hand. Use on them to shake it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.group.none: You're in no party. Shake hands with someone to start one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.group.kept: This group is kept by the server.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession.villag: %s, one of its own people, now rules %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ruler.steps_down: %s steps down from the throne of %s; %s, one of its own people, rules now.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_wrapp: You want to know what's under my belt, %1$s? A tail. Wound round and round, and it stays that way. One look at a full moon with it loose and they say I'd stop being me.
My mother made me swear, the night she showed me how to bind it: never let it out, not for anyone, not under any moon. I've kept that promise every day since.
Warrior blood, %1$s. The kind with a tail. Folk here would run screaming if they saw it, so it stays tied up under my shirt where it belongs.
On full-moon nights I bolt the shutters and don't look up. The tail's bound tight, but the old stories don't say how tight is tight enough.
I was ashamed of it as a child. Now I just keep it wrapped and keep quiet. Strangers don't need to know what my grandfather was.
Cut it off? I've thought about it. But it's part of me, %1$s. So I keep it hidden instead, and I keep indoors when the moon is round.
I don't remember the night it happened, %1$s. Only waking in a field, and everyone looking at me. The tail had come loose. It hasn't since.
There's a broken roof on the east side they still haven't fixed. That was me, they tell me, under the full moon. I bind it twice as tight now.
The moon took me once. Something huge, and red-eyed, and not me. I can't bring myself to cut the tail... but I'm afraid of every full moon.
They say I was taller than the church tower. I believe them. My knuckles were raw for a week and I've no memory of why.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/1: I was born with a tail, %1$s. My parents had it cut the night I was born, so I'd never turn under the moon. I've only the scar to show for it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/2: Lost it in a fight, years back. A blade meant for my neck took the tail instead. It never grew back, and honestly, I sleep better for it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/3: Warrior blood, they call it. I had the tail once. The village elder took it off with a woodsman's axe after... well. After there was a rampage. Nobody speaks of it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/4: My father cut his own off before I was born, and mine the day I could walk. He said our family had done enough damage under full moons.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/5: There's just a stump now, %1$s. Some of my kin's grows back, they say. Mine never has. I stopped waiting for it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut/6: The healer who birthed me cut it off without asking anyone. My mother cried for a week. I'm glad she did it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_cut_r: I turned, %1$s. Under the full moon, the tail came loose and I became... that. Somebody brought me down and cut it off. It's never coming back, and I'm glad.
You've heard about the ape, haven't you? That was me. They cut the tail off me while I lay there in the mud, and I woke up small again.
I still dream of the moon that night. Whoever took my tail saved this whole village. If you know who it was, tell them I said thank you.
No more tail, no more moon-madness. It cost me a rampage and half the market square to learn I should have cut it long ago.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_stone: Stone in the blood, my grandmother said. I feel the hills under my feet when I walk. Slow, but steady.
My hands glitter purple in the dark sometimes, %1$s. Don't stare, it's only the stone in me.
My people were miners before there were names for them. I'd still rather sleep underground than under the sky.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_tideb: Tideborn, %1$s. I can hold my breath longer than you'd believe. The gills help.
My father came up out of the sea, or so my mother tells it. I've never quite felt dry since.
The marks on my arms glow when I'm wet. Fishermen think it's luck. I don't tell them otherwise.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_sylva: Sylvan blood. The fireflies follow me about. I've learned to stop shooing them.
The old forest folk were my ancestors. I fall soft and walk quiet, %1$s, but I'm no use in a fistfight.
See this vine on my arm? Born with it. It glows a little at night, like the woods remember me.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_verda: Yes, I'm green, %1$s. And yes, the antennae are real. My people come from very far away.
A sunny day fills me up better than bread. Fire, though... fire I stay well clear of.
My kind came from a green world, once. I've never seen it. Some nights I think I hear it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_ember: Emberborn. Fire doesn't touch me, %1$s. Winter, though, winter takes it out of me.
I once pulled a child out of a burning barn. Not a burn on me. The cold that night nearly killed me instead.
See the glow in my eyes? My mother had it too. Our blood runs hot.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_frost: Frostborn, %1$s. The cold never bites me. The heat, though, the heat I can't abide.
My grandparents came down from the ice. I still sleep with the window open in midwinter.
Snow falls off my hands even in summer. Children think it's a trick. It isn't.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_night: Nightborn. I'm quicker after dark, %1$s. Midday leaves me feeling half-asleep.
My eyes shine silver by day. Folk find it unsettling. I find the sun unsettling, so we're even.
The stars are in my blood, my father said. I believe him on the darkest nights.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_storm: Stormborn, %1$s. When the thunder rolls in, I feel it in my teeth.
My grandmother was struck by lightning twice. She called it being kissed by the sky.
Don't ask me to go down the mine. I can't breathe without the sky over me.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_dawnb: Dawnborn. Give me a long summer day, %1$s, and I'll outwork anyone here.
The dead don't like us. They know the sun is on our side.
Nights are long for my kind. I count the hours till dawn.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_endbo: Endborn, %1$s. My mother came back from somewhere she never spoke of, and I was born after.
I keep a roof over my head when it rains. You'll understand if you ever see my skin after a storm.
The tall dark ones never mind me staring. I think they know what I am.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_drago: Dragonblood. Yes, %1$s, the scales are real. No, you may not touch them.
I sleep better with a bit of gold under the pillow. Don't laugh.
Fire's never scared me. My father used to warm his hands in the forge.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_deepb: Deepborn, %1$s. I can hear you breathing from the next room. Sorry, it's not polite.
Fireworks at the festival? I'll be in the cellar, thanks.
My people came up from the deep dark. Something down there still listens for us.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_earth: Earthling, %1$s. Nothing strange in my blood, but I learn fast. Show me something once and I've got it.
My family trained with the martial masters, generations back. I still wrap my hands out of habit.
Plain blood, quick hands. My grandfather said that's how our people kept up with the stranger ones.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.7: Look at %s's eyes! They've gone black!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.8: That's not %s talking, it's the black stuff!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.fear.host.10: Somebody help %s! No, don't go near!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.6: The crows are all roosting early. They know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.7: Red sky at night, nobody's delight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.8: I'll be sleeping with my boots on tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.9: Smells like iron out here. Like blood.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.10: Don't go past the graveyard. Not tonight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blood.11: The old ones are stirring under the hill.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.super_blood: It looks close enough to touch. Don't.
Even the guards are scared, and they're never scared.
This is the night the stories warned about.
The well water's gone red. I'm not imagining it.
Hold your loved ones close. Hold them tight.
Every dog in the realm is howling.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.6: Pumpkins'll be the size of carts by morning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.7: Good night for a dance in the barn.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.8: My old knees feel younger under that moon.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.9: Look at the fields shine gold!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.10: The bees are still out. In the dark! Busy little things.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.harvest.11: They say a child born under the harvest moon never goes hungry.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.7: I won three games of dice tonight. Three!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.9: Even the creepers look a bit friendly tonight. A bit.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.10: The water's gone blue as a sapphire.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.moon.blue.11: Something lucky's going to happen. I can feel it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.6: Oh, it's you. Don't step on the flowerbeds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.7: Morning! Or... whatever you are this morning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.8: Same person, new face. We're used to it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.9: Could you be the big stone one? The kids love that one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.10: Just let us know before you turn into something with fangs.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.alien.11: Thank you for not eating anyone. Again.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.6: Hello again. And hello to your... friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.7: Keep it on a leash, please. My goats.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.8: I suppose it keeps you warm, at least.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.9: Tell it the butcher's got scraps if it's hungry. Not us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.symbiote.1: You look like a walking puddle of ink. A friendly one.
We know, we know. It's just you. Still shiver, though.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.6: Evening, shadow. Keep to the dark bits, you'll scare the cattle.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.7: It's only them. Their shadow, anyway.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.8: Back from the dead again? You're making a habit of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.9: Do shadows eat? I've got soup if you want it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.10: Come by in daylight next time. We miss your face.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.odd.known.shade.11: Our very own ghost. Lucky us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.6: A shepherd %s blocks %s of here lost half his flock to a falling rock.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.7: The rock that fell %s blocks %s of here was still glowing at dawn.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.8: Merchants won't take the road %s blocks %s of here since the sky-fire.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.9: My nephew swears the rock %s blocks %s of here whispered to him.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.10: You can see the scorch from the hill. %s blocks %s, about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.meteor.11: Some say the rock %s blocks %s of here was thrown. By a person.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.star.6: The star %s blocks %s of here glows green at midnight.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.star.7: A hermit's moved in by the star %s blocks %s of here. Talks to it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.star.8: Treasure hunters are all off %s blocks %s, after that star.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.star.9: A girl touched the star %s blocks %s of here and her hair stood on end for a day.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.star.10: They say there's something inside the star %s blocks %s of here. Waiting.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.star.11: Two stars in one month? One came down %s blocks %s of here.
Hunters %s blocks %s of here found a puddle of black that crawled away.
Don't drink from the stream %s blocks %s of here. Something black's been in it.
A wolf %s blocks %s of here went black and came back wrong.
The black thing %s blocks %s of here. It ate a cow whole. Bones and all.
My cousin %s blocks %s of here sleeps with a torch lit now.
They say it picks a person and wears them. %s blocks %s of here, last.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.shade.6: A shadow was seen walking on water, %s blocks %s of here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.shade.7: %s blocks %s of here, the shadows are longer than they ought to be.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.shade.8: Somebody's own shadow walked off without them, %s blocks %s of here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.shade.9: The watch %s blocks %s of here put out double torches.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.shade.10: Gravediggers %s blocks %s of here say a shade sat on a headstone, watching.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.shade.11: %s blocks %s, folk whisper of a dead man walking in the dark.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.6: They say %s is touched by the gods. Or worse.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.7: I wouldn't want to owe %s money.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.8: %s helped the miller, they say. Mostly helped.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.9: Children play at being %s now. Little terrors.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.10: %s came through and nothing's been the same since.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.11: If you see %s, be polite. Very polite.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.win: %s stopped a storm dead, they say. Then started a smaller one.
Kites don't need string when %s is about.
%s blew the fire out at the bakery. And the baker's eyebrows.
They say %s can hear things on the wind. Watch what you say.
%s ran across the lake. Across it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.web: %s pulled a drowning man out of the river with a web from the bridge.
Every chimney in town has a little web on it now. %s.
They say %s hangs from the clocktower to sleep. Like a bat.
%s strung up three bandits by the ankles, upside down.
My daughter climbs everything since she saw %s.
Spiders follow %s about, they say. Little ones.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.gra: %s stood on the ceiling of the mead hall. For a bet.
They say %s can crush a man just by looking down at him.
Birds fall out of the sky round %s. Gently, mind.
%s held up a collapsing barn while everyone got out.
My scales are wrong since %s passed by.
%s jumped off a cliff and fell up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.chr: %s answered my question before I asked it.
Old Bertram says %s made him young for a moment.
%s was never there and was always there. I don't understand it either.
They say %s has seen tomorrow. Didn't like it.
%s caught an arrow before it was loosed.
My bread rises twice as fast when %s is in town.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.ars: %s carries no blade, yet I saw a hundred.
They say the king's smith wept when he saw %s's swords.
%s duelled six men at once with six swords at once.
Never challenge %s to a fight. Never.
%s summoned a cannon to knock a door down. Could've knocked.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.res: %s sang a note and the bandits dropped their swords.
The church bell rings by itself whenever %s is near.
They say %s can hear your heartbeat from across a field.
%s cracked a boulder with a hum.
My baby stops crying when %s hums. Strangest thing.
%s whistled and every window in the street shattered.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.dar: %s doesn't cast a shadow. Or the shadow doesn't follow them.
They say %s can walk through the dark like a door.
Candles gutter when %s passes. Every time.
My grandmother crossed herself when she saw %s.
%s came back from the dead. As a shadow. Then as themselves again.
The night belongs to %s. Ask anyone who's been out in it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.xen: %s became a dragon. A small one. Still a dragon.
They say %s was a living fire one day and a ghost the next.
%s's band fell from the stars. Folk saw it fall.
Don't play cards with %s. Can't read the face. Faces.
%s turned into a giant and carried a cart up a hill.
Nobody knows what %s really looks like any more.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.1: %s's eyes! Look at their eyes, they're red!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.3: That's not %s, not any more! Bar the doors!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.4: %s's got teeth like a wolf! Get inside!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.5: It was %s all along! It was them the whole time!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.7: Don't let %s bite you! Don't let them near!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.8: I knew %s never ate supper with us. I knew it!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.cry.10: %s just bit someone! I saw it!
key.jaymoskingdoms.frost_prison: Warrior-born: Wrap or Let Out the Tail
message.jaymoskingdoms.frost_prison.wait: The frost in you needs time to gather again (about %s min).
message.jaymoskingdoms.frost_prison.none: Look at something living to lock it in ice.
message.jaymoskingdoms.frost_prison.big: That is too big to lock in ice.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.turned: You wake with a thirst no water will touch. The light stings your eyes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.cure.done: The priest's prayer burns through you, and then it's gone. You're yourself again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.ritual: The fires gutter. Something in the moonlight looks back at you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.moon: The moon holds you. There's no changing back tonight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.unmaster: The wolf won't come at your call. Not yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.wolfbloo: The fires gutter, but the moon isn't full. Only half the wolf comes into you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.half: Your wolfblood can't change you. Only a full moon could finish the rite.
message.jaymoskingdoms.werewolf.den: You come to in the dark, curled in earth that smells of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.turned_ha: You wake with a thirst, but the gold in your blood holds it back. Half of you is still yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.crypt: You wake on cold stone in a crypt you've never seen. It feels like home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.vampire.gold: The gold burns going down. Something in your blood fights back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.warrior_zenkai: You came back from the brink stronger: an attribute point is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.earthling_surge: Your ki flares on the brink: %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.fever: Your blood is racing toward something.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.old_blo: It came easily, as if your blood had only been waiting to be asked.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.born_dh: The gold held the thirst back. The night it couldn't hold back at all.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.trace_e: The rite is done, but the dark still opens to your eyes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.trace_s: The rite is done, but something in your blood still listens for them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.whisper: %s leans close, voice low: "The night is in you already, child of the dark. Let me finish what it began."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.accepted: The teeth are gentle. The cold that follows is not.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.refused: "Another night, then." He steps back into the dark.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.walked: You feel eyes on your back, but nothing follows.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightkin.no_offer: No one is waiting on your answer.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.bloodle: Get your teeth off them, you monster! Guards!
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cure.vampire.title: The Old Rite: Blood for Blood
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cure.vampire.text: I see the hunger in you, child; you can't hide it from me. There is an old rite that can still draw it out, but the night must pay for it first. Hunt down %s of the %s that walk among us, and come back to me. Then we'll pray, and you'll be yourself again.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cure.wolf.title: The Old Rite: The Wolf's Price
quest.jaymoskingdoms.cure.wolf.text: The moon has its claws in you. I know the rite that can break its hold, but the curse wants a life in return. Slay %s of the %s, one of the cursed in its beast shape, and come back to me. Then the moon will lose its grip on you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bed_rest: You lie down to rest. Poison and withering can't hurt you here.
ship.jaymoskingdoms.too_big: Too many blocks for one ship (the most is %s): is the hull still tied to the land?
ship.jaymoskingdoms.too_long: Too long for one ship (the most is %s blocks): is the hull still tied to the land?
ship.jaymoskingdoms.land: The hull is joined to the land: cut it free first
ship.jaymoskingdoms.not_afloat: The hull must float free on water to cast off
ship.jaymoskingdoms.too_heavy: She's too heavy to float: lighter blocks, or more dry hull
ship.jaymoskingdoms.no_room: No room to drop anchor here
ship.jaymoskingdoms.left_helm: You left the helm: she drifts, sails furling. Take the wheel and sneak once she lies still to drop anchor

ship.jaymoskingdoms.cannon.not_loaded: She's not loaded: gunpowder, then round shot

ship.jaymoskingdoms.built: She's built and her hold bailed: take the helm to cast off

sign.jaymoskingdoms.road.title: King's Road
commands.jaymoskingdoms.roads.plan: %s roads still to plan; planning the next
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.overworld: Roads can only be charted in the Overworld
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.begun: Charting from this sign. Follow your road to another sign and mark it with the charter (mark this one again to stop)
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.not_here: Your chart doesn't reach this sign: follow the road right up to it
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.short: Too short to chart: a road must run at least %s blocks
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.off_road: Only %s%% of that was on road (paths, gravel, cobble, bricks, planks): it needs %s%%
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.linked: Road charted: %s blocks. Right-click either sign to travel it
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.put_away: You stopped charting (keep the charter in hand while you go)
message.jaymoskingdoms.charter.lost: Your chart lost the road: start again from a sign
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.coach_h: A coach drives you along the road at a gallop. The fare goes to the nearest realm
message.jaymoskingdoms.journey.turned_ba: You turn back and get down. Your %s emeralds are yours again.
You turn back and get down.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.journey.title: On the road
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.telepor: There after a moment's blackout, worn out as if you'd walked it. The fare is lost to the road
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.too_far: Stand by the milestone to travel from it
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.gone: The sign at the other end is gone, and the road with it
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.rest: You're still worn out from the last road: %s s
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.arrived: You travel the road to %s (%s blocks)
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.no_coac: No coachmen work these parts: there's no realm to send one
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.dismoun: Get down first: the coach can't take you mounted
message.jaymoskingdoms.milestone.coach_o: A coach takes you along the road to %s (%s emeralds)
mca.jaymoskingdoms.stranger: They don't know you well enough for that. Only family, those who hired them, or friends of %s hearts.
language.jaymoskingdoms.foreign: They speak %s, which you don't (%s%% learned). Trade and gestures only.
language.jaymoskingdoms.shrugged: %s shrugs and shakes their head. They speak %s (%s%% learned): trade and gestures only.
language.jaymoskingdoms.fluent: You can speak %s now. Its folk will talk with you.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.gift: They press something into your hands and smile.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.greet: They wave and smile: they know you.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.hungry: They rub their belly and point at your pack: they're hungry.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.bargain: They hold up %s %s and count out %s emeralds on their fingers.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.child: They tag you and run off giggling: you're it!
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.warn: They point at the setting sun, then at the houses: get indoors.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.toll: They hold out a hand and tap it: %s emeralds to pass.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.bout: They raise their fists and flash %s emeralds: a bout, for a wager.
language.jaymoskingdoms.command.unknown: No such tongue (common, northern, southern, wildwood, blossom).
language.jaymoskingdoms.native: You sound born to %s now. Nobody hears an accent any more.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.halting.0: Ha! You try to speak like us? Slow... slow. Good, %s.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.halting.1: You say the words like a little child, %s. Is good! Again!
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.halting.2: No, no, not 'fish'. You just called my mother a fish. Try again.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.halting.3: You learn our words? Brave. Very... brave. Keep going, %s.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.broken.0: You're getting there, %s, though you mangle every other word.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.broken.1: I understood almost half of that. That's an improvement!
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.broken.2: Your grammar's a crime, %s, but the guards won't arrest you for it. Yet.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.broken.3: Not bad! You sound like my grandfather after the harvest ale.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.thick.0: You speak it well now, %s. Where's that accent from? It's charming.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.thick.1: Every word right, but you roll them like a stranger. The children copy you, you know.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.thick.2: I can always tell when it's you, %s. Nobody else here says it like that.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.thick.3: Fluent, yes, but you still sound like you've a mouthful of bread.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.slight.0: Your accent's nearly gone, %s. Only the old folk would notice now.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.slight.1: If I closed my eyes I'd think you grew up two villages over.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.slight.2: There's just a touch of somewhere else when you speak, %s. I'll miss it when it's gone.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.slight.3: You even swear like one of us now. My mother would be appalled.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.native.0: %s, you sound like you were born here. Were you, and nobody told me?
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.native.1: Not a trace of an accent left. You're one of us now, %s.
language.jaymoskingdoms.accent.native.2: I told my cousin you were a foreigner and he didn't believe me. Well done, %s.
item.jaymoskingdoms.pirate_chart.lore: X marks where she went down. Sail there and look below.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.pirate: The pirate ship %s has gone down, sunk by %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.navy: The warship %s has gone down, sunk by %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.merchan: The merchantman %s has gone down, sunk by %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.ship.sunk.whaler: The whaler %s has gone down, sunk by %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.raid.announce.pir: Sails on the horizon! The pirates of %s are coming ashore at %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.pirate_cove.clear: The pirate captain of %s has fallen to %s! The cove's pirates scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pirate_cove.thank: Word of the captain's death spreads along the coast: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.escort.sailing: %s weighs anchor for %s. Sail with her and keep the pirates off her.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.escort.arrived: %s is safe in harbour at %s. Go back to the king for your reward.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.escort.lost: %s has gone down. The escort has failed.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.pirate.title: The Pirates of %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.pirate.text: Pirates out of %1$s burn my coast and take my ships. Their cove is at %2$s, %3$s, and their captain sails from it. Kill him, or send his ship to the bottom with him aboard. Take a ship with guns: he will not come ashore to die.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.escort.title: Safe Passage to %1$s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.escort.text: A merchantman of mine is loaded for %1$s's harbour, at %2$s, %3$s, and the pirates are thick on the water. Come down to my harbour and she'll sail with you. See her safely in.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.escort: Go to %s's harbour: a merchantman sails for %s with you (%s, %s).
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.escorting: Keep the merchantman from %s safe until she reaches %s (%s, %s).
ship.jaymoskingdoms.crew.helm_held: Her captain has the helm. Kill him first.
ship.jaymoskingdoms.crew.hold_guarded: Her crew still guard the hold.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.pirate.cry_4: Take the gold, sink the rest!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.strafe_0: Can't get a bead on him from here. Moving!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.strafe_1: He keeps dodging. Let me shift.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.strafe_3: Missing every time. Changing my footing.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.seek_sight_: I've no clear shot. Finding a better spot.
Wall's in the way. I'll find a window!
Can't see him. Getting a line.
Hold on, I need a clear view.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.close_in_0: Too far to hit anything. Closing in!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.close_in_1: Getting closer. These shots are wasted.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.close_in_3: Forward! I can't hit him from here.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.back_off_1: Backing off for a proper shot.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.flank_1: I'll come at him from the flank.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.cover_1: Wait in the shadows. Then strike.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.ranged.cover_3: Down. Let him wonder where I went.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.skills.hover: Point at a perk to read it in full; press one to learn it.
journal.jaymoskingdoms.sub.map: The land about you, %s blocks across
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stable.hover: Point at a row to read it in full.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival: Bells ring in %s: a festival today at the square! All are welcome.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_welcome: The folk of %s welcome you to their festival.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_lords: Only a lord of a realm, or its ruler, can call a festival.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_soon: Your realm held a festival lately; another can be called %s days after it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_war: No festivals while the realm is at war.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_cost: A festival costs the treasury %s emeralds, and it hasn't got them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_called_t: %s keeps a festival today (%s emeralds from the treasury).
message.jaymoskingdoms.festival_called: %s will keep a festival tomorrow (%s emeralds from the treasury).
festival.jaymoskingdoms.feast.1: A feast fit for the king!
festival.jaymoskingdoms.feast.2: I'll be full till next festival.
festival.jaymoskingdoms.music.2: Request? No? Then I'll play my own.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.adopt.0: Well, hello! You're coming home with me.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.adopt.1: Look at you! You'll want a name.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.adopt.2: Have you no one? You do now.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.adopt.3: There's a good beast. Come along.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.cat.1: Don't you dare sit on my bread again.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.cat.3: You've caught another mouse, haven't you.
pet.jaymoskingdoms.dog.2: Yes, yes, I missed you too.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_empty: Hold what you want delivered in your hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_far: They're too far away for anyone to take it to them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_nobody: There's nobody about free to run an errand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.courier_refused: The folk of %s won't run errands for you.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.missed.1: No sign of them. Back it goes.
spirits.jaymoskingdoms.hungry.3: Someone ought to bring in food.
spirits.jaymoskingdoms.waking.3: Where did I leave my boots?
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.raise: Press to put a point in it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.blocked.points: No attribute points left: level a pillar.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.hint: Your character level is Survival, Stealth and Strength added up. Every %s levels earns an attribute point. A respec gives them back with your perks.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.stats.legend: Pips: teal from your heritage, gold from your class, white your own. Hearts come from eating well, not from here.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.might.desc: Every blow lands harder, whatever is in your hand.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.endurance.desc: Hunger drains slower, whatever you are doing.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.grit.desc: Tougher hide and a firmer stance: armour, and blows push you back less.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.wits.desc: You learn quicker: every pillar earns more experience. A little luck with loot and fishing too.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.title: Heritage
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.picked: Your heritage, once you choose it. It's for life.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.press: Press it on the left to pick it
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.lead: Your heritage gives free attribute points (see K, Attributes), a gift and a flaw. Your class comes next.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.one.1: Did you know there's a %2$s living among us? Keeps to themselves, mostly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.one.2: We've a %2$s in town now. The children won't stop staring.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.one.3: That %2$s down the lane? Kind enough. Strange ways, though.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.one.4: Only one %2$s here, and everyone has an opinion about them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.many.1: There are %3$s %2$s living here now. It's not the place it was, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.many.2: %3$s of the %2$s, right here among us. They keep to their own.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.many.3: The %2$s are settling in. %3$s of them now, and more coming, I'd wager.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.mixed.1: Heartlanders, Earthlings, %2$s, even %3$s. Quite the mix we've become.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.mixed.2: A %2$s and a %3$s under the same banner. My grandmother wouldn't believe it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.mixed.3: Between the %2$s and the %3$s, the market's never been so loud.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.plain.1: Heartlanders and Earthlings, all of us here. Plain folk, and glad of it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.plain.2: Never met anyone of the old bloods. Not round here, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.neighbours.plain.3: They say there are Frostborn and Tideborn out in the wide world. Never seen one myself.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.heartlander.gift: Gift: two attribute points to put where you like
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.heartlander.desc: Plain folk of the river valleys and the farmland. Nothing in your blood marks you out, so you can become anything.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stoneborn.desc: Raised under the mountains among picks and lanterns. Stone gives way to you, but you were never built for running.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn.gift: Gift: long breath, strong swimming, quick mining under water, and blows 15% harder while you're wet
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn.flaw: Flaw: two minutes out of water and you dry out; then hunger drains 20% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn.desc: Sea folk from the coves and reefs. The water is home; dry land wears you down until rain or a swim brings you back.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan.gift: Gift: falls hurt from higher up, and when you sneak, witnesses spot your thieving from less far
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan.desc: Light-footed woodland kin. You drop from branches without a sound, but you were never one for brute force.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.verdant.gift: Gift: green skin and antennae; you heal on your own, set broken bones, regrow lost limbs; hunger drains 35% slower in the sun; as a Z Fighter, Giant forms and healing others
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.verdant.desc: Of the Verdant blood, like the folk of the Verdant World. The sun feeds you, and fire is your oldest enemy.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn.gift: Gift: fire, lava and burning never hurt you; hunger drains slower in hot lands; Kindle: hold left mouse bare-handed for a gush of flame from your palm, and let go at full heat to throw a fireball
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn.flaw: Flaw: the cold (snowy lands, freezing) saps you: 15% weaker blows, 10% slower (twice that when freezing), and hunger drains 25% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn.desc: Born of the badlands, the deserts and the burning places. Flame and lava cannot touch you, but the frost saps your strength and starves you.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn.gift: Gift: you never freeze; hunger drains slower in the cold; as a Z Fighter, forms that cost no ki to hold
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn.flaw: Flaw: hunger drains 25% faster in hot lands
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn.desc: Highlanders of the snowfields and the peaks. Powder snow can't touch you, and the heat wears you thin.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.gift: Gift: in the dark you hit 10% harder and move 5% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.flaw: Flaw: under the open sun you hit 10% lighter
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn.desc: Your mother's people kept to the night. You come alive after dusk and in deep places, and the daylight dulls you.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.warriorborn.gift: Gift: a tail; below half health your blows land harder the more you bleed (10% to 35%) and you stand your ground; as a Z Fighter, the Great Ape and double growth from defeat; survive near death and gain an attribute point (once every 5 minutes)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.warriorborn.flaw: Flaw: you start far weaker than anyone; hunger drains 20% faster, always
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.earthling.gift: Gift: the skill tree learns 25% faster; as a Z Fighter, Training Points 25% faster and a cheaper Limit Break; near death, your ki flares with a random buff for 5 minutes
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.earthling.desc: Plain human blood that makes up for it in grit. Earthlings are born to train: whatever you set your hand to, you learn it fast.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.warriorborn.desc: Of an old fighting blood that came down from the stars. You fight hardest when you're losing, and you're never full for long.
message.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.unlocked: Something old stirs in your blood: %s. Your children may be born to it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.rite_cru: The rite crumbles to dust. Blood isn't changed by rites any more: it runs on in your children.
message.jaymoskingdoms.elder.set_off: %s has packed a bag and set off for %s, to see it again while the legs still carry them. Don't wait up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.elder.home: %s is home again from %s, tired and full of stories.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.gone: Your child isn't by you any more. The moment passes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.lives_on: You open your eyes as your child, %2$s in your veins. %1$s lives on, grey now, and you will need a calling of your own.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.earned_desc: Not every blood is born. Some sleep until the world wakes them. Wake this one and your children may be born to it.
The plain folk of the heartlands, as they have always been.
Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.sunfreckled.desc: Freckled and sun-browned from a life in the open fields and savannas. Their skin runs warmer than other Heartlanders'.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.skymarked.desc: Born in sight of a Highfield monolith. A pale swirl like a cloud marks one forearm and glows faintly by day; the old folk say the Aether's sky-meadows left it there.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.skymarked.trait: Trait: falls 1 block further without harm
variant.jaymoskingdoms.stoneborn_base.de: The mountain folk, grey-skinned like the stone they mine, with amethyst in the cracks of their hands.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.stoneborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.obsidian.desc: Born deep, where lava meets the water. Their skin set hard and black-violet as obsidian, and it weeps the same purple tears. Extremely hardy.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.obsidian.trait: Trait: +3 armour and 20% knockback resistance, 4% slower
variant.jaymoskingdoms.magmavein.desc: Stone and ember in one: a Stoneborn line with Emberborn blood. Their basalt-dark skin is cracked with glowing magma that drips when they are dry.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.magmavein.trait: Trait: burns 60% shorter, blows land 4% harder
variant.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn_base.des: The fishfolk of the coasts and rivers, finned and gilled, lit like the deep-sea lights.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.tideborn_base.tra: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.reefcrowned.desc: From the warm seas. Coral grows in crusts over their forearms and their fins blush coral-pink.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.abyssal.desc: From the deepest water, with Deepborn blood in them: dusky blue skin, pale lure-lights and eyes that never needed the sun.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.abyssal.trait: Trait: holds their breath even longer
variant.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan_base.desc: The forest folk, a glowing vine wound round each arm.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.sylvan_base.trait: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.thornrose.desc: Sylvans of the flower meadows. Briars bristle up their arms and red roses bloom at the wrist. Whoever strikes one up close comes away bleeding.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.thornrose.trait: Trait: melee attackers are pricked for half a heart
variant.jaymoskingdoms.blossomkin.desc: Born under the blossom trees near the Highfield monoliths, where the Aether's sky-meadows fell. Pale petals drift off them wherever they walk, and they land as lightly.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.blossomkin.trait: Trait: falls 2 blocks further without harm
variant.jaymoskingdoms.verdant_base.desc: The green folk of the Verdant World, antennae and all.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.verdant_base.trai: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.glowcap.desc: Verdants who grew up beside an Irradiated monolith. The Ambrosium sickness on the air turned their green yellow and their patches glow like it.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.mosshide.desc: A deep-jungle line with Sylvan blood: darker, olive green, moss and lichen grown over the hands.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn_base.de: Fire under the skin of the hands, ember-gold eyes.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.emberborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.soulflame.desc: Born in the Nether's soul valleys, where fire burns blue. Their embers and their eyes are soul-fire cyan.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.ashen.desc: A fire that met frost and banked low: Emberborn with Frostborn blood. Ash-grey skin, cinders that only glow at night, and ash on the wind behind them.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn_base.de: Rime on the fingers, pink patches that glow in the dark.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.frostborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.rimeglass.desc: Born in the shadow of an Arctic monolith. Clear ice crystals have grown into the skin of their forearms, cold blue at the core.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.aurora.desc: Children of the long polar nights. Lines of shifting green and violet light run up their arms, brightest after dark.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn_base.de: Shadow soaking the hands, stars in it.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.nightborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.moonpale.desc: Moon-silver skin and a crescent on each hand. They are seen on the heights more than anywhere, nearer the moon.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.umbral.desc: Shadow that climbs past the elbow and never lifts, with Endborn blood somewhere back in the line. Wisps follow them day and night.
Warrior-born, plain to the eye, the tail wrapped or long cut.
Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.battlescarred.des: A line that has always fought. Old scars cross their forearms and one cheek.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.warpainted.desc: The old warrior clans' ochre stripes, painted on the forearms and the face from childhood.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.earthling_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.ironknuckle.desc: Taped fingers and knuckles hardened to callus by a thousand strikes against posts and stone.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.inkmarked.desc: Dojo tattoos: bands of ink round the forearms, one for each teacher.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn_base.tr: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.lodeborn.desc: Born near a Magnetic monolith. Iron-dark lines run their arms like filings round a lodestone, and their sparks crackle violet.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.galeborn.desc: Sky-swirled from the Highfields, white cloud lines up their arms; wisps of cloud trail them on the heights.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.galeborn.trait: Trait: falls 2 blocks further without harm
variant.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn_base.des: A gold sun-ring on each hand.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn_base.tra: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.twilight.desc: Dawnborn with Nightborn blood: a gold sun on one hand and a silver moon on the other.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.gilded.desc: Gold-leaf flecks over the hands and cheeks, like the badlands' gold. Their eyes catch the light by day.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.endborn_base.trai: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.chorusgrown.desc: Chorus has grown into their hands in pale purple knots. They hum, faintly, when it is quiet.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.voidpale.desc: Grey-lilac skin, black void-specks, dark eyes that glow like the End's sky.
Dark scales on the forearms and one cheek, ember-lit at night.
Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.goldscale.desc: Scales gone gold from generations sleeping on the hoard.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.rimewyrm.desc: Ice-dragon blood, or Frostborn in the line: pale blue scales rimed with frost.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn_base.des: Teal sculk veins up the forearms.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn_base.tra: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.hollow.desc: So long in the deep dark that their colour has gone: ashen skin, white eyes, veins that pulse dim.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.geode.desc: Deepborn with Stoneborn blood: amethyst crystals grow out of the sculk on their knuckles.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.heritage.variants: Born in three looks: %s, %s and %s. Pick this heritage, then press Look to choose.
message.jaymoskingdoms.variant.offer: Every heritage now comes in three looks. Which %s are you? (once, for life)
message.jaymoskingdoms.variant.settled: Your look was settled long ago.
message.jaymoskingdoms.variant.unknown: That isn't one of your heritage's looks.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.title: Progress your bloodline's story?
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.you_become: You will live on as %s, with the %s blood they were born to, and find a calling of your own.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.you_become_pl: You will live on as %s, and find a calling of your own.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.elder: Your old self stays behind, an elder now, and goes on living their own life. You can still ask them along for old times' sake.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.power: Your %s won't come with you. It sleeps in %s's blood and will awaken in them in time.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.lineage.things: Your things: hand them down, or leave them with your elder?
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn.gift: Gift: 12% faster under the open sky; lightning never hurts you, it charges you (Speed II, Strength I); in the rain your blows throw a spark that leaps between two monsters; Thunderclap: hold left mouse bare-handed, let go to call lightning where you look
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn.flaw: Flaw: deep underground (below Y 0) you're 8% slower
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn.desc: Your people live on the high peaks where the storms break. The open sky quickens you, and the deep places weigh you down.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.stormborn.hint: Some say it wakes in those whose wind the storm has taken.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn.gift: Gift: under the open sun you hit 15% harder and heal; your blows bite the undead 30% harder and set them alight by day; Sunflare: hold left mouse bare-handed by day, let go for a flash that burns the undead, blinds mobs and heals friends
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn.flaw: Flaw: in the dark you hit 10% lighter and hunger drains 20% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dawnborn.desc: Children of the open savanna and the long summer days. The sun is your strength, and the Nightborn have never trusted you.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.endborn.gift: Gift: now and then you blink aside from an arrow or anything thrown
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.endborn.flaw: Flaw: water and rain burn you, a little at a time
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.endborn.desc: Something of the End came back with you. Space folds a little when you need it to, and the rain has never been your friend.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.endborn.hint: Some say it wakes in those who watch the dragon of the End fall.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.gift: Gift: fire and dragon's breath do you half harm; the more gold you carry, the harder you hit (up to 15% with a stack of ingots)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.flaw: Flaw: carrying no gold at all, you hit 10% lighter
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.desc: Old dragon blood runs hot in you. Flame is a friend, and like any dragon you are only as strong as your hoard.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.dragonblood.hint: Slay a dragon, or win one over, and the blood may answer.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn.gift: Gift: when you sneak, you sense the creatures round you through stone and walls; sculk never hears you
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn.flaw: Flaw: blasts stun you for a moment; under the open sun you hit 10% lighter
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn.desc: You came up from the deep dark changed. You hear the world through the stone, and loud noise and bright sun are hard to bear.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.deepborn.hint: It waits below, with the Warden. Face it, and come back up.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.0: You put it out! Bless your hands, %1$s!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.1: That would have taken the whole row. Thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.2: Quick thinking! I thought we'd lose the roof.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.3: You ran toward the fire. Who does that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.4: Thank you, thank you! My things were all in there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.5: I'll not forget you beat that out for us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.6: Look at your hands, you're singed! Thank you, friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.7: Fire's out! You've saved more than you know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.8: We'd have been sleeping in ashes tonight. Thank you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.9: There's not many strangers would fight our fire for us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.10: You doused it! Somebody fetch them a drink!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.thanks.11: My heart's still pounding. Thank you for stopping it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.0: There goes %1$s, who put out our fire!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.1: Ho, %1$s! The roof's still standing, thanks to you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.2: That's the one who ran into the smoke for us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.3: %1$s! I still smell the smoke when I see you. In a good way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.5: You're the one who beat the flames out, aren't you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.6: Morning, %1$s. Not a spark since you were last here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.8: The baker says you're welcome at her oven any day, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.9: Every time I see a torch I think of you, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.10: There's the one who saved the row from burning!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.11: Hail, %1$s! We'd be living in cinders but for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.fire.greet.hear: You're %1$s? They say you put out a blaze in %2$s.
Word from %2$s is you fought their fire, %1$s.
Are you the one who doused %2$s's fire? Welcome!
%2$s's folk can't stop talking about you, %1$s.
A traveller said you beat out a fire in %2$s. Was it really you?
If our roofs ever catch, we'll know who to send for. %2$s did!
Heard you saved half of %2$s from burning, %1$s.
You're welcome here, %1$s. %2$s speaks well of you.
Ha! The fire-fighter of %2$s, here in our street!
My cousin in %2$s says you ran straight into the smoke.
They say in %2$s you put out what their own couldn't.
%1$s, is it? The one %2$s owes its roofs to?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.0: You saved my life! I... thank you, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.1: I thought that was the end of me. Thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.2: It had me, it really had me. You came just in time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.3: Thank you! I'll owe you for the rest of my days.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.4: You stood between me and that thing. Who are you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.5: My legs are still shaking. Thank you, friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.6: I'd be dead on the ground if not for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.7: Bless you! I'll tell my children about this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.8: You didn't have to do that. Thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.9: I owe you my life, %1$s. Don't think I'll forget.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.10: Gods, that was close. You're a hero, you know that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.thanks.11: Thank you! I couldn't run, I just couldn't run.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.0: Did you see that? They cut it down!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.2: They saved them! Right in front of us!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.4: Ha! That'll teach it to come here!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.6: I saw it all! The beast never stood a chance!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.7: That's how it's done! Thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.9: Someone ring the bell, we've got a hero!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.10: Brave, that one. Brave and quick.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.cheer.11: Bless you, %1$s! You saved one of ours!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.0: There's %1$s, who saved one of ours!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.1: Ho, %1$s! We're still talking about how you fought that thing off.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.2: That's the one who stood up for us when it mattered.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.3: Welcome back, %1$s. You're always welcome here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.4: The one you saved told everyone, %1$s. Everyone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.6: Morning, %1$s. Safer streets with you about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.7: %1$s! My neighbour lives because of you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.8: There goes the one with the quick blade and the kind heart.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.9: I'd buy you a drink if I had a coin, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.10: Children, that's %1$s. They saved someone's life here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.11: Keep coming back, %1$s. The monsters don't like it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.save.greet.hear: You're %1$s? They say you saved a life in %2$s.
Word from %2$s is you cut down something that had one of theirs.
Is it true you saved someone in %2$s, %1$s?
%2$s says you're a hero. Are you?
A peddler from %2$s told us what you did. Welcome.
You're welcome here, %1$s, after what you did for %2$s.
My aunt in %2$s says she saw you fight off a beast.
They sang about you in %2$s, %1$s. Badly, but they sang.
Heard of you from %2$s. Stand by us as you stood by them?
So you're the one %2$s keeps going on about.
%2$s owes you a life, they say. We'd be honoured to know you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.1: Get me out of these chains, I beg you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.2: Over here! Please! They'll be back!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.3: I want to go home. Please, let me go home.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.5: Please, cut me loose! I'll pay you, I swear!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.6: Is someone there? Please don't leave me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.7: They took me from my village. Help me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.8: My family must think I'm dead. Please!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.9: These chains... I can't feel my hands. Help!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.10: You're not one of them. Please, free me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.plead.11: Days... I've been here days. Help me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.0: I'm free! Oh thank you, thank you! Take me home?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.1: You came for me! Please, lead me home, I'll stay close.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.2: The chains are off! I'll follow you anywhere out of here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.3: Thank you! Let's go before they come back!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.4: I thought no one would ever come. Take me home, please.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.5: Free! Stay near me, I don't know the way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.6: Bless you! I'll be right behind you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.7: I can walk! I can actually walk! Lead the way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.8: Get me home and my family will thank you properly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.9: Don't go too fast, my legs are weak. But let's go!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.10: You broke them! Thank you! Home, please, home.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.freed.11: I'll never forget this, %1$s. Lead on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.0: Home! I'm home! Thank you, %1$s! Here, take this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.1: I never thought I'd see these streets again. This is for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.2: My family's going to cry. Thank you, take this, please.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.3: Home at last. You've given me my life back. Here.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.4: Smell that? That's home. Thank you, friend. For you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.5: I'll tell everyone what you did. Take this, it's all we can spare.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.6: Look, there's my house! Thank you! This is yours.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.7: Safe! I'm safe! Take this, please, I insist.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.8: You brought me all this way. Here, a little something.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.9: Mother! Mother, I'm back! Thank you, %1$s, take this!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.10: I'd given up. You didn't. Please, take this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.home.11: We'll drink to your name tonight, %1$s. Here, for your trouble.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.0: %1$s! You brought them back to us! Thank you, thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.1: That's my child you've brought home. Whatever you need, you ask.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.2: I'd lit a candle every night. Bless you, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.3: My brother! Oh, you found my brother! I owe you everything.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.4: We'd sold half the house to pay for searchers. You did it for nothing.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.5: Come in, eat with us, %1$s. You're family now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.6: I can't stop shaking. Thank you. Thank you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.7: They told us to give up. I'm glad you didn't listen.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.8: My wife! You brought her home! I'll never forget your face, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.9: Whatever we have is yours. You gave us back our own.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.family.1: I'll name my next child after you, %1$s. I mean it.
Home and whole. You've no idea what this means to us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.cheer.0: They've brought them back! They're alive!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.cheer.3: We thought they were dead! Bless you, %1$s!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.cheer.4: Someone fetch the family! They're back!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.cheer.6: Out of the chains and home again! Thank you!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.cheer.7: Look who's home! Look who brought them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.cheer.8: I'll ring the bell myself! They're back!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.cheer.9: Gods be thanked, and you too, %1$s!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.cheer.10: Welcome home! And welcome to you, rescuer!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.cheer.11: We'll not forget this, %1$s. Not ever.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.0: There's %1$s, who brought one of ours home!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.1: Hail, %1$s! The family you reunited sends their love.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.2: That's the one who broke the chains!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.4: %1$s! The one you brought home is fattening up nicely.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.5: We still talk about the day you came back with them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.6: Hail, %1$s! You walked into their camp for us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.7: Children, that's the one who brought our neighbour home.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.8: There's a bed and a meal for you here any time, %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.10: The one who came back from the camp with a captive in tow!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.11: Bless you, %1$s. We'd given up hope.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.deed.rescue.greet.he: You're %1$s? They say you freed one of %2$s's from chains.
Word from %2$s is you walked one of theirs home from captivity.
Are you the one who rescued someone for %2$s?
%2$s says you broke a captive's chains. Welcome!
A traveller told us you brought someone home to %2$s.
The rescuer of %2$s! We've heard all about you.
My friend in %2$s says you're the bravest soul alive, %1$s.
If they ever take one of ours, we'll come looking for you, %1$s.
You're welcome here. Anyone who did what you did for %2$s is.
%1$s, who freed a captive for %2$s? It's an honour.
%2$s's folk named a toast after you, %1$s.
So it's true, then. %2$s wasn't lying about you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.0: Did you hear? %1$s put out the fire that nearly took the row.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.1: The smoke still clings to the thatch, but %1$s stopped it spreading.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.2: If it weren't for %1$s, half of us would be homeless.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.3: Everyone's saying %1$s ran into the flames with bare hands.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.4: I saw %1$s beat out the fire myself. Brave, or mad.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.5: The baker's oven caught, and who should come running but %1$s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.6: They say %1$s smelled the smoke from across the fields.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.7: My man says he'd have fought the fire too. He was hiding.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.8: Fire's a terrible thing. We're lucky %1$s was about.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.9: That fire? Out before the bell rang, thanks to %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.10: We ought to give %1$s a bucket of their own.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.11: Little Pip keeps playing firefighter, being %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.fire.hea: They say %1$s put out a great fire in %2$s.
Word from %2$s: %1$s fought their fire and won.
A peddler told me %1$s saved %2$s from burning down.
Heard of %1$s? %2$s would be ashes without them, they say.
My cousin in %2$s watched %1$s beat out the flames.
If our roofs catch, let's hope %1$s is near, like at %2$s.
%2$s had a fire, and %1$s doused it. That's the tale.
They say %1$s went into %2$s's smoke and came out grinning.
%2$s is singing %1$s's praises. Something about a fire.
A carter from %2$s says %1$s has hands like wet blankets.
In %2$s, they say, %1$s outran the flames themselves.
Fire in %2$s, and %1$s put it out. That's what I heard.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.0: %1$s saved one of ours from a beast. Cut it down in the street.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.1: Did you see %1$s fight that thing off? I've never seen the like.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.2: It had them pinned, and then %1$s came out of nowhere.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.3: We owe %1$s a life now. Remember that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.4: My neighbour's alive because of %1$s. She won't stop saying so.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.5: They say %1$s didn't even stop to think. Just charged.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.6: Next time the monsters come, I hope %1$s is near.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.7: %1$s? Good folk. Saved a life here, you know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.8: The children play monsters and %1$s now. Everyone wants to be %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.9: I'd marry %1$s for what they did. My husband would object.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.10: Saw %1$s with my own eyes, sword out, standing over one of ours.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.11: Whatever folk say about strangers, %1$s stood by us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.save.hea: They say %1$s saved a life in %2$s.
Word from %2$s: %1$s cut down a monster that had one of theirs.
A trader from %2$s says %1$s is a true protector.
My aunt in %2$s saw %1$s fight off a beast, bare-handed nearly.
Heard %1$s stood between %2$s's folk and death.
%1$s? The one who saved that poor soul in %2$s?
If %1$s ever comes here, treat them well. Ask %2$s why.
They tell it in %2$s: %1$s came running at the scream.
%2$s says %1$s is welcome at any table. I'd say the same.
A tinker from %2$s won't shut up about %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.0: %1$s walked one of ours home from captivity. Out of chains!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.1: They took them to the camp, and %1$s brought them back.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.2: We'd lit candles for the dead, and %1$s brought them home alive.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.3: Did you hear what %1$s did? Broke the chains and walked them home.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.4: I saw them come up the road, %1$s in front. I wept.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.5: That family's whole again, all thanks to %1$s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.6: %1$s went where none of us would dare. Into their camp.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.7: They say the captors never even saw %1$s coming.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.8: Every mother here would give %1$s her last loaf.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.9: If they take any more of us, it's %1$s we'll be praying for.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.1: %1$s? Brought our neighbour home in one piece. That's who.
I hear the one %1$s rescued won't stop talking about the journey.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.deed.rescue.h: They say %1$s freed one of %2$s's folk from chains.
Word from %2$s: %1$s brought a captive all the way home.
A trader from %2$s says %1$s walked into a camp and out again.
Heard of %1$s? %2$s got one of theirs back because of them.
In %2$s they tell of %1$s breaking a captive's chains.
If they ever take any of us, we'd best send for %1$s, like %2$s did.
My cousin in %2$s says %1$s is fearless.
%2$s had someone taken. %1$s brought them home. That's the tale.
They're toasting %1$s in %2$s. A rescue, I heard.
%1$s? The one who freed %2$s's captive? Brave soul.
A drover from %2$s swears %1$s fought off the whole camp.
%2$s won't forget %1$s, and nor should we.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.freed: %s follows you now. Bring them home to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.freed.now: %s follows you now. Bring them to any settlement and they'll be safe.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.home: %s is home safe in %s. Its people won't forget what you did.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.lost: %s couldn't keep up and makes their own way home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.died: %s was killed before you could get them home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.freed.gua: %s, one of %s's guards, follows you now. Bring them home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.freed.kin: %s, kin of %s's ruler, follows you now. Bring them home: they'll be well rewarded.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.home.guar: %s is back at their post in %s. Its guards won't forget what you did.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.home.kin: %s is home safe in %s. Its ruler's own kin, brought back by you: the whole realm will hear of it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.reward: Their family gave you %s emeralds, and %s paid %s more from its treasury.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.favour: %s owes you a favour now (%s in all): its guards won't toll or search you, and the next arrest is let go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.captive.pardon: %s's guards let it go this once, for the one you brought home. Favours left: %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.hostile: %1$s now counts %2$s an enemy. Its guards will attack that mask on sight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.un: The people of %1$s saw you take off your mask. They know %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.lo: The people of %1$s saw you lower your hood. They know %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.ma: The people of %1$s saw you put on your mask. They know %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.po: The people of %1$s have put two and two together: the same power, the same person. They know %2$s is you now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.li: You lifted your mask (or lowered your hood) for the guard. %1$s knows %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.re: Someone of %1$s got a good look at the face under your hood. They know %2$s is you now, and whatever %2$s did there is yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.known.wo: Word has spread to %1$s: they say %2$s is you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.sent_off: The guards of %1$s won't have a masked stranger in their streets. Get out within %2$s seconds or unmask.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.unmasked.1: I knew it! I knew there was someone under that mask. It's %2$s!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.unmasked.2: So that's who %1$s really is. Wait till the others hear.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.masked.2: Put the mask on all you like, %2$s. I saw your face.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.lowered.0: Wait... %2$s? That was you under the hood? You're %1$s?!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.lowered.1: I knew that walk. Hood down and it's %2$s, plain as day!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.lowered.2: So %1$s is %2$s. Wait till the others hear.
Wait. Under that hood... you're %2$s! I'd know that face anywhere.
A hood doesn't hide much from this close, %2$s. I saw you.
I got a good look at you, hooded one. It's %2$s, isn't it? Everyone will hear of this.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.powers.0: Hold on. %1$s does that very same trick. You're %1$s, aren't you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.powers.1: Only one person I've ever seen can do that... and it's %1$s. So you're %1$s!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.powers.2: Same power, same build, same walk. %1$s, I'd know you anywhere now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.0: Halt, masked one. Nobody walks the streets of %s with their face hidden. Show yourself: lower that hood or take off the mask.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.1: You, in the hood and mask. The king trusts no face he can't see, and neither do I. Take it off.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.2: Stop right there. Masks are for assassins and thieves. Who are you, under that?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.0.more: The king's sure someone means him harm, and a mask is just the way they'd come. Unmask, let me search you, or leave %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.1.more: I've my orders. Every masked stranger in %s shows their face or turns out their pack. Or goes.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.2.more: Nobody hides their face in %s unless they've reason to. Show me yours, or show me your pack, or get out.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.answer.lift: Lift your mask (or lower your hood) for him
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.answer.search: Keep your face hidden, but let him search you
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.reply.lift: %s. Hm. Put it back on if you must. I'll know you now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.reply.lift_tr: %s! I knew that face. Guards! Seize them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.reply.search_: Nothing. Fine, go on. But I'll be watching that mask.
And what's this? Stolen goods! That's %s emeralds' fine, and you're coming with me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.reply.refuse: Then you've no business in %s. Out, before I count to thirty, or we'll drag you out.
language.jaymoskingdoms.gesture.unmask: They point at your mask and make a lifting motion, then at your pack, then at the road out.
command.jaymoskingdoms.identity.realm: %s: reputation %s, wanted for %ss more, known to be %s
command.jaymoskingdoms.identity.unlinked: %s no longer knows who wears your costume.
Nobody knows who wears your costume any more.
command.jaymoskingdoms.identity.forgotte: The world has forgotten your costume, and the powers it saw you use.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.exiled: The ruler of %s has no love for masked vigilantes. You are exiled: its guards will see you out of its streets.
message.jaymoskingdoms.identity.exiled.i: You are an exile in %1$s: they know who wears your costume. Leave within %2$s seconds or the guards will take you by force.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.exiled.0: You! The masked meddler! The king wants your kind gone. Out!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.exiled.1: We know you, %s. No vigilantes here. Be on your way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.exiled.2: Guards! The one who plays the hero in a mask is back!
gui.jaymoskingdoms.tier.title: World Tiers
tier.jaymoskingdoms.hearth.desc: The world as it is. Foes are as nature made them, and so is the loot.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.borderlands.desc: Past the last milestone the roads stop being kept. What lives out there has had to grow hardier.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.wildlands.desc: No king's writ runs here. Raiders wear better steel, beasts hit harder, and what they guard is worth more.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.dread.desc: The land remembers the Wither. Everything that hunts you here has survived worse than you.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.legend.desc: The age of songs. You slew the dragon; now the whole world wants to be the one who slays you.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.effect.none: Foes have no bonuses, and you get no extra rewards.
tier.jaymoskingdoms.effect.luck: You: +%s luck (better chest and fishing loot)
tier.jaymoskingdoms.effect.experience: You: %s more experience from tiered foes
tier.jaymoskingdoms.effect.loot: You: %s chance for each stack of loot to come doubled
message.jaymoskingdoms.tier.unlocked: A harder world tier is open to you: %s. Take it from the skill screen (K), World Tier.
message.jaymoskingdoms.tier.wait: You can change your world tier again in %s seconds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.tier.below_floor: The world has grown too harsh for that: no one plays below %s now.
command.jaymoskingdoms.tier.unlock: Opened world tiers up to %2$s for %1$s player(s).
command.jaymoskingdoms.tier.is: %s is in world tier %s (open up to %s, %s great foes slain).
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.1: Shunned: most folk think a little less of Sylvan blood
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.2: Shunned: most folk look down on Warrior-born blood
