heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.3: Shunned: most folk find Stoneborn blood unnatural (worse prices, slower trust, wary guards)
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.shunned.4: Shunned: most folk think Tideborn barely human (worst prices, slowest trust, wary guards)
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.low.0: Hm. %1$s. Keep an eye on that one.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.low.2: Their kind never did fit in.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.low.4: Wouldn't want my daughter marrying a %1$s.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.0: Gods. A %1$s. Is that even a person?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.1: Hide the children, there's a %1$s about.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.2: Unnatural, that. Should keep to their own.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.3: Look at it. %1$s. Makes my skin crawl.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.high.4: Don't let it touch anything. %1$s filth.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.child.0: Mama, why does that one look like that?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.child.1: Is that a %1$s? Is it true they bite?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.child.3: Papa says not to talk to %1$s folk.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.shrink.2: Excuse me. I'll just... over here.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kind.0: Pay the stares no mind, %2$s. Blood's blood.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kind.1: Folk can be cruel to %1$s. Not me.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kind.2: Good day to you, %2$s. Don't let them sour it.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kind.3: I don't care what you're born. Welcome.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kin.0: Another %1$s. Chin up; they look at me the same.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kin.1: Ah, one of ours. Stick close to friends here, %2$s.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.kin.2: %1$s and proud, eh? Let them stare.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.0: A human. Come to have a laugh at us, have you?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.1: We left your kind behind for a reason.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.2: Keep walking, human. Nobody stares at us here but you.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.3: Huh. See how it feels, being the odd one out?
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.haven.4: Watch that one. Humans never come here for anything good.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival.0: Human. Bet you've laughed at folk like me.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival.1: Hmph. Your lot never let us forget what we are.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival.2: Go on, stare. Everyone else does.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival.3: Humans. Always so sure they're the proper sort.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival_child.0: My mama says humans are mean.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.rival_child.2: Are you gonna laugh at how I look? Everyone does.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.fair.0: Not every human's the same, I suppose. Good day.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.fair.1: You've an honest face, %2$s. For a human.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.fair.2: Pay my kin's scowls no mind. They've had a hard time of it.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.0: Welcome, %2$s. No one stares at you here.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.1: A %1$s! Rest easy. You're among your own sort here.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.2: Tired of the human towns too? Most of us were.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.welcome.3: Stay as long as you like. We look after each other.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.0: My grandmother lived among the humans. Every day the jeering. One spring she packed up and came here, and never went back.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.1: We built this place ourselves. No humans to tell us what we are.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.2: In the human towns they charged us double and called it a kindness. Here a %1$s pays what anyone pays.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.3: They say there's more villages like ours every year. Folk get tired of being laughed at.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.haven.4: Don't bring humans round here, %2$s. We came here to be rid of them.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.nonhuman: Heard of the villages where only our sort live? I think about going, some days.
The humans laugh at us here. Over in the havens, it's the other way round.
Every year a few more of us leave for the havens. Can't say I blame them.
Being a %1$s among humans is a lonely thing, %2$s.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.human.0: Did you hear? There's whole villages now with not one proper human in them.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.human.1: Those non-human villages want nothing to do with us. Good riddance, I say.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.human.2: My cousin went to trade with one of those haven places. They charged him double and stared him out of town.
prejudice.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.human.3: Bad blood between us and the non-humans these days. Mind yourself out on the roads.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.packing.0: Pots, blankets, the good knife... that's the lot.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.packing.1: Hold the horse still, would you? Nearly done.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.packing.2: Twenty years in this place, and it fits on one cart.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.farewell.ridicul: I'm done being stared at. I'm off to %1$s, where folk like me are welcome.
Laugh at someone else now. We're leaving for %1$s.
No more whispers behind my back. %1$s, here we come.
Not the right blood for this king, am I? Fine. We'll go where it is.
Pride's all this realm has. We're off to %1$s.
I'll not be stepped over one more day. Goodbye, %2$s.
Taxes, tolls, and his guards' boots. Enough. We're for %1$s.
The tyrant can rule an empty house. We're going.
Better poor and free in %1$s than here under him.
Every neighbour here's a quarrel waiting. We're off to %1$s.
I'll not share a well with those people another day.
%2$s can keep its feuds. We're starting over.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.farewell.unhappy: Nothing's gone right here. Maybe %1$s will be kinder.
I can't bear this place any more. We're leaving.
A fresh start, that's what we need. %1$s, then.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.farewell.restles: I've always wondered what's past those hills. Off to %1$s!
Itchy feet, my mother called it. Goodbye, %2$s.
We came from %1$s. Folk there never let us forget our blood, so we packed up for %2$s.
In %1$s they stared and whispered every day. Here in %2$s nobody minds what I am, %3$s.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.purist.0: %1$s's king wanted only his own blood. We weren't it, so we left.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.purist.1: They looked down on us in %1$s for how we were born. %2$s is better.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.tyrant.0: We fled %1$s. Its ruler took everything and called it a tax.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.tyrant.1: Life under that tyrant in %1$s? No. %2$s suits us fine.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.grudge.0: Too many feuds back in %1$s. We came to %2$s to start fresh.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.grudge.1: I couldn't stand my neighbours in %1$s, %3$s. Here's quieter.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.unhappy.0: Nothing went right for us in %1$s. %2$s has been kinder.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.unhappy.1: I was miserable in %1$s. Packed the cart one morning and never looked back.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.restless.0: I used to live in %1$s, but I wanted to see more of the world. %2$s is where the road ended.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.restless.1: Born in %1$s, me. Got restless, loaded a cart and came here.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.ridiculed.0: My grandparents left %1$s. The humans there mocked them, so they built a life out here instead.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.ridiculed.1: Our family were laughed out of %1$s generations back. We've kept to ourselves since.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.purist.0: My family weren't the right blood for the lords of %1$s, so they left long ago.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.purist.1: Proud kings, %1$s had. Too proud for the likes of us. That's why we live out here.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.tyrant.0: My grandfather fled %1$s and its cruel lord. No kings out here, and we like it that way.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.tyrant.1: We pay no king's tax out here, %2$s. Our folk left %1$s to be rid of all that.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.grudge.0: Some old feud drove my family from %1$s. Nobody remembers what it was about.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.grudge.1: Our people left %1$s after a falling-out. We've done well enough on our own.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.unhappy.0: Times were hard in %1$s when my parents left. They came out here for a fresh start.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.unhappy.1: Nobody here came from nowhere, %2$s. We all left %1$s one way or another.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.restless.0: My family wandered out of %1$s long ago and liked it out here. No kingdom tells us what to do.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.restless.1: Live away from any kingdom? Our folk left %1$s for the open land, and stayed.
message.jaymoskingdoms.emigrants.ruin: The last peasants have left %s. With no one to rule, it falls into ruin.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.tyrant: Even the tyrant of %s blinks: with the people slipping away, taxes there are cut by %s%%.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.noble: The ruler of %s hears the empty houses: taxes are cut by %s%% and the guards told to go gently.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.warlord: The warlord of %s needs bodies for the levies: taxes are cut by %s%% to keep folk home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.paranoid: Grudgingly, the ruler of %s eases off: taxes down %s%%, fewer searches at the gates.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.reveler: %s throws open its granaries to win its people back: taxes are cut by %s%%.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.purist: The proud ruler of %s softens: taxes down %s%%, and outsiders are to be treated fairly.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.t: The tyrant of %s answers the leavers with a sneer. "Let them go."
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.n: The ruler of %s grieves the families leaving, but the treasury can spare nothing.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.w: The warlord of %s calls the leavers deserters, and changes nothing.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.p: The ruler of %s calls the leavers spies and traitors, and the gates stay watched.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.r: In %s the feasting goes on, whoever packs up and leaves.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.stubborn.p: The ruler of %s says good riddance to those leaving: the realm is purer for it.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reformed.0: Taxes in %s are lighter since so many left. Maybe we'll stay after all.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reformed.1: The guards hardly stop anyone any more. %s's ruler finally noticed the empty houses.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reformed.2: Folk were leaving %s by the cartload. Now things are easier, and the carts have stopped.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.stubborn.0: Half the street's packed up and gone, and %s's ruler won't change a thing.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.stubborn.1: If things don't get better in %s, I'll be loading a cart myself, %s.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.stubborn.2: Every week another family leaves %s. Soon there'll be no one left to rule.
message.jaymoskingdoms.reform.tolerance: %s now forbids mocking folk for their blood. The realm needs every pair of hands it has.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.reformed.3: They say %s is welcoming settlers now. Lighter taxes, fewer tolls. Folk are moving in.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.tolerance.0: There's a decree in %s now: no jeering at folk for their blood. Some still mutter, but quieter.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.tolerance.1: Since the edict in %s, my Tideborn neighbour finally walks to market without the stares.
reform.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.tolerance.2: Took half the non-humans leaving %s for the ruler to put a stop to the mockery.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.caught.guard.0: Halt! Nobody leaves without the ruler's leave. Back to your house.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.caught.guard.1: Unpack that cart. You're going nowhere.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.caught.guard.2: Deserting the realm? Turn around before I make you.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.caught.0: They won't even let us leave...
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.caught.1: Stopped at the gate like criminals. One day we'll get out.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.caught.2: Fine. Fine! We'll unpack. For now.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.farewell.expelle: Driven out for my blood. So be it. %1$s will have us.
The guards gave us till sundown. Goodbye, %2$s.
Not pure enough for this king. We're off to %1$s.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.expelled.0: We didn't leave %1$s. We were thrown out, for the wrong blood. %2$s took us in.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.story.expelled.1: The ruler of %1$s drove out everyone not of the royal blood. We ended up in %2$s, %3$s.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.expelled.0: A proud lord of %1$s once drove out every family not of his blood. Ours among them.
emigrant.jaymoskingdoms.old.expelled.1: Our folk were expelled from %1$s long ago. We made our own place out here, %2$s.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.jeer.0: Ugh. A %1$s. Who let that in?
purist.jaymoskingdoms.jeer.1: Mind your purse, there's a %1$s about.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.jeer.2: You can always tell a %1$s. It's the smell.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.jeer.3: This is a %2$s city, %3$s. Don't forget it.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.jeer.4: Look at it, walking about like it belongs here.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.jeer.5: Go home, %1$s. Oh, that's right. You lot don't have one.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.shoulder.2: %2$s folk walk the middle of the street. Step aside.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.kin.0: One of us! Good to see %1$s blood about, %2$s.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.kin.1: Welcome, kinsman. You're among your own here.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.kin.2: Ah, a true %1$s. Not many of you travellers are.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.kin.3: Stay a while, %2$s. We could use more of our own blood.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.scene.1: Still here, %3$s? Thought your kind would have moved on by now.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.scene.2: Don't you look at me, %1$s. Eyes down.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.scene.3: This is a %2$s street. Go walk somewhere else.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.slink.1: I was born here too, you know.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.proud.kin.0: You're %1$s, like us! Isn't it good to be somewhere they know what that's worth?
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.proud.kin.1: The king says every child born %1$s is a stone in the wall. So go on, settle down here, %3$s.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.proud.kin.2: They're giving the best houses to %1$s families now. About time.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.proud.kin.3: My grandmother was %1$s, and hers, and hers. That's how it should be.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.proud.kin.4: Did you see the guards turn back that cart of outsiders? The king's right. Our blood first.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.proud.outsi: You know you'll never be one of us. No %2$s ever is. Just so you know where you stand.
Nothing personal, %3$s. I just think %1$s folk ought to live with %1$s folk.
The king says there are too many of your kind about already. He's not wrong.
We had a %2$s living down the lane. Moved on, thank the crown.
Buy what you need and go, that's my advice. Prices go up for your kind the longer you stay.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.grumble.0: Psst. You're not %1$s either, are you? Then you know how they look at us here.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.grumble.1: I'm %2$s, born and raised in this city, and they still spit when I pass.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.grumble.2: The guard drafts took every %1$s lad and not one of us. We're not good enough to die for him, even.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.grumble.3: One day this king will be gone, %3$s, and we'll still be here. Remember that.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.gift.0: %1$s! I still have that %2$s you gave me. Thank you again.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.gift.1: I keep thinking of the %2$s you gave me, %1$s. Nobody gives me anything.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.gift.2: Ah, %1$s, the one who brought me %2$s. You're always welcome here.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.trade.0: %1$s! %3$s trades in one day. You're my best customer.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.trade.1: Back again, %1$s? A regular, you are. I'll keep the good stock for you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.trade.2: Business has been better since you started coming by, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.fed.0: I haven't forgotten the food you gave me when I was hungry, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.fed.1: %1$s! You fed me when nobody else would. I owe you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.fed.2: My belly remembers you, %1$s. That meal got me through the week.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.kind.0: You were kind to me the other day, %1$s. It made my morning.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.kind.1: %1$s! Good to see you again. You've a kind word for everyone.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.kind.2: Not many strangers talk to me the way you did, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.stood.0: You swore you'd stand with us against %2$s, %1$s. We're counting on it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.stood.1: %1$s! Still with us against %2$s, I hope?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.stood.2: Folk here remember you took our side against %2$s, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.played.0: %1$s! Will you play with me again? Please?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.played.1: That was the best game ever, %1$s! Again!
recall.jaymoskingdoms.played.2: You're the only grown-up who ever plays with me, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.hugged.0: I liked that hug the other day, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.hugged.1: %1$s! Come here, I could use another hug.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.hugged.2: You give good hugs, %1$s. Don't tell anyone I said so.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.kissed.0: %1$s... I keep thinking about that kiss.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.kissed.1: Oh! %1$s. I... hello. About the other day...
recall.jaymoskingdoms.kissed.2: I haven't stopped smiling since you kissed me, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.rebuffed.0: About when you tried to %2$s, %1$s. Please don't do that again.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.rebuffed.1: %1$s. You remember when you tried to %2$s? I'd rather you didn't.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.rebuffed.2: I hope you've learned some manners since you tried to %2$s, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.rude.0: You were rude to me, %1$s. I haven't forgotten.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.rude.1: Oh, it's you, %1$s. Come to insult me again?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.lied.0: You lied to my face, %1$s. Don't think I'll believe you again.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.lied.1: %1$s. The liar. What story is it today?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.lied.2: I know a liar when I've caught one, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.threatened.0: Stay back, %1$s. I remember what you threatened me with.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.threatened.1: You threatened me, %1$s. I told the guards about you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.threatened.2: I'm not scared of you, %1$s. Well. Not much.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.confessed.0: You owned up and paid what you owed, %1$s. That's more than most do.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.confessed.1: No hard feelings, %1$s. You did the honest thing in the end.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.confessed.2: An honest thief is still a thief, %1$s. But you did pay up.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.bribed.0: Ah, %1$s. Our little arrangement still stands, eh?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.bribed.1: %1$s. I don't remember a thing about the other day. Not a thing.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.bribed.2: If you've anything else that needs not looking at, %1$s, you know where I am.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.beat_you.1: You took that bout well, %1$s. Want to try your luck again?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.beat_you.2: I still feel bad about that bout, %1$s. Only a little.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.lost_to_you.0: %1$s. You beat me fair and square. My jaw still aches.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.lost_to_you.1: Next time, %1$s. Next time I'll have you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.lost_to_you.2: Folk keep asking about the bout I lost to you, %1$s. Thanks for that.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.struck.0: You hit me, %1$s. I still have the bruise.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.struck.1: Keep your hands to yourself this time, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.struck.2: I remember your fist, %1$s. Stay away from me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.paid_off.0: %1$s. You paid for that bruise, I'll give you that.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.paid_off.1: Money doesn't make it right, %1$s. But it helped.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.paid_off.2: Come to buy your way out of another fight, %1$s?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.crime.0: I saw that %2$s, %1$s. With my own eyes.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.crime.2: %1$s. I know what you are. I saw that %2$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.robbed.0: Keep your hands out of my pockets this time, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.robbed.1: I felt your hand in my pocket, %1$s. I won't forget it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.killed_kin.0: You killed %2$s. Get away from me, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.killed_kin.1: %2$s was my family, %1$s. And you killed them.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.killed_kin.2: Every night I think of %2$s. And every night I think of you, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.saved.0: You saved my life, %1$s. I'll never forget it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.saved.1: %1$s! Without you I'd be dead in the dirt. Anything you need, ask.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.saved.2: I tell everyone how you saved me, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.freed.0: You broke my chains, %1$s. I still dream of that place.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.freed.1: %1$s! You freed me. I owe you everything.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.freed.2: If you hadn't come for me, %1$s, I'd still be in those chains.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.home.0: You brought me home, %1$s. I'll be grateful till my last day.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.home.1: %1$s! The one who carried me out of captivity. Bless you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.home.2: My family thought me dead until you brought me home, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.returned_kin.0: You brought %2$s home to us, %1$s. We'll never forget it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.returned_kin.1: %1$s! You're the one who saved %2$s. Our door is always open to you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.returned_kin.2: %2$s talks of you every day, %1$s. Thank you for bringing them home.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.saw_deed.0: I saw you %2$s, %1$s. Not many would have done that.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.saw_deed.1: %1$s! I saw you %2$s. Good on you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.saw_deed.2: Folk like you are rare, %1$s. I saw you %2$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.quest_done.0: You did what I asked, %1$s: %2$s. I'll remember that.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.quest_done.2: Not many would have bothered with %2$s, %1$s. You did.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.quest_failed.0: You gave up on me, %1$s. %2$s. I was counting on you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.quest_failed.1: Oh. %1$s. The one who walked away from %2$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.quest_failed.2: I asked you for one thing, %1$s: %2$s. Never mind.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.letter.0: Thank you for the letter from %2$s, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.letter.1: %1$s! You brought me word from %2$s. Bless you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.letter.2: I've read the letter from %2$s three times now, %1$s. Thank you for carrying it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.fed.0: %3$s says you fed them when they were hungry, %1$s. That was good of you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.fed.1: Word is you share your food with the hungry, %1$s. %3$s told me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.kissed.0: %3$s tells me you kissed them, %1$s. Ooh!
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.kissed.1: So you're the one who kissed %3$s, %1$s. The whole village knows.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.lied.0: %3$s says you're a liar, %1$s. I'll take your words with salt.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.lied.1: I hear you lied to %3$s's face, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.threatened.0: %3$s told me you threatened them, %1$s. Keep away from me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.threatened.1: You're the one who threatened %3$s. I'll be watching you, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.struck.0: %3$s says you hit them, %1$s. Is that true?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.struck.1: I hear you raise your fists to folk, %1$s. %3$s told me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.crime.1: Word gets round, %1$s. %3$s told me about the %2$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.robbed.0: %3$s says you tried to pick their pocket, %1$s. Hands where I can see them.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.robbed.1: Mind my purse, folks: %3$s says %1$s is a cutpurse.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.killed_kin.1: I know what you did to %2$s, %1$s. %3$s told me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.saved.0: %3$s says you saved their life, %1$s. You're a good soul.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.saved.1: You're the one who saved %3$s! Well met, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.freed.0: %3$s says you broke their chains, %1$s. Brave of you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.freed.1: So you're the one who freed %3$s, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.home.0: %3$s tells everyone you brought them home from captivity, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.home.1: You're the rescuer %3$s talks about! Welcome, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.returned_kin: I hear you brought %2$s home, %1$s. %3$s can't stop talking about it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.quest_done.0: %3$s says you're a reliable sort, %1$s. Did a task for them: %2$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.quest_done.1: You helped %3$s with %2$s, I hear. Good on you, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.fed.0: %1$s fed me once when I had nothing. A kind soul, that one.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.fed.1: If you see %1$s, thank them for me. They fed me when I was starving.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.kissed.0: Don't tell anyone, but %1$s kissed me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.kissed.1: %1$s kissed me! I don't know what to make of it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.lied.0: Don't trust %1$s. They lied straight to my face.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.lied.1: %1$s? A liar. I'd not believe a word they say.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.threatened.0: Watch out for %1$s. They threatened me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.threatened.1: %1$s threatened me, you know. In broad daylight.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.crime.0: I saw %1$s at their %2$s once. Keep your doors locked.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.crime.1: Keep an eye on %1$s. I saw that %2$s myself.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.robbed.0: %1$s tried to pick my pocket. Mind your purse round them.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.robbed.1: Cutpurse, that %1$s. I caught their hand in my pocket.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.killed_kin.0: %1$s killed %2$s. My family. I'll never forgive them.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.killed_kin.1: If you see %1$s, tell them %2$s's family hasn't forgotten.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.saved.0: %1$s saved my life once. If you know them, you know a hero.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.saved.1: I'd be dead if not for %1$s. Remember that name.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.freed.0: %1$s broke my chains when I was taken. Brave as they come.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.freed.1: I was a captive till %1$s came. I owe them everything.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.home.0: %1$s carried me home from captivity. A good soul.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.home.1: Ever met %1$s? They brought me home when I'd given up hope.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.returned_kin: %1$s brought %2$s home to us. We'd do anything for them.
We owe %1$s. They saved %2$s from captivity.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.quest_done.0: %1$s helped me with %2$s. Reliable, that one.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.quest_done.1: If you need something done, ask %1$s. They did %2$s for me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.more: I just wanted you to know I remember. That's all.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.0: I've nothing to say to you, %1$s. Leave me be.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.1: After what you did? Don't touch me, %1$s.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.command.head: %s remembers %s thing(s) of you (leaning %s):
message.jaymoskingdoms.hornkin_rally: %s roars, and the Hornkin rally to him!
message.jaymoskingdoms.warboss_horn: %s blows a war horn, and his piglins rally!
message.jaymoskingdoms.nether_host: A war host marches out of %s against %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nether_fort_falle: %s has fallen: %s is broken, and its host flees.
message.jaymoskingdoms.portal_raid: Hornkin from %s burst out of a Nether portal near %s, hunting for gold!
message.jaymoskingdoms.portal_raid_bough: %s pays the Hornkin in gold, and the raiders head back to their portal.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.horns: %s Hornkin horns! Well done. Here are %s emeralds, as I promised anyone who drives those raiders off.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.nether.hornkin: Hornkin raiders come through the portals for our gold, and they answer to %4$s, the warlord who holds %1$s in the Nether. Go through, find his fort at %2$s, %3$s by Nether reckoning, and kill him. His horns break shields, and when he is hurt he roars his kin to his side.
The piglins of %1$s follow %4$s, a warboss as big as a cart, and their war hosts make the Nether no place for honest folk. His camp is at %2$s, %3$s in the Nether. Kill him, and mind his leap: he comes down on his foes like a falling tree.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.objective.nether_wa: Slay the warlord of %s in the Nether (%s, %s).
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.beef: %s tears into the raw beef. The hunger leaves its eyes, for tonight.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.calling: %s turns the brewing stand over in pale hands. "An alchemist, then."
%s runs a finger down the smoker. "I know a thing or two about meat."
%s strokes the old shelf. "I have seen a great deal of history. I'll keep it."
%s taps out a slow tune on the note block. "A bard. Why not."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.sold.al: %s presses a warm, golden vial into your hand. "Drink it before they bite, not after."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.sold.sl: %s wraps a few strips of dark meat. "Better under a full moon."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.sold.ch: %s slides a card across. "It remembers how we move."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.sold.ba: %s hands over the lute. "Even the dead stop to listen."
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.no_slee: Sleep won't come. Not while the night holds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.begins: Something in your blood answers the dark. The sun will not rise.
message.jaymoskingdoms.nightfall.paralys: You can't move. Something is in the room.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.sheep.t: The common's grazed down to nothing but weeds and we've no flock to keep it short. Bring me %1$s %2$s on a lead, please.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.hay.tex: Winter's coming and the hayloft's half empty. %1$s %2$s would see the animals through.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.eggs.te: There's a feast coming and not an egg in the village. %1$s %2$s, if you can find them.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.desert.camel.t: Our caravan leaves soon, a camel short. Bring me %1$s %2$s on a lead and you'll be remembered in the songs. Probably.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.desert.water.t: The well's running low and the gardens are thirsty. %1$s %2$s would help more than you know.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.desert.hides.t: The wind's torn the tents again. %1$s %2$s will patch them.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.savanna.cattle: Something got into the kraal and half the herd is gone. Bring %1$s %2$s on a lead to fill the kraal.
We've more to carry than backs to carry it. %1$s %2$s on a lead, please.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.savanna.acacia: The fences are falling over and the goats know it. %1$s %2$s to mend them.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.goat.text: The cold's dried up our old nanny. %1$s %2$s on a lead would keep the children in milk.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.coal.text: It's a long, cold night up here. %1$s %2$s for the hearths.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.stew.text: The ice fishers come home frozen through. %1$s %2$s would thaw them out.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.taiga.pigs.tex: The pen's empty and the smokehouse is cold. %1$s %2$s on a lead, please.
Jam-making day, and not a berry picked. %1$s %2$s from the bushes in the woods.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.taiga.firewood: The woodpile won't last the month. %1$s %2$s, split or not.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.chicken: The ocelots got the hens. Again. %1$s %2$s on a lead, and we'll build a better coop.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.cocoa.t: Traders are coming for cocoa and we've none dried. %1$s %2$s, quickly.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.melon.t: It's too hot to think. %1$s %2$s would cool everyone down.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.frog.tex: The flies are unbearable since the frogs left. %1$s %2$s on a lead, if a frog can be led.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.slime.te: Don't ask what it's for. %1$s %2$s, in a jar if you have one.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.lilies.t: The herbalist wants %1$s %2$s for a poultice. Or a hat. It's not clear.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.cat.tex: LOST: grey cat, one white paw. Answers to nothing. Probably asleep somewhere warm. Reward: gratitude.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.plains.dance.t: Harvest dance at the bell, sundown. Bring a partner, or a pie.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.desert.well.te: The well is for DRINKING. Not bathing. You know who you are.
Found by the dunes: one sandal, left foot. The owner may ask at the bell.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.savanna.crossi: Mind the cattle crossing at the river. They do not mind you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.savanna.tale.t: The old tale is told tonight under the big acacia. Children sit at the front. Elders at the back, to sleep.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.ice.title: Thin Ice
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.ice.text: The ice on the pond is THIN. Stay off it. Yes, you.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.snow.mitten.te: Lost: one red mitten, left hand. The right one is very lonely.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.taiga.fox.text: A fox has been in the henhouse every night this week. If it's yours, take it home.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.taiga.timber.t: Woodcutters: shout before it falls. The bakery roof has had enough.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.parrots: Do NOT feed the parrots. They will not leave. They will never leave.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.jungle.melon_t: Missing: one whole melon, from the market. No questions asked if it comes back.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.hut.text: The hut out in the bog is OFF LIMITS. Whatever she's selling, don't buy it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.swamp.boot.tex: Lost in the mud: one good boot. The mud won't give it back. Neither will the frogs.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.errand_lore: Pull it off the board to take the errand.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.notice.posting.0: There. "%s". Someone ought to read it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.stale: The notice is out of date. You tear it down.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.stale_noti: That bounty is over. No one will pin this notice up again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.not_here: This notice is for another realm's board.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.gave_up: You pin the notice back up and give up the hunt for %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.posting.0: Wanted: %s! %s emeralds to whoever brings them in.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.posting.1: There. %s, %s emeralds. Someone ought to see to it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.posting.2: Another one for the board: %s, worth %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.bandit.1: Masked and armed... bandit! Somebody fetch the guard!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.bandit.2: Bandit in the square! Hide the silver!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.bandit.3: I don't like the look of that one. Bandit, mark me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.bandit.4: Keep your face covered, do you? Honest folk don't.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.pirate.1: A sea-thief, bold as brass! Lock the stores!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.pirate.2: That's a pirate's rag on that face, I'd swear it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bandit.cry.pirate.4: Off your ship and into our town, are you? Pirate!
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.posted: %s has put a price on %s's head: %s emeralds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.taken: Someone else is already on this one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.full: You can hunt only %s bounties at once.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.took: You took the bounty on %s (%s emeralds). Bring them in alive, or their head for half.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.sentenced: You were brought before the court of %s. Your crimes there are paid for (a fine of %s emeralds).
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.no_court: No realm keeps this board: there's no one here to pay a bounty.
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.none: No one is wanted in %s. For now.
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.title: %s: %s emeralds
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.title.dead: %s, dead: their head for %s emeralds' worth
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.text.player: WANTED: %s, for %s. Bring them before %s alive for %s emeralds, or their head for %s.
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.text.crook: WANTED: %s, a villager gone crooked, for %s. Bring them before %s alive for %s emeralds, or their head for %s.
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.text.boss: Armed with a legendary weapon, and dangerous.
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.objective.offer: Take it to learn where they were last seen.
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.objective.away: Last seen leaving this world altogether.
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.objective.dead: Dead. Bring the head to %s for %s emeralds.
bounty.jaymoskingdoms.extra.head: Their head: %s emeralds
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.alive.0: %s, alive and in chains. Well done. Here: %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.alive.1: So this is %s. Not so bold now. Your %s emeralds, hunter.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.alive.2: The crown keeps its word: %s brought in, %s emeralds paid.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.head.0: The head of %s. Grim work, but it's done. %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.head.1: I'd rather have had %s alive. Still: %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.head.2: Put it on a spike by the gate. %s won't trouble us again. %s emeralds for you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.cells.1: Throw %s in the dungeon and lose the key.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.bounty.cells.2: %s will answer to the court. Away with them.
crook.jaymoskingdoms.fetch.0: Wait right here, I'll fetch them from my house.
crook.jaymoskingdoms.fetch.1: They're round the back. Won't be a moment!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.fetch.2: Stay put, friend, I'll bring them right out.
crook.jaymoskingdoms.gloat.0: Ha! %s emeralds for nothing! Never trust a bargain, friend!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.gloat.1: Pleasure doing business, sucker! Thanks for the %s emeralds!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.gloat.2: Goods? What goods? Easiest %s emeralds I've made all week!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.caught.1: Just admiring your coat, that's all!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.mug.2: Emptying your pockets, neighbour? Let me help.
crook.jaymoskingdoms.mug_player.0: Your emeralds or your teeth, stranger!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.mug_player.1: Dark night to be out alone. Pay up!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.cry.thief.2: I saw that! Give it back, you crook!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.cry.arson.0: Fire! They set it on purpose!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.cry.arson.2: Fire! I saw who lit it!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.demand.0: Hey! Give me back what you took!
crook.jaymoskingdoms.demand.1: You cheated me. Hand it over.
crook.jaymoskingdoms.demand.2: I know what you did. Pay it back, now.
crook.jaymoskingdoms.give_back.0: Alright, alright! Here, take it. No harm meant.
crook.jaymoskingdoms.give_back.1: Just a joke, see? Here's your due.
crook.jaymoskingdoms.give_back.2: Fine! Take it and keep your voice down.
crook.jaymoskingdoms.bolt.2: You'll have to catch me first!
message.jaymoskingdoms.crook.picked_seen: %s picked your pocket (%s), and was seen! Catch them or confront them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crook.picked_felt: You feel a hand in your pocket: %s just lifted %s! Confront them, or bring them down.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crook.missed: Your pack feels lighter. Someone lifted %s from you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crook.recovered: You take back what was stolen from you: %s.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.halt.0: Halt! In the name of the crown!
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.halt.2: You there! Hands where I can see them!
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.resisted.0: Resisting arrest, are we? Have it your way.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.hauled.0: On your feet. The crown will see you now.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.present.0: Your Majesty, this one was caught at %s.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.present.1: Sire, a criminal for judgment. The charge: %s.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.present.2: We took this wretch in the act, Majesty. %s.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.pardon.0: A first offence. You are pardoned. Do not make me regret it.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.pardon.1: I am merciful today. Go, and sin no more.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.pardon.2: Let them go. Everyone deserves a second chance.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.flog.1: A beating, so they remember the law.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.flog.2: Teach them a lesson they won't forget.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.exile.0: You are banished from this realm. Never return.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.exile.1: Get out of my kingdom, and do not come back.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.exile.2: Exile. Let the wilds have you.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.1: Death. Let this be a warning to all.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.2: The sentence is death. Carry it out.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.exiled.2: Where am I supposed to go?
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.0: To the cells with you. Let the rats keep you company.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.1: Robbing the dead earns you the dark below. Take him down.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.2: Lock him up. He'll see daylight when I say so.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.jailed.0: Not the cells! Anything but the cells!
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.jailed.2: It was only boots... they didn't need boots...
message.jaymoskingdoms.looter.handed: You brought a looter before %s's guard for judgement. The town thanks you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.looter.news.pardo: That looter you brought in? The crown let him go. Too soft, if you ask me.
Heard they freed your looter. Watch your dead.
The looter walked free, would you believe it.
They flogged that looter you caught. Heard him howl from the well.
Your looter got the lash and sent off. He won't sit for a week.
A good flogging for the grave robber. Thanks to you.
The looter you brought in is rotting in the cells now.
They threw your grave robber below. Good riddance.
Heard the cell door slam on that looter. Your doing, wasn't it?
message.jaymoskingdoms.looter.news.execu: They took the looter's head. He'll rob no more dead.
The grave robber you caught? Executed at the seat. Folk cheered.
Your looter's joined the dead he robbed. Justice, that.
message.jaymoskingdoms.looter.news.exile: They sent your looter packing out of the realm.
The looter's banished. Let some other land deal with him.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.notus_d: A shadow crosses the sun and the air smells of cinders. Notus, the south wind, has seen you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.boreas_: The wind drops and your breath hangs in the air. Something long and pale is gliding overhead. Boreas, the north wind, has seen you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.encounter.zephyru: The frogs go quiet. Something under the water is watching you. Zephyrus, the west wind, has seen you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.crashed: %s crashes to the ground, wounded and wary. Come close crouching, with empty hands, and it may come to trust you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.bolted: %s has had enough. It bolts into the sky.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.tamed: %s lowers its head and lets you touch its snout. It's yours.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.exhausted: %s is exhausted and can only glide down. Let it rest, or feed it meat.
message.jaymoskingdoms.dragon.not_yours: %s won't carry you unless its owner is in the saddle.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.who: Hm. You. You walk like you're trailing weather behind you. Who are you?
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.slain: And what have you killed? Quick now. I can smell it on you.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.reveal: Then you'll do. Hold your breath, little storm!
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.shoo.1: Pah. A wind's worth of nothing. Away with you!
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.shoo.2: Not yet. Come back when you've bled a dragon or two.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.shoo.3: Off! I've no time for the unblooded.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.cramped: Too many trees about. Find me somewhere with sky.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.who: Mm... come closer, child. The air tells me little of you. Who are you?
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.who.b: Only someone who is passing through.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.slain: And in all your wandering... what have you slain, little one? Speak slowly. I am old, and the winds are long.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.slain.b: Some of your children, I think.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.reveal: So. The winds were right about you. Then let us see what you are made of.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.shoo.1: Not yet, child. The winds have not spoken your name. Go on, go home.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.shoo.2: Hm. Young. Come back when you have seen more of the sky.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.shoo.3: Run along now. The old have no use for the green.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.busy: Ah. You again. The winds have not changed their minds.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.cramped: There is no room here for what I am. Walk with me to open ground.
message.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.phase3: Aeolus breathes all four winds at once.
message.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.gale: The sky draws breath. Get low!
message.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.fallen: Aeolus falls. The winds are calm, and four eggs lie where he fell.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.struck.1: Ha! Was that meant to sting? I've been hit harder by a breeze.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.struck.2: Again? You flail like a hatchling in a gale. Do that once more and see what happens.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.eurus.after: There. Now you know what a storm feels like. Crawl off.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.struck.1: Mm. A child tugging at my sleeve. How sweet. Run along.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.struck.2: I have watched mountains wear down to sand, little one. I can wait out your tantrum. But not for ever.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.snap: So be it. Let the old man teach you manners.
disguise.jaymoskingdoms.aeolus.after: Lie there and think on it. The young never listen until they're on the ground.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.tied: Line tied. Now string it to the next stake, straight along the ground (at most %s blocks).
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.strung: Strung: a side of %s blocks, stake to stake.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.not_straigh: A line runs straight north-south or east-west, from stake to stake.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.too_far: The string won't stretch that far: %s blocks at most.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.too_steep: Those stakes are too far apart in height to string together.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.already: Those stakes are already strung together.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stake.full: That stake can't hold another line.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pulley.wound: The rope is wound all the way in.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pulley.full: The pulley can't hold any more rope.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pulley.no_rope: No rope left on the pulley: give it some.
death.attack.jaymoskingdoms.gloom.player: %1$s was taken by the dark while fleeing %2$s
command.jaymoskingdoms.tier.floor: The world's floor tier is now %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_rallies.her: %s rallies! Her guards rush to her side.
message.jaymoskingdoms.king_fallen.her: The Queen of %s has fallen to %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.lord_fallen.her: The Lady of %s has fallen to %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.king.her: The Queen of %s has died peacefully in her sleep, at a great age. Her heir will take the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.old_age.lord.her: The Lady of %s has died peacefully in her sleep, at a great age. Her heir will take the seat by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor.he: %s mourns its queen. An heir will take the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.fate.successor_lo: %s mourns its lady. Another will take her seat by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession.her: A new queen takes the throne of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.succession.lord.h: A new lady takes the seat of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.carriage.bought.h: %s has bought its queen a carriage.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.tyran: The queen of %1$s laughed at my envoy. No one laughs at me. Kneel to her, swear her your sword, and she will let you near her throne at %2$s, %3$s. Then end her. An oath to a dead man binds no one.

The queen of %1$s is loved, and that offends me. Each day she leaves her throne at %2$s, %3$s to hand out bread with few swords at her back. She stops for any stranger who looks hungry. Look hungry, and let her kindness kill her.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.warlo: I would rather take the crown of %1$s on the field, but its queen hides behind her walls and will not come out to fight me. Swear yourself her man, get near her throne at %2$s, %3$s, and finish what she is too craven to face me for.

The queen of %1$s will not meet me in the field; she is too busy feeding peasants. Each day she walks out from her throne at %2$s, %3$s with bread and few guards. If she will not fight me, let her die among her loaves.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.paran: The queen of %1$s plots against me. Her spies are everywhere; I hear them at night. Strike first. Swear to her, let her trust you as I never trust anyone, reach her throne at %2$s, %3$s, and kill her before she kills me.

The queen of %1$s smiles and hands out bread, and everyone loves her. It is a mask: she plots my end, I am sure of it. Each day she walks out from her throne at %2$s, %3$s with hardly a guard. Kill her before she moves against me.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.revel: The queen of %1$s refused my feast and called my court a tavern. Drink to her health, swear to her crown, and get close to her throne at %2$s, %3$s. Then make her the last guest of a very short party.

The queen of %1$s plays the saint and makes my feasts look like gluttony. Each day she leaves her throne at %2$s, %3$s with bread for the poor and few guards. Take her bread, then take her life. We will drink to it.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.regicide.puris: The queen of %1$s lets every stray blood under the sun settle in her city and calls it strength. It is rot, and it spreads. Swear to her, get near her throne at %2$s, %3$s, and cut the rot out at the root.
The queen of %1$s walks among mongrels and hands them bread as if they were her own. Each day she leaves her throne at %2$s, %3$s with few guards at her back. Let her die among the rabble she loves.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant.her: Stop. By the queen's command, every stranger's pack is searched. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid.her: Hold still. The queen believes someone means her harm. Let's see what's in your pack.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.tyrant.more.h: Open it, or we open you. Those are the queen's words, not mine.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.paranoid.more: Knives, poison, letters to her enemies. You'd be amazed what we find. Open it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.purist.more.h: Anyone not of %3$s blood is searched coming in. The queen's orders. Open it, or turn around.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.tyrant.her: Halt. Strangers pay the queen's toll to walk her streets. %s emeralds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reveler.her: A coin for the queen's feast! %s emerald, and you're welcome at the table.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.tyrant.more.her: %s emeralds, into the queen's coffers. Strangers who don't pay don't walk free.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.paranoid.more.h: %s emeralds. Everyone pays. Everyone is written down. That's how we keep her safe.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reveler.more.he: %s emerald, and there's cake and ale for everyone tonight. The queen insists!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.tyrant.her: Tell me, stranger. What do you think of our glorious queen?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.noble.her: A question, if I may: how do you find our queen? Folk say she's fair.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.paranoid.her: What do you think of the queen? Choose your words carefully.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reveler.her: Isn't our queen the best? Go on, say it! Best queen in the world!
Folk who speak well of her prosper. Folk who don't... don't. So?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.noble.more.h: We like to know what travellers think. It helps her rule well. Be honest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.warlord.more: Every man here would die for her. I want to know if you'd stand beside us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.paranoid.mor: There are people who'd see her dead. I'm only asking who you are. What do you think of her?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reveler.more: Nobody throws a feast like her. Nobody! Go on, what do you think?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.purist.her: You're no %3$s, but you're in our queen's city. What do you make of her?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.purist_kin.h: Proud to have a queen of our own blood, aren't you?
She's made this realm what it is: pure, and strong. Your kind should be grateful she lets you in. Well?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.purist_kin.m: She's the first queen in an age to stand up for %3$s folk. Say it with me.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.found.t: What's this? Stolen! %s emeralds for the queen, and pray she doesn't hear of it.
Refusing the queen's men? Seize them!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.search.reply.bribe.n: A bribe? You insult me, and you insult the queen.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.paid.tyra: Into the queen's coffers. You may pass.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.toll.reply.haggle_fa: Haggle? With the queen's men? I'll take it all, and a slap for asking.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reply.praise: That's kind of you. She'll be pleased to hear it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reply.silent: Not like our blood to hold its tongue about our own queen.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reply.ill.re: Ha! Grumpy! She'd laugh at that, you know.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.loyalty.reply.ill.pu: You speak ill of her in her own city? Your kind should be on its knees, thanking her!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.0.more.her: Something about the taxes, I heard. Or her dinner. Either way, don't cross the castle folk today.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.0.her: Did you hear? The queen's in a foul temper again. Best keep your head down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.1.her: You, in the hood and mask. The queen trusts no face she can't see, and neither do I. Take it off.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unmask.0.more.her: The queen's sure someone means her harm, and a mask is just the way they'd come. Unmask, let me search you, or leave %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.identity.exiled.0.he: You! The masked meddler! The queen wants your kind gone. Out!
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.proud.kin.1: The queen says every child born %1$s is a stone in the wall. So go on, settle down here, %3$s.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.proud.kin.4: Did you see the guards turn back that cart of outsiders? The queen's right. Our blood first.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.proud.outsi: The queen says there are too many of your kind about already. She's not wrong.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.grumble.2.h: The guard drafts took every %1$s lad and not one of us. We're not good enough to die for her, even.
purist.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.grumble.3.h: One day this queen will be gone, %3$s, and we'll still be here. Remember that.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.king.break_in.title: A Horse for the Queen
quest.jaymoskingdoms.race.won.her: You rode into %s with %s seconds to spare! Go back and tell the queen.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.escort.arrived.her: %s is safe in harbour at %s. Go back to the queen for your reward.
festival.jaymoskingdoms.feast.1.her: A feast fit for the queen!
wealth.jaymoskingdoms.wealthy.her: wealthy (mounted guards and archers, the queen's carriage)
They've got more steel than the queen's armoury.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.gossip.odd.power.ars: They say the queen's smith wept when he saw %s's swords.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.realm.hover: %s guards in the realm, %s emeralds in the treasury
standing.jaymoskingdoms.temper.tyrant.ho: Slaps their people, seizes from the stalls, taxes hard. Kneel (sneak) near them.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.temper.noble.hov: Greets their people with bread, builds well, taxes lightly. Quick to think well of you.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.temper.warlord.h: Drilled guards and twice the war parties. Sheathe your blade near them.
Short rounds, eyes everyone. Hang about and the guards drive you out.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.temper.reveler.h: Gifts on the round and a feast at dusk. Pester them and you're tossed off, laughing.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.temper.purist.ho: Proud of the %s blood: welcomes their own kind, shoves everyone else aside.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.ruler.day.hover: Round of the town from dawn, court until mid-afternoon, then their own time
standing.jaymoskingdoms.duty.hover: Each guard has a shift off by day, and the evening, among the townsfolk
hud.jaymoskingdoms.seize.fight: The wolf has you. Hammer your movement keys to fight it
hud.jaymoskingdoms.seize.fight_or_give_i: The blood has you. Hammer your movement keys to fight it, or give in [%s]
hud.jaymoskingdoms.seize.hold_back: The wolf is tearing out. Hammer your movement keys to hold it down
Your mouth is dry. You can hear the heartbeats in the next room.
The fever's in your veins now. Every neck looks soft.
You're burning. If you don't feed, it will feed for you.
The blood takes you. Your legs are moving before you are.
A pulse, close by. Nothing else in the world matters.
Your teeth ache. Your body turns toward the warmth on its own.
The thirst has the reins. You're only along for the ride.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_fever.give_: You stop fighting. It feels like coming home.
Why fight it? You were made for this.
You let go. The red rushes in.
You tear yourself back. Your hands won't stop shaking.
Not tonight. Not them. You stagger away, sick and starving.
You win, for now. The thirst sulks somewhere behind your eyes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_fever.fed.g: The fever breaks. You've never felt so alive, or so far from yourself.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_fever.fed.t: You come back to yourself with blood on your chin. You didn't choose this. Did you?
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_fever.stage: The thirst comes quicker now. It knows your name.
Bloodbound. The night bends to you, and you bend to the blood.
Ravenous. Even your friends smell like supper.
There's nothing left of you to fight with. Only the blood.
You feel more like yourself. The thirst is quieter.
The blood loosens its grip. A little of you comes back.
Your friends smell like friends again. Mostly.
Somewhere under the hunger, you're still there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.stage.1: Restless. The wolf paces behind your ribs, even when you're yourself.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.stage.2: Wild. The wolf wants out more nights than the moon allows.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.stage.3: Savage. You can't remember which of the dreams were dreams.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.stage.4: Feral. Every night, the wolf comes for you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.stage.5: Lost. There's more wolf in you than you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.back.0: The pacing behind your ribs has stopped. For now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.back.1: The wolf settles. The nights are your own again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.back.2: You remember your own name more easily.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.back.3: Some nights, now, the wolf lets you sleep.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.back.4: A little of you claws its way back from the wolf.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.hunt.1: A scent. The wolf's legs aren't yours any more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.hunt.2: Something moves. The beast is already running.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.hunt.3: Prey. The word fills your whole skull.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.hunt.4: The wolf takes the reins and goes for the throat.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.free.1: You drag the wolf back on its haunches, snarling.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.free.2: Not that one. You pull yourself back, panting.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.free.3: The wolf yields, for now. It won't forget.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.refuse.1: You reach for yourself, but the wolf won't let go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.refuse.2: The beast shakes you off like water. Not yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.refuse.3: You try to shrink back. The wolf growls you down.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.tearing.1: Your bones crack. It's not even the full moon.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.tearing.2: The wolf smells your blood and wants out. Hold it down!
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.tearing.3: Something is tearing at you from the inside.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.tearing.los: The wolf doesn't ask any more. It just comes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.held.1: You force the wolf back down. You're shaking all over.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.held.2: Your bones grind back into place. You held it. Barely.
message.jaymoskingdoms.feral.held.3: The wolf sinks back, sulking. You're still you.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.h: Helps anyone up, anywhere, whatever you've done. Won't strike someone who's down.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.hove: Forgives a poor name, helps out in the wild too, and quickly.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.devout.hover: Mercy is a duty: helps anyone who isn't the land's enemy. Won't strike someone who's down.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.hover: Helps whoever their people think well of.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.brave.hover: Helps whoever their people think well of, monsters or not. Stands their ground.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.proud.hover: Helps only those of real standing. Can't be bought off.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.hover: Helps anyone not an enemy who can pay, and takes a fee. Takes anyone's bribe.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.ho: Won't help a stranger: introduce yourself first.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.timid.hover: Helps only with no monster near. Frightened easily, runs from fights.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.hov: Never helps someone they're cross with. Quick to fight, even someone feared.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.hove: Helps only a friend, and laughs at everyone else's misfortune.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.hover: Helps whoever their people think well of, from nearby only, and slowly.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.h: Hold on, hold on! I've got you.
Easy now, whoever you are. Let's get you up.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.help: Up you get! It's not so bad as all that.
Had a tumble? Here, I'll patch you up.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.devout.help.0: Mercy for all. Lie still and I'll tend you.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.devout.help.1: No one is left to die where I can help it.
Stay down, I'll see to you.
One of ours is hurt! Coming.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.brave.help.0: Never mind them, I'm getting you out of this.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.brave.help.1: Grit your teeth, friend. I'm here.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.proud.help.0: You're worth the trouble. Barely. Hold still.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.proud.help.1: Someone of your name shouldn't be lying in the dirt.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.help.0: Looks like you need help. Help costs, mind.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.help.1: I'll get you up. We'll talk about payment after.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.he: I know you, at least. Don't make me regret this.
Fine. But I'm watching your hands.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.timid.help.0: Is it safe? Oh... all right, quickly.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.timid.help.1: Please don't let anything come back. Hold still.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.hel: Who did this to you? I'll break their nose. Up!
Get up and let's find them!
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.help: Only because it's you. Don't tell anyone.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.help.0: Of course this happens. Hold still.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.help.1: We all end up on the ground sooner or later...
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.jeer: Ha! Look at you down there.
Serves you right. Don't expect any help from me.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.fee.0: That'll be %s emeralds. Pleasure doing business.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.fee.1: %s emeralds for my trouble. Cheap at the price.
temperament.jaymoskingdoms.command.nobod: No one with a temperament nearby.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.duty.audience: Taking a visitor to their liege
message.jaymoskingdoms.audience.ask: [Ask to be taken before the ruler]
message.jaymoskingdoms.audience.no_guard: There's no guard near enough to ask.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.follow: Follow me. I'll take you to the %s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.here: The %s is right there. Speak your piece.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.keep_up: Keep up. The %s won't wait all day.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.busy: Not now. Ask another of us.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.banned: You were thrown out of here. The %s won't see you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.refused: The %s has no time for the likes of you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.away: The %s isn't holding court just now.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.asleep: The %s is asleep. Come back in the morning.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.point: I can't get through. The %s is just there, go on ahead. You're expected.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.t: Kneel, %s, and be quick about it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.n: Welcome, %s. What can I do for you?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.w: %s. Speak plainly, I've a war to run.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.p: Stay where you are, %s. What do you want?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.r: %s! Come in, come in! What's the news?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.audience.receive.p: Well, %s. Say what you came to say.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.retinue.make_way1: Let them through, they're on the crown's business.
royal.jaymoskingdoms.dress.robes: Enough of the iron; my robes and crown.
royal.jaymoskingdoms.dress.robes.hurried: The danger has passed; I shall dress.
royal.jaymoskingdoms.dress.night: It is late. The crown and armour can wait till morning.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pigeon.nobody: Your pigeon cocks its head. It knows nobody called %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pigeon.self: Your pigeon won't fly a letter to you.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.busy.0: Not now, I've things to do.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.0: Carry your letters? Not for you.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.refuse.2: I run no errands for the likes of you.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.who.0: Who's this for? I don't know the name.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.who.2: Nobody by that name I know of.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.ride.0: That's a long road. I'll saddle up.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.ride.2: A horse, then, and off I go.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.news.1: Have you heard? It's all in here.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.order.0: Your order from the board! Wrapped and all.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.order.1: Goods for you, from the merchants. Mind, it's heavy.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.order.2: Brought your parcel. Pleasure doing business.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.no_town: This board serves no town, so no merchants take orders here.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.refused: The merchants of %s won't sell to you.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.none: No merchant about this town has anything to sell for emeralds just now.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.locked: %s more wares at a higher standing.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.title: %s x%s for %s emeralds
orders.jaymoskingdoms.text: Sold by %s, %s of %s. Pay %s emeralds now; a courier brings it to you once it's made up.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.text.ordered: From %s, paid %s emeralds. Cancel before it's sent for your emeralds back.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.objective.left: You may order this %s more times today.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.objective.sold_out: Sold out to you for today. More at dawn.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.objective.courier: Ready. Waiting on a courier to take it.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.too_many: You already have plenty waiting from this town.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.sent: Your order from the merchants of %s has gone out with %s.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.post: Your order from the merchants of %s was given to the post.
orders.jaymoskingdoms.tidings.waylaid: %s, carrying your parcel from %s, was cut down on the road near %s, %s. The goods lie there.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orders.posting.0: Orders taken here! Pay up front, we'll send it on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.orders.posting.2: Can't come to the stalls? Order from the board.
courier.jaymoskingdoms.from.1: %s sent this. Long way I've come.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.fitting: The whaler %s fits out at %s's harbour. Come aboard before she sails to sign on for a share.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.signed: You sign on with %s as a %s, for a share of the catch. Ask the captain about work to change berth before she sails. Be aboard when she comes home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.sails: Cast off! We sail for the whaling ground.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.anchor: Let go the anchor! Lash her alongside, and get the spades into her. Light the tryworks!
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.lay: Your lay: %s emeralds and two bottles of oil from %s, as her %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.home: The whaler %s is home with %s whales and %s bottles of oil.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whale_cut_in: Too big to cut from the water: lash it alongside a big ship to cut in the rest
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.dealing: Dealing in the open street? Guards! Guards!
I saw that! Peddling filth in our town!
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.contrab: What's that in your hand? You're coming with me!
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.0: Psst. Thirsty for more than ale? There's a hatch in the grass %2$s paces %1$s, by a hay bale. Knock gentle.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.1: You've the look of someone after %3$s. Head %1$s, %2$s paces or so. Look down, not up.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.whisper.2: Not here, the guards have ears. %2$s paces %1$s, there's a hatch. Tell 'em nobody sent you.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.dice.win.0: You throw %1$s and %2$s, I throw %3$s and %4$s. Bah. Take your %5$s and twice over.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.dice.win.1: %1$s and %2$s against my %3$s and %4$s? The bones love you tonight.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.dice.win.2: %1$s, %2$s... and me %3$s, %4$s. Lucky. Don't make a habit of it.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.dice.lose.0: You throw %1$s and %2$s, I throw %3$s and %4$s. The house thanks you for the %5$s.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.dice.lose.1: %1$s and %2$s? Oh dear. My %3$s and %4$s take it.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.dice.push.0: %1$s and %2$s, %3$s and %4$s. Even. Your stake back.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.dice.push.1: A tie. Nobody's happy. Here's your %5$s.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.yes.0: For you? Go on then. Here, and not a word.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.yes.1: Ha! I could use a little something. Quick, before someone looks.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.yes.2: You didn't get it from me and I didn't get it from you. Deal.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.no.0: Put that away. I didn't see it.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.no.1: Not my sort of thing, friend. Try someone else.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.no.2: Are you mad? Not out here.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.snitch.1: How dare you. The watch will hear of this.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.snitch.2: In our town? I'm telling the guard.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.again: I've had my fill today. Come back tomorrow.
underworld.jaymoskingdoms.pitch.fresh: It's still green. Dry it first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.found: You've found %s's back room. Keep it quiet.
news.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.hotbed: Travellers say %s has become a hotbed of trafficking and gambling; its back rooms deal in %s.
news.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.jailed: %s was thrown in %s's cells for trafficking.
news.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.escaped: %s broke out of %s's cells and is wanted there.
commands.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.none: There's no realm's law here (or it keeps no den).
commands.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.nosit: This realm keeps a den now, but no site was found to dig it yet.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.flog.1: Five strokes, and be glad it's not the cells.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.flog.2: Hold still. This'll teach you to deal in our streets.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.0: Take them below. The cells will cool your trade.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.1: Into the pit with you, trafficker.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.2: You'll sit in the dark and think on it.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.0: The realm's had enough of you. Kneel.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.1: Trafficker, again? Then it's the block.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.2: By the crown's word: death. Kneel.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.flogged.0: There. Off with you, and stay clean.
bust.jaymoskingdoms.flogged.2: Let that be a lesson to the rest of them.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.sentence: Caught by %s's guard for %s: you're sentenced to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.seen: %s is caught by %s's guard and sentenced to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.cells: You're thrown in the cells for %s minutes. Dig out and you're an outlaw.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.released: Your time is served. %s's guards let you out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bust.escaped: You've broken out of %s's cells. Every guard there wants you now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.begin: Alchemy? Oh, %1$s, you've come to the right rock! Sit, sit. Everything in the world is made of essences, and you can learn to read them.
You want to know about alchemy? Nobody ever asks! Wonderful. It all starts with learning to see what things are made of.
Ah, a curious one! I've waited years for someone to ask me that, %1$s. Let me tell you how every apothecary begins.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.eager: %1$s! Back again! Tell me everything. No, wait, let me guess what you've been brewing.
Questions? I live for questions! Well, questions and clouds. Mostly questions.
You've got that look, %1$s. The look of someone who's thrown something strange into a pot. Splendid!
Ask, ask! I've written half a library on this and nobody has read a page of it.
Another apothecary! Do you know how lonely it is, knowing all this and having nobody to tell?
Ha! I knew you'd come back. The craft gets its hooks in you, doesn't it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.greet: %1$s! I can smell the crucible on you from here! Come up, come up, tell me what you've learned!
A fellow apothecary on my little rock! Mind the edge, and then mind my questions!
Is that essence on your sleeves? It is! Oh, today is a good day.
%1$s, at last! I've had a dozen thoughts about your work and nobody to tell them to!
First, a Scrying Lens: gold for the frame, a pane of glass, a shard of amethyst. Hold it on anything and look a while. Then a Codex to keep your notes in: a book, an amethyst shard and some ink.
Have you opened your Codex properly? What you learn with the lens is insight. Spend it there and the pages start to make sense.

Look at more things! Stones, beasts, flowers, the soup you had for supper. Every new thing you study teaches you something, and some essences only show themselves once you know the ones they're made of.
You need a crucible. Iron and copper, set over a fire and filled with water. Throw anything in once it's hot and it melts into its essences. The Codex will tell you more, if you've the insight.
Salt, sulphur and mercury! The three principles. Your pot can make them solid, if you give it the right thing to work on. Look in the Codex under the crucible.
Orichalc, the alchemist's own metal. Plain iron, dropped into a pot that's rich in metal and something more... arcane. You'll want plenty of it later, trust me.
Stop scooping essence out with phials like a peasant! Set an alembic on your crucible and some jars beside it. It'll sort the essences out for you while you sleep.
Ever wanted a flame that never goes out? Glowstone, light and a little fire, all in the pot. I've had one burning by my bed for nine years.
Lead into gold! Well, iron into gold, a nugget at a time. And seeds into more seeds. The pot can change a thing's nature, if you feed it the right essences.
Have you noticed what your pot loses? It doesn't vanish. It goes into the land around you. Read about flux in your Codex before you learn about it the hard way.
Every apothecary should know how to clean up after themselves. Purifying salts, a purifying draught, a ward stone. Learn them before you need them, not after.
Now the real work begins: infusion! Pedestals in a ring, one in the middle, and a matrix floating two blocks above it. Keep your essence jars close. It drinks from them.
Did your altar spit things at you? Ha! Balance, my friend. Mirror your pedestals. Salt candles help, and so do skulls and ward stones. Magic hates a lopsided room.
If the work leaves you feeling a little... unwell, a runic amulet helps. Gold and orichalc, made on the altar. It bleeds away the worst of it while you carry it.
Ichor. The blood of the old powers, or near enough. A diamond on the altar, ghast tears and orichalc around it, and a great deal of spirit. Everything good after this needs it.
Have you made yourself a rod yet? An artificer's rod and a focus or two: pull things to you, push them away, lift a whole chest and carry it off. My favourite toy.
The enchanting table will take essence instead of all those gems and trinkets, if you know how to ask it. Bring full phials.
Stuck with a bad enchantment? A spellbinding cloth pulls it right out of the thing, and you keep the essence it was made of.
Melt ichor into gold in your pot and you get ichorium. The finest tools ever made. They do get... hungry. Don't let them feed too often.
Ichorcloth robes! Better than any knight's plate against magic, and the flux takes longer to get its teeth into you. Also, they're very flattering.
A lantern that hangs everflames wherever you point it. For people who never want to carry torches again. Light essence is all it eats.

The table has its limits. The altar doesn't, quite. Set an enchanted thing in the middle with a book of the same magic beside it, and you can push it one step further than anyone should. Mind the instability!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.maste: You know more than I do now. I'm not jealous. I'm a little jealous. Come and tell me what you discover next!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.worry: Stop. Look at me. Your eyes are wrong, friend. That's the flux in you. Learn to cleanse it, and quickly. Your Codex has the way, if you've studied far enough.
You've let it get into you again, haven't you? A purifying draught for the worst of it. And what goes deepest only lifts with a whole night's sleep somewhere clean, under a full moon.
Can you feel that? The ground here is sick with flux. Purifying salts, a ward stone, anything. Before it spreads.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.whisp: Some say there are pages that only show themselves to those who've heard the whispers. I've never read them. I don't intend to. Don't you go looking either.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.0: A tip: the crucible loses a little of everything you melt. A small price, but it adds up in one place. Move your work about now and then.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.1: Did you know a jar keeps its essence when you break it? Carry your stores wherever you go.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.2: Tipping out a crucible in a hurry is the fastest way to ruin a meadow. Draw it off into phials instead.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.3: Things that are made from other things carry their essences along. Study the parts and you'll guess the whole.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.4: Creatures have essences too. Hold your lens on a sheep sometime. It's very calming. For you, not the sheep.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.5: The Blood Moon makes flux spread like wildfire. If you've been careless, that's the night you'll pay for it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.6: Wisps? Little purple lights that drift toward you at night? Don't let them touch you. One good swat does for them.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.7: The pot only works once it's properly hot. Lava under it is quickest, but a campfire will do.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.8: Compound essences are made of two others. Learn the simple ones first and the rest follow.
