talk.jaymoskingdoms.hermit_alchemy.tip.9: I once infused a sword with no candles about. I still have the scar. And the sword, actually, so it worked out.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.mending.desc: Heals who you look at, or you, and closes a cut. Burns the undead.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.sanctuary.de: A circle of light on the ground: friends in it heal, and the undead are thrown out of it.
Heal instead of imbuing. J mends who you look at; sneak and J is a ring of healing round you, or brings a downed friend back up. Your blows on foes heal your friends a little. Poison and withering hurt you half as much.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.unattuned: You aren't attuned: you feel no mana in you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.attuned: The amethyst sings, and something answers in you. You are attuned: you feel mana, and you can learn spells from scrolls and cast them with a staff.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.attuned.natu: Mana floods through you. You are attuned, as every caster is.
message.jaymoskingdoms.restoration.hungr: You're too hungry to cast that.
message.jaymoskingdoms.restoration.downe: Mending can't reach the downed: Rekindle them (sneak and J).
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.ask: You look worn. What can I do for you?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.heal_free: Mend my wounds and set my bones (free, for a friend of the realm)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.scroll_restor: A Scroll of Restoration (%s emeralds, one a week)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.healed_free: Hold still... there. The realm looks after its friends.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.sold: Read it when you need it most.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.sold_restorat: Few are given one of these. Don't waste it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.deed.mercy: show mercy to a fallen foe
recall.jaymoskingdoms.mended.0: You healed me with your magic, %1$s. I've felt better ever since.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.mended.1: %1$s! The one with the healing hands. Thank you again.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.mended.2: I still can't see how you closed that cut, %1$s. Magic, they say.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.arcana.desc: For the attuned: more mana, and it comes back faster.
stat.jaymoskingdoms.arcana.now: +%s most mana (a caster; +%s otherwise), +%s mana a second
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.title: Where were you born?
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.sub: Your blood and the land that bore you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.plains.tale: You were born among the wheat of the open plains, where the days are long and the bread is honest.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.mountain: A mining hold inside the mountain
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.mountain.tale: You were born in a hold carved deep into the mountain, where the walls hum and no one fears the dark.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.coast: An unknown oasis by a water temple
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.coast.tale: Nobody knows quite where you were born: you were found at a hidden oasis by an old water temple, already at home in the water.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.forest.tale: You were born under the canopy of the old forest, where the trees are older than any realm.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.valley: A whole world of plains, moss and vines
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.valley.tale: You were born in a whole world of plains, moss and vines, where things grow back faster than they fall.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.forge: On an expedition outside the Nether
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.forge.tale: You were born on an expedition just outside the Nether, and its heat never quite left you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.north.tale: You were born in the frozen north, where the winter keeps half the year and the cold is just weather.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.moors: The moors, where the sun barely rises
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.moors.tale: You were born on the grey moors, where the sun barely clears the hills and the nights belong to your people.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.warband.tale: You were born in a warband's camp that never stayed anywhere long, a blade within reach of your cradle.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.scholars: A city of scholars and towers
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.scholars.tale: You were born in a city of towers and libraries, where everyone argued and nothing was ever settled.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.temple.tale: You were born on the high desert, woken every morning by the first light on the sand.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.title: Who raised you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.sub: Your family's place in the world shaped your first years.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.farmers.tale: Your parents worked the land from first light, and you worked beside them.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.smiths.tale: Your family dug ore and beat it into tools, and you grew strong carrying it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.fisherfolk.t: Your family lived off the water, and you learned to keep your feet on a rolling deck.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.hunters.tale: Your family lived off what they could track and shoot, and you learned to keep a steady hand.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.merchants.ta: Your family drove caravans between the towns, and you learned to count coin and read a face.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.soldiers.tal: Your parents served in a realm's ranks, and drilled you as soon as you could hold a stick.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.healers.tale: Your family tended the sick at a temple, and you learned what the body needs to mend.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.wizard.tale: A hedge-wizard took you in and set you to grinding his powders and copying his notes.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.outlaws.tale: Your family lived outside the law, and you learned to move quietly and leave no trace.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.nobles.tale: Your family held a small title in %s, and you learned the manners of the court.
story.jaymoskingdoms.raised.foundling.ta: Nobody claimed you. You were left on a doorstep and raised by whoever was kind that year.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.title: As a child, you were always...
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.sub: What kind of child were you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.roofs.tal: As a child you were always out playing in the moonlight, leaping further than you should have and landing lighter than you had any right to.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.caves.tal: As a child you were always sneaking into caves, coming home scraped and filthy and grinning.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.fights: Training like your life depended on it
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.fights.ta: As a child you trained like your life depended on it: running, lifting, striking, until your hands bled and you went again.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.books.tal: As a child you were always reading anything you could get your hands on, and asking about how time works.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.swimming: Swimming further out than anyone dared
As a child you always swam further out than anyone dared, and the deep never frightened you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.storms: Watching the storm clouds roll in
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.storms.ta: As a child you were always out in the wind, watching the storm clouds roll in while everyone else ran indoors.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.fire: Playing too close to the fire
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.fire.tale: As a child you always played too close to the fire, and somehow the smoke never bothered you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.snow: Building snow forts in the blizzards
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.snow.tale: As a child you were always out building snow forts in the blizzards, long after your fingers went numb.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.bells: Listening to the bells at night
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.bells.tal: As a child you lay awake listening to the bells at night, and swore you could hear more than one note.
story.jaymoskingdoms.childhood.blades.ta: As a child you collected everything you came across, a blade, a buckle, a broken bow, and knew every piece of it by heart.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.title: As you grew up, you...
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.sub: Before your present journey, you made a place for yourself in the world.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.cutpurses: Ran with a gang of cutpurses
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.cutpurses.tal: As you grew up you ran with a gang of cutpurses, quick hands and quicker feet.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.levy.tale: As you grew up you marched in a realm's levy, and learned to lead the line.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.apprentice: Swept floors for a court wizard and read his books
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.apprentice.ta: As you grew up you swept a court wizard's floors and read his books when he wasn't looking.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.hermit: Eventually realized you were more capable
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.hermit.tale: As you grew up you eventually realized you were more capable than the folk around you, and the elements answered when you called.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.hunted.tale: As you grew up you hunted for sport, and rarely missed.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.winter: Lived off the land through hard winters
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.winter.tale: As you grew up you lived off the land through hard winters that killed better folk than you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.pits: Fought in the pits for coin
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.pits.tale: As you grew up you fought in the pits for coin, and learned to take a hit.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.gunsmith.tale: As you grew up you worked in a gunsmith's shop, testing every barrel yourself.
story.jaymoskingdoms.youth.messenger.tal: As you grew up you carried messages on horseback, from one end of the land to the other.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.title: Then one day...
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.sub: Something happened that you never quite explained.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.bite: A spider bit you in the dark
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.bite.tale: Then one day a pale spider bit you in the dark, and you shrugged it off, as you always do. The bite never quite healed.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.weapon: A strange weapon came to you
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.weapon.tale: Then one day a strange weapon came into your hands. It never kept one shape for long.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.fall: You fell from a great height
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.fall.tale: Then one day you fell from a great height, and landed as light as a feather.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.storm: A gust lifted you off your feet and set you down gently
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.storm.tale: Then one day a gust lifted you clean off your feet and set you down gently, as if the wind knew your name.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.clock: An old watch in your hands ticked backwards
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.clock.tale: Then one day an old watch in your hands began ticking backwards, and the world went with it, for a moment.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.bell: You heard a bell nobody else heard
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.bell.tale: Then one day you heard a bell ring that nobody else could hear, and felt it in your bones.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.sea: You were lost at sea for a night
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.sea.tale: Then one day you were lost at sea for a whole night, and the deep sang to you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.fists: Your bare fists and spirit won a fight you should have lost
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.fists.tale: Then one day your bare fists and spirit won a fight you should have lost, and something sparked inside you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.smoke: You walked out of a burning field, despite breathing the smoke
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.smoke.tale: Then one day you walked out of a burning field, despite breathing the smoke as if it were air.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.blizzard.tale: Then one day a blizzard caught you far from shelter, and the cold simply stopped biting.
story.jaymoskingdoms.turn.fate.tale: Nothing strange has happened to you, yet. Fate will decide.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.title: What sets you on the road now?
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.city: Down on your luck in a rich city
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.city.tale: Now you are down on your luck in a rich city, with hardly a coin to your name and only the old tools of your trade.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.banished.tale: Now %s has banished you, and you wake beyond its borders.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.cave.tale: Now a caving trip has gone wrong, and you wake deep underground: poisoned, wounded and barely breathing.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.shipwreck.tale: Now your ship lies wrecked on a strange shore, and you crawl out of the debris.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.sworn.tale: Now you have sworn to serve %s, and you stand before its keep.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.village.tale: Now you arrive at a village to start over, in a land like the one you were born to, ready to take up whatever work it has.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.monolith.tale: Now something has drawn you to an ancient monolith. You can feel it humming.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.wild.tale: Now you are alone in the wild, far from anyone.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.skyfall.tale: Now you have fallen from the sky, from somewhere far above, and you drift down into the crater your landing should have made.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.timelost.tale: Now you have slipped out of your own time, and wake in a ruined city a lifetime ahead, with the dead walking its streets.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.burned.tale: Now your village is ash. You wake in what's left of your home, soot on your face, holding the few things you saved.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.snowed: Snowed in on a mountain pass
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.snowed.tale: Now the snows have caught you on a high mountain pass, and you wake half-frozen with only a lantern and a fur coat.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.captive.tale: Now you have cut your ropes and slipped out of a barbarian camp with nothing but your fists, and they are coming after you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.whalers.tale: Now you have signed on with a whaling crew as her harpooner, and you stand on her deck while she fits out for the deep.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.fate.tale: Now fate will decide where your road begins.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.unarmed.tale: Now you set out unarmed, quite literally: you lost a limb long ago, and the stump healed over years back.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.city.wake: You wake inside a realm's capital, with 2 emeralds and your class's gear.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.banished.wake: You wake well past the realm's land with your class's gear. It dislikes you; its rivals like you a little.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.cave.wake: You wake underground, poisoned, wounded and barely breathing, with a pickaxe, torches and your class's gear.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.shipwreck.wake: You wake by a wreck on the shore.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.sworn.wake: You wake at the realm's keep, already sworn to it, in iron armour with a sword, a shield and your class's gear.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.village.wake: You wake by a village of your homeland's kind, with a random job's tools and your class's gear.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.monolith.wake: You wake within sight of a monolith. Its Giant may be near.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.skyfall.wake: You drift down into a crater far from anyone, with shards from somewhere above in your pack.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.timelost.wake: You wake in the future's ruined city with Chrono already awakened (its first ability). The way back is dying, or a Chrono's leap home once you can make one. (If the future hasn't been downloaded yet, you wait between times until it has.)
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.burned.wake: You wake in a burnt-out ruin with a few things you saved.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.snowed.wake: You wake high in the frozen peaks, half-frozen, with a lantern and a fur coat.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.captive.wake: You wake near a barbarian camp with nothing at all. Its raiders hunt you for a day.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.whalers.wake: You wake aboard a realm's whaler fitting out in harbour, signed on as her harpooner with harpoons, shears and oilskins. Come home aboard her for a share of the catch.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.fate.wake: Any of the starts, at random.
story.jaymoskingdoms.road.unarmed.wake: You wake in the wild missing one random arm or leg. It grows back if you die, or with a Hermit Bean.
story.jaymoskingdoms.realm.title: Which realm?
story.jaymoskingdoms.realm.nobles: Name the realm your family held its title in.
story.jaymoskingdoms.realm.nobles.desc: They remember your family: you start with their goodwill.
story.jaymoskingdoms.realm.banished: Name the realm that banished you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.realm.banished.desc: You wake well past its land. It thinks poorly of you, and its rivals think a little better of you for it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.realm.sworn: Name the realm you swore to serve.
story.jaymoskingdoms.realm.sworn.desc: You wake at its keep, sworn to it as a peasant, with its goodwill.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.title: Your life story
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.skip.ask: Would you rather skip the story?
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.skip.desc: Your life is picked at random. You can still read it over and change any of it before you make your character.
story.jaymoskingdoms.gender.title: Who are you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.gender.desc: Your story starts with you. Your face, hair and name are chosen in the character creator after your story.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.summary_sub: Read it over. Once lived, it's yours for life.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.lead: Point at an answer to hear how it goes, and what it gives you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.no_realms: No realm stands in this world yet.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.gives.free: +1 attribute point to spend as you like
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.gives.noble: Goodwill with the realm you name
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.gives.purse: A few extra emeralds to start
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.title: Your story is being written
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.realm: The kingdoms of this land are rising
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.harbour: A whaler is being fitted out for you
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.future: The future is still being made
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hold.arriving: The world takes shape around you
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.gives.echo: Something in you answers this road: it awakens a day sooner
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.captive: The camp has found your cut ropes. Its raiders will hunt you until the day is out.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.whalers: You've signed on %s as her harpooner. Stay aboard: she sails when she's fitted out, and every hand who comes home with her gets a share.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.making.real: The kingdoms of this land are rising. Your story begins in a moment...
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.timelost: This isn't your time. Only death, or a Chrono's leap, will take you home.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.job: The village has work for a %s. Your tools are in your pack, and your work starts when you get there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.story.limb: You've lived without your %s for years.
command.jaymoskingdoms.story.reset: Reset the life story of %s player(s).
gifted.jaymoskingdoms.hover: They awoke to a power, as some do. They'll use it.
gifted.jaymoskingdoms.hover.corrupted: Their power has turned on them. It's wilder now, and darker.
gifted.jaymoskingdoms.hover.master: Few ever wield a power like this. They've made it their own.
gifted.jaymoskingdoms.storm_line.hover: Somewhere back in their family, a Wind user was taken by the storm.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.zfighter.nothing: They have nothing for you right now.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_none: Power? I don't know what you think you saw.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_refuse: What I can do is none of your business.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_hidden: You saw that? It's %s. It woke in me one day. Please, don't tell my family.
Keep your voice down. Yes, it's %s. Hardly anyone knows, and I'd like it to stay that way.
I didn't think anyone was watching. It's %s. I use it as little as I can. Folk talk.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_open.0: %s! Impressive, isn't it? Let them stare, I don't care who knows.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_open.1: It's %s, and I'll use it however I like. Who's going to stop me?
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_open.2: You liked that? That's %s. I'm the only one round here who has it.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_master: %s. I've worked at it for years, alone, where no one could see. You're not to speak of it.
Few would understand what I've made of %s. Fewer still should know. That includes you.
You saw what %s can be, in the right hands. Forget it, if you're wise.
%s. Others have it; none use it like I do. Watch and learn.
I didn't just wake to %s. I mastered it. Let the whole realm know.
%s answers to me as it answers to no one else. Remember that.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.gift_corrup: %s... it isn't what it was. Something's wrong with it. With me.
Stay back. My %s has turned, and I can't always hold it.
It was %s once. Now it whispers. Don't ask me what it says.
job.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.title: Butcher
job.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.desc: Bring the town meat and leather.
job.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.perk.1: Animals you slaughter give an extra cut of meat.
job.jaymoskingdoms.butcher.perk.2: Two extra cuts, and cooked meat fills you more.
job.jaymoskingdoms.woodcutter.title: Woodcutter
job.jaymoskingdoms.woodcutter.desc: Fell trees in town and bring logs and planks.
job.jaymoskingdoms.woodcutter.perk.1: Each chop counts three times, so trees come down far sooner.
job.jaymoskingdoms.woodcutter.perk.2: Fell a whole tree with one chop at its base.
job.jaymoskingdoms.builder.title: Builder
job.jaymoskingdoms.builder.desc: Build in town and bring what the next building needs.
job.jaymoskingdoms.builder.perk.1: Blocks you place in town come out of the storehouse when it has them.
job.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.title: Farmer
job.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.desc: Harvest the town's fields and bring in the crops.
job.jaymoskingdoms.farmer.perk.2: Half your harvests give twice the crop.
job.jaymoskingdoms.miner.title: Miner
job.jaymoskingdoms.miner.desc: Mine ore near town and bring coal, ore and stone.
job.jaymoskingdoms.miner.perk.1: Ore near you glints (only you see it).
job.jaymoskingdoms.miner.perk.2: One ore in three drops twice.
job.jaymoskingdoms.fisher.title: Fisher
job.jaymoskingdoms.fisher.perk.1: Fish bite sooner (as Lure II), with a little luck.
job.jaymoskingdoms.fisher.perk.2: Sooner still (Lure III), and treasure comes up as with Luck of the Sea III.
job.jaymoskingdoms.smith.title: Smith
job.jaymoskingdoms.smith.desc: Smelt ore and bring the town ingots.
job.jaymoskingdoms.smith.perk.1: Anvil work costs half the levels.
job.jaymoskingdoms.smith.perk.2: One ingot in four you take from a furnace comes with a bonus ingot.
job.jaymoskingdoms.hunter.title: Hunter
job.jaymoskingdoms.hunter.desc: Thin out the monsters near town and bring hides, feathers and string.
job.jaymoskingdoms.hunter.perk.1: Tracks show where animals and monsters are walking (only you see them).
job.jaymoskingdoms.hunter.perk.2: Your blows hit beasts half again as hard.
job.jaymoskingdoms.courier.title: Courier
job.jaymoskingdoms.courier.desc: Carry parcels to other towns and realms.
job.jaymoskingdoms.courier.perk.1: Twice the pace on roads, on foot or on horseback.
job.jaymoskingdoms.courier.perk.2: Faster still on roads, and other realms' guards let you pass unless they hate you.
job.jaymoskingdoms.watch.title: of the Watch
job.jaymoskingdoms.watch.desc: Keep watch over the town at night and fight what comes.
job.jaymoskingdoms.watch.perk.1: The town's guards come to your aid when you're attacked in town.
job.jaymoskingdoms.watch.perk.2: Call up to three of the town's guards to follow you.
order.jaymoskingdoms.forge: Hammer out %s pieces at a smithing anvil
order.jaymoskingdoms.night: Keep watch in town for a night
journal.jaymoskingdoms.order.title: %s: %s
journal.jaymoskingdoms.order.text: Work for your job as %s. Each finished order pays %s emeralds at dusk.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.hired: %s takes you on: you're its %s now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.gone: %s is no more, and your work as a %s with it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.fired.reputat: %s has had enough of you. You've lost your work there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.fired.harm: You struck one of %s's own. You've lost your work there.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.disliked: %s won't hire someone it thinks so little of.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.paid: Your wages: %s emeralds from %s for the day's work as a %s (%s orders).
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.paid_short: Your wages: %s emeralds from %s for the day's work as a %s (%s orders). Its storehouse was short.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.quit: You've given up your work as a %s with %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.apprentice: %s is your apprentice now. Each day they'll bring the storehouse goods of their %s's trade and earn you a cut.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.stall_opened: Your stall in %s is open. Leave your goods in it: villagers buy up to %s emeralds' worth a day, from noon.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.stall_refused: That can't be your stall: it must be in %s, and not its storehouse.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.stall_sold: Your stall sold %s emeralds' worth in %s today.
message.jaymoskingdoms.job.none: You have no job. Ask a villager about work, or pull a Help wanted notice off a bounty board.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.none: I've no work to give, friend.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.no_work: There's no work here for anyone.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.barred: After what you did? Come back in a few days, if then.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.greet_short: Looking for work? %s is short of hands: %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.hand: Hand over goods for my orders
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.offer_short: %s, short of hands (%s emeralds an order)
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.hired.0: Good. We need a %s. Your orders come each morning.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.hired.1: A %s? We'll find work for you. See the storehouse when you've something to bring.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.hired.2: Welcome on. A %s earns their keep here, and gets paid at dusk.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.handed: That's %s for the storehouse. Good work.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.mine_words: What is it? You've %s orders open with us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.quit: Give up my work as a %s
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.quit_words: Sorry to lose a %s. Come back if you change your mind.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.apprenticed: Me? Learn the %s's trade from a master? I'll not let you down!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.open_stall: Open a stall of my own
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.stall: Set out a chest or barrel in town and open it: that's your stall.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.next_chosen: The %s it is. The builders will start on it next.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.call_guards: Call the watch to follow me
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.guards_come: %s of the watch will follow you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.no_guards: There's no one of the watch near to send.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.ctx.apprentice: %s! I've been practising the %s's trade like you showed me. What do you need?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.ctx.ruler: %s has work for willing hands. Tell me your trade, and I'll see you're put to it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.ctx.ruler_servi: You serve %s well as our %s. It hasn't gone unnoticed. What is it?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.ctx.guard: The watch could use another pair of eyes after dark, if you've the stomach for it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.ctx.guard_watch: Evening, %s. Same as ever: walk the streets after dark, and put down whatever comes over the wall.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.ctx.same_trade: One of our own! How's the work treating you, %s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.ctx.trade_wante: I'm the %s here, and I could use the help. Want to learn the trade?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.work.ctx.posted: Back to it, %s? You've %s orders open with us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.ashore: I'm a sailor, not a townsman. I've no work to give ashore.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.pirate.captain: Work? Aboard the %s you'd sign our articles and swab her decks for a share of what we take. Not today.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.pirate.hand: I'm her %s. The %s takes what she likes, and I get my share. Talk to the captain if you're brave.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.navy.captain: The %s sails for %s's navy. If you'd serve the crown at sea, take it up with the crown.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.navy.hand: I'm a %s aboard the %s. We keep the sea clear of pirates. The captain's the one to ask about anything else.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.merchant.captai: The %s carries %s's goods, bound for %s. No berths for passengers, but I'd pay well if pirates come at us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.ship.merchant.hand: I'm her %s. The %s carries cargo, and I haul it. Ask the captain about where we're bound.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.ashore: Between voyages. I'll sign on again when she fits out. Ask at the harbour then.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.ashore_mate: We'll sail together again when she fits out, shipmate. Until then, it's dry land for us.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.see_captain: Signing on? The captain's taking on hands for the %s. Go and see him.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.full: Every berth on the %s is filled for this voyage. Come down to the harbour when she next fits out.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.full_hand: We're full up on the %s this voyage. Try again when she's back in port.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.hiring: Looking for a berth? The %s sails for the whaling grounds in about %s minutes. A harpooner's lay is half again a hand's, if you've irons of your own.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.irons_given: Take these from the rack, and don't waste them on the sea.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.signed.harpoo: Our harpooner, then. When the lookout sings out, you're in the first boat with your irons. Welcome aboard the %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.signed.deckha: A deckhand it is. Sails, lines, and the cutting-in when she's alongside. Welcome aboard the %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.signed.monkey: The ship's boy, eh? You'll fetch and carry and keep out from underfoot. Welcome aboard the %s.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.berth.harpoon: You're my harpooner, %s. When we sight a spout you're in the boats, and the first iron in her is yours.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.berth.deckhan: You're a deckhand, %s. Work the lines, mind the tryworks, and lend a hand at the cutting-in.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.berth.monkey: You're our powder monkey, %s. Fetch, carry, keep the tryworks fed, and stay out of the harpooners' way.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.stands.outwar: We're bound out for the whaling grounds.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.stands.huntin: We're on the grounds: %s of %s whales taken. Keep your eyes on the water.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.stands.cuttin: We're cutting in. Mind the blood, the sharks will come.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.stands.homewa: Homeward bound, %s whales in her hold.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.lay.harpooner: A harpooner's lay, half again a hand's: about %s emeralds, as the hold stands now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.lay.deckhand: A hand's lay: about %s emeralds, as the hold stands now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.lay.monkey: A boy's lay: about %s emeralds, as the hold stands now. Grow a bit and earn more.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.mate.harpoone: You're our harpooner. I'm only a %s; the captain's the one to ask about your lay.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.mate.deckhand: You're a deckhand, same as me near enough. I'm her %s. The captain's at the helm if you want your lay.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.mate.monkey: You're the powder monkey, so fetch what you're told. I'm her %s. The captain keeps the book on lays.
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.help.title: Help wanted: %s
quest.jaymoskingdoms.town.help.lore: Pull it off the board to take the job.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.jobs.title: Your jobs
gui.jaymoskingdoms.jobs.hint: Hover a job for its perks
gui.jaymoskingdoms.jobs.about: Ask a villager about work, or pull a Help wanted notice off a bounty board. Orders come each morning, and wages are paid at dusk from the town's storehouse.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.jobs.ranks: Journeyman at %s experience, Master at %s (10 an order). Masters can take an apprentice and open a stall.
message.jaymoskingdoms.info.sovereign: Its crown is worn by %s. The ruler on its throne is their steward.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.abdicated: %s has given up the crown of %s. Its steward now rules in their own right.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.steward_fel: The steward of %s has fallen. %s keeps the crown, and a new steward will sit on the throne by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.new_steward: %s takes the throne of %s as steward.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.usurped: %s has slain their ruler in the hall and seized the crown of %s!
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.inherited: %s, the late ruler's spouse, inherits the crown of %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.fell_in_war: %s, sovereign of %s, has fallen in battle to %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.conquered: %s has claimed the crown of conquered %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.founded: %s has founded the realm of %s and wears its crown.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.yours: The crown of %s is yours. A villager steward keeps the throne while you're away. /kingdom crown abdicate gives it up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.may_claim: You may claim the crown of %s by tomorrow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.no_claim: You have no claim to that crown, or it has lapsed.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.roads: You wear no crown. As a lord, slay your ruler in their own hall; marry a ruler and outlive them; as a lord at war, take an enemy's seat or slay its ruler, then claim it; or found a realm with /kingdom crown found [name] (%s emeralds).
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.overworld: Realms are only founded in the Overworld.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.too_near: This land is too near %s. Found your realm at least %s blocks from any other.
message.jaymoskingdoms.crown.found_cost: Founding a realm takes %s emeralds. You have %s.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.death.desc: Forbidden. Your blade's blows blight: no healing reaches them till it wears off. Sneak and J reaps the downed (your mana back), throws a death bolt at the living, or raises a body lying near as your thrall. Withering hurts you half as much. Casting it corrupts you, and it's a crime where a realm's people see.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.blood.desc: Forbidden. Paid in blood, not mana: what you drink from the bleeding near you, then your own health. Your blade's blows cut. Sneak and J grips a bleeding foe and drags them to you, throws a bolt that cuts, or (at nothing) bursts every cut round you. Bleeding hurts you half as much. Casting it corrupts you, and it's a crime where a realm's people see.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.blight.desc: Who you look at withers, and nothing heals them till it wears off. Healing magic lifts it.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.whispers.des: A body you look at tells you how it died, and how long ago.
For five minutes, the next time you fall you get straight back up. You're a little less alive until you next sleep.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.hemorrhage.d: Every cut on everything bleeding round you bursts at once. Paid in blood.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.blood_grip.d: Who you look at is dragged to you: a monster drops its weapon, a player is weakened. Paid in blood.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.frenzy.desc: Cut yourself for strength a while, and every blow you land heals you a little. Paid in blood.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.too_many: You can hold no more than %s of the dead at once.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.whispers_si: The dead keep their silence. Whatever happened here, it was too long ago.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.door_open: Death's Door stands open behind you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.death.door_used: Death turns you away at the door. You're back on your feet, but something stayed behind. Sleep to win it back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood.too_little: Too little blood left in you to cast that.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood.too_deep: You cast too deep: a wound opens on you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.necroma: Necromancy! Stop them before the dead get up!
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.blood_m: They're tearing the blood out of them! Guards!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.healer.refuse: I know what you are. I'll not lend my hands to your kind. Go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.attuned.vis: The essences you carry have worn a channel through you, and mana runs in it now. You are attuned: you can learn spells from scrolls and cast them with a staff.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.burnt_out: You're burnt out: no magic will come until it passes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.smothered: Something near you smothers your magic: it costs you more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.brimming: You're brimming: the amethyst has nowhere to go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.sick.1: Your head swims with the magic you've pushed through it. Mana will come back slowly for a while.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.sick.2: Mana sickness: you've cast too hard, too fast. You're weak and slow, no mana comes back, and every spell costs more until it passes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.mana.sick.3: You burn out. What mana you had burns out of you, and no magic will come until you've recovered.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.1: Magic? A spark of it. Enough to feel, not much more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.2: I have a steady little flame of it. It does what I ask, mostly.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.3: A fair measure. Most who work magic would call me their equal.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.4: More than most. It burns bright in me, and I've learned to hold it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.tier.5: Few in this world carry what I carry. Mind how you go near me.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.compare.eve: You'll have seen as much in my glow. We're about even, you and I.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.compare.str: Though I see yours burns brighter than mine.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.compare.wea: Yours is a dimmer light than mine, but lights grow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.corrupted: And you... you see it, don't you? Not as the attuned do. Something in you has gone wrong.
message.jaymoskingdoms.magic.blind: You can't see it, can you? Only the attuned see the glow.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.unattuned: The wand is dead in your hand: you aren't attuned.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.full: The wand can hold no more.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.nothing: You have no mana to pour.
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.poured: Poured %s mana into the wand (%s of %s)
message.jaymoskingdoms.wand.empty: The wand is empty. Sneak and use it to pour mana in.
item.jaymoskingdoms.mana_wand.use: Sneak and use: pour your mana in. Use at an attuned player: give it to them. Use at nothing: draw it back.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.name: Grimsby
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.name: Varro
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.name: Ambrose
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.name: Thessaly
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.quiet.name: The Quiet One
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.sick.begin: Something has noticed you. Your mana runs thin and you dream of hands. Give it a few days, or stir it by casting and meditating.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.woke: %s has woken. Press L to call it, sneak and tap L to pick a move, sneak and hold L to send it away.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.no_mana: Not enough mana for that move.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.no_moves: Your spirit knows no moves yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.arms: Your spirit has grown a second pair of hands.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.release.as: Releasing your spirit is for good, and it will hurt. No other will come. Say /kingdom spirit release again within 30 seconds to be sure.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.release.do: Your spirit is gone. The mana goes with it.
key.jaymoskingdoms.spirit: Mana Spirit (tap: call or cast; sneak + tap: next move; sneak + hold: send away)
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.hold.on: The spirit takes hold of what is in your off hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.hold.off: The spirit puts its hands away.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.hold.nothi: Carry a shield or a torch in your off hand for the spirit to hold.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.wake.1: Hm. Awake, am I. Four hundred years of study and the first thing I see is you. Wonderful.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.wake.2: There. Hands, arms, a bad temper. All present. Try not to get us killed before breakfast.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.wake.3: So you are the one who kept pulling at my sleeve. Fine. I am up. Do not thank me.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.summon.1: Yes, yes, I am coming. Must you always shout?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.summon.2: Called again. I had just got comfortable. Well, what is it this time?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.summon.3: Out I come. Stand behind me, and for once do as you are told.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.dismiss.1: Finally, a little quiet. Do try to stay alive while I am gone.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.dismiss.2: Back to my book, then. Do not touch anything that glows.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.dismiss.3: Off I go. Wake me if something truly dreadful happens. Not before.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.tired.1: You have drained us both dry. Rest, child. I mean it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.tired.2: I cannot hold a shape on an empty well. Sit down and drink something.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.tired.3: Enough. Even a wizard of my years has limits, and you have found them.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.kill.1: Hm. Tidy enough. I have seen worse, mostly from you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.kill.2: One less thing to swat. Do not look so pleased about it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.kill.3: Dead. Good. Now watch your feet next time.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.hurt.1: You are bleeding. Of course you are. Stand still.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.hurt.2: I told you to duck. I distinctly remember telling you to duck.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.hurt.3: Careful! Do you know how long it takes to train a keeper? Do not answer that.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.low.1: Mind your health, child. I am not minded to bury you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.low.2: You are one bad step from the grave. I would rather not write the letter.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.low.3: Back away. Heal. Please. I am too old to start over with another one.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.idle.1: Four hundred years of study and I spend them watching you stare at the sky.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.idle.2: Nice quiet day. Suspicious, that. Keep your eyes open.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.idle.3: Do you ever sit still? No? I thought not.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.bond.1: We seem to be growing used to each other. Do not let it go to your head.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.bond.2: I find I do not mind you quite so much. Do not tell anyone I said that.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.bond.3: You are, I suppose, tolerable company. Do not make me say it twice.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.level.1: I feel sharper. Do not imagine it was your doing. Well, a little of it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.level.2: More power, then. Try to use it with sense for once.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.level.3: Hm, stronger. Good. You will need it, the way you behave.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.act.1: Behind you! Honestly. Where were your eyes?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.act.2: Hold still. There. I am not doing that every time, you know.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.act.3: That would have hurt. You are welcome. No, do not thank me.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.release.1: So that is the end of it. I will not say I shall miss you. Take care of yourself, child.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.release.2: Gone, then. Mind the dark, and do not walk into caves at night. Some habits I shall not miss.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.release.3: Fine. Fine! I am free of you. Why does that feel so quiet?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.move.1: Watch the edge. Edge first, not hilt first.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.move.2: A clean line. Try to remember how that felt.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.move.3: Steel of aura, and still you swing like a farmer.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.sick.1: ...hm. Someone is awake in here. Is it too early for complaining?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.sick.2: ...child. I can hear you breathing. Stop worrying so loudly.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.sick.3: ...nearly there. Be still. You are making this far harder than it need be.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.sick.4: ...I can almost see your face. A young one. They always send a young one.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.sick.5: ...Open your eyes, child. I am here. Four hundred years of study, and I am here.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.advice.cas: A caster. Close the gap and cut it off mid-word, or hide. Do not stand and admire the sparks.
Robes and pointing. Spellwork, child. Break its line of sight, then strike.
Its hands are glowing. Do not wait to see why. Move.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.advice.arc: Archer. Do not run in a straight line, you fool. Zig, then zag.
A bow on you. Get behind something solid, or close in fast.
Arrows. Strafe, child. It cannot hit what keeps moving.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.advice.cre: A creeper. Back away. Hit it once and retreat, do not stand and trade.
That hissing is not friendly. Distance, child. Distance!
Green and silent. I have seen better men than you blown into the next valley.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.advice.arm: Plate on that one. Break its guard first, then cut.
Steel will shrug off your pokes. Use the axe, or the hammer. Think!
Armoured. Do not waste strength on the iron. Wait for a gap.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.advice.man: Too many. Do not fight them in the open. Find a wall and put it at your back.
A crowd. Back to a corner, child, and sweep wide.
Count them. No, do not count them, move. Greatsword, and keep your back clear.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.advice.big: That one is large. Large means slow. Stay out of reach and take your time.
Mind the size of it. Strike its legs, then step away.
A big one. Do not stand toe to toe. You are not built for it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.advice.foe: Something wants you dead. As usual. Face it and keep your guard up.
Hostile. Watch its hands and not its face. Hands are where the danger lives.
Mind it, child. I will help, but I will complain the whole time.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.wake.1: On your feet, recruit! Old Varro reporting. Try to look like you meant to wake me.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.wake.2: Awake and armed. Good. What is the situation? No, do not tell me, I can smell it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.wake.3: At ease. No, not at ease. Stand up straight, recruit. We have work.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.summon.1: Varro here! Point me at them!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.summon.2: Called and ready. Name your target, recruit.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.summon.3: Reporting! Do not make me wait on you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.dismiss.1: Standing down. Keep your guard up, recruit.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.dismiss.2: Dismissed. Stay sharp. I am only a call away.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.dismiss.3: Fall out, then. Do not do anything stupid.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.tired.1: Out of mana, recruit! Fall back and recover.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.tired.2: Dry well. No more throwing until you rest. That is an order.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.tired.3: Cannot hold the line on nothing. Rest. Now.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.kill.2: That is how it is done. Not pretty, but done.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.hurt.1: You are hit! Stay on your feet!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.hurt.2: Move, recruit! Do not stand there bleeding!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.low.1: Health is low! Fall back, recruit! That is an order!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.low.2: Pull back and patch yourself up. I will not carry you home.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.low.3: Casualty in the making! Retreat, drink, and return.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.idle.1: Quiet. Too quiet. I do not like it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.idle.2: Keep your head up, recruit. Peace does not last.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.idle.3: Check your gear. Check it again. Good.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.bond.1: You listen better than most, recruit. It does not go unnoticed.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.bond.2: Fine soldier, you are turning into. Do not let it go to your head.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.bond.3: We have fought well together. Keep it that way.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.level.1: Stronger! Good. Now use it wisely, recruit.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.level.2: Promoted, as it were. Do not make me regret it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.level.3: More power in these hands. Aim true.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.act.3: I have it! Hold your ground, recruit!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.release.1: Dismissed for good, recruit. You were a decent soldier. Do not forget what I taught you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.release.2: My watch is over. Keep your head down and your guard up. Farewell.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.release.3: So be it. It was an honour, recruit. Do not tell anyone I said so.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.move.3: Hit them where they are weakest, recruit.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.sick.1: ...report... somebody is out there... who goes there?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.sick.2: ...recruit? Is that you? Stand easy... I am coming through.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.sick.3: ...nearly through the fog. Hold your position, recruit. Hold it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.sick.4: ...I can see you now. Skinny little thing. Fine. We shall make a soldier of you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.sick.5: ...Wake up, recruit! Old Varro is here! On your feet!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.caste: Caster ahead! Close in or break line of sight! Do not stand and gawk!
Robes and sparks. Hit it before it finishes its chant, recruit!
Spellcaster! Rush it or take cover. Decide now!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.arche: Archer! Keep moving, recruit! Do not give it a straight line!
Bow on you! Cover, then close in!
Eyes up! Arrows incoming. Weave, recruit, weave!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.creep: Creeper! Back off! Throw from range, recruit!
That hiss is a fuse! Fall back! Javelin it from here!
Green menace! Do not close! Fire from distance!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.armou: Heavy armour! Do not waste throws on plate. Bombard it, recruit!
Iron on that one. Break it with weight, not speed!
Armoured! Mark it and hit it with everything you have!
Eyes up, recruit! Three on the ridge. Throw when I say. Now!
Many contacts! Fall back to a choke point. Volley when they bunch!
Too many to count! Spear wall! Hold the line!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.big.1: Big one! Keep your distance and hit it with the bombard, recruit!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.big.2: Large target. Easy to hit, hard to stop. Mark it and keep throwing!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.big.3: Heavy hitter! Do not trade blows. Kite it, recruit!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.foe.1: Contact! Hostile ahead. Weapons ready, recruit!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.foe.2: Enemy sighted. Stand your ground and throw on my word.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.advice.foe.3: Here they come! Steady. Steady. Now!
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.aegis.soak: The ward takes the blow and fades.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.steady.off: The hands let go of your shoulders.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.wake.1: There we are. Slowly, little one. Slowly. You have had a rough few days, and I have been waiting for you to come round.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.wake.2: Ah. Good morning, little one. Do not try to stand just yet. I am Ambrose, and I do not intend to go anywhere.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.wake.3: Hello, little one. What a fright you gave us both. Never mind. I have you now, and I am in no hurry at all.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.summon.1: Here I am, little one. No need to shout. I heard you the first time.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.summon.2: Of course, of course. Let me have a look at you. Good. Still in one piece.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.summon.3: Up and about, then. Lead on. I shall be a step behind you, as always.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.dismiss.1: Rest well, little one. Call if you need me. I will hear.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.dismiss.2: Back to my chair, then. Mind the stairs, and mind your temper.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.dismiss.3: Off you go. Eat something. Drink something. Come back whole.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.tired.1: The well is nearly dry, little one. Sit a while. The world will keep.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.tired.2: Gently now. You have given a great deal today. Let us rest, the pair of us.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.tired.3: No more for now, little one. A candle needs time to be a candle again.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.kill.1: There. Well done. It is never a happy thing, but it was needful.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.kill.2: That is that, then. Catch your breath, little one. You did nicely.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.kill.3: Quite safe now. Quite safe. Let your shoulders down.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.hurt.1: Oh, that stung. Hold still, little one, I have you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.hurt.2: Easy, easy. A scratch. We have both had worse.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.hurt.3: Breathe. It always hurts most in the first moment.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.low.1: Little one, you are very pale. Step back. Let an old man worry for you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.low.2: That is quite enough of that. Away from the fight, and let me mend you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.low.3: Please, little one. Retreat. I have buried enough good people for one lifetime.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.idle.1: Lovely light today. Do you ever stop to look at it, little one?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.idle.2: I was just thinking of an old friend of mine who kept bees. Terrible temper, wonderful honey.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.idle.3: No hurry at all. The road will be there when we get to it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.bond.1: You know, little one, I have grown very fond of this arrangement.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.bond.2: I used to count the years. Now I count the mornings I get to spend with you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.bond.3: We understand one another better now, you and I. It is a rare, quiet sort of gift.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.level.1: I feel a little stronger, little one. Your doing, I think, not mine.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.level.2: There. A touch more light in these old hands. Use it kindly.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.level.3: How nice. I had thought I was done learning. Thank you, little one.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.act.2: There, there. Stay close to me, little one.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.act.3: No, no, none of that. Let an old man do his job.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.release.1: Then this is goodbye, little one. Be kind to yourself. I shall think of you often, in the quiet.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.release.2: I understand. I do. Go gently, and do not forget to eat your supper.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.release.3: It has been an honour to look after you. Farewell, little one. Farewell.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.move.1: Steady. Breathe in, breathe out. That is all magic really is.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.move.2: Good, good. Gentle hands do the best work.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.move.3: Just so. Not a moment too soon, and not a moment too late.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.sick.1: ...little one? Do not be frightened. I am only here. I shall be here the whole time.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.sick.2: ...rest. There is no hurry. I am sitting beside you, and I shall not leave.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.sick.3: ...nearly there. Doing wonderfully. Just a little longer, little one.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.sick.4: ...I can see your face now. A kind one. I had hoped it would be a kind one.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.sick.5: ...open your eyes, little one. Gently. It is Ambrose. I have been waiting so patiently.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.advice.cas: A caster, little one. Do not stand and watch it. Get behind something solid, or close the distance quickly.
See how its hands glow? Spells are coming. Keep moving, and a blessing of resistance may do you good.
Magic, little one. Never fight a spell head on. Go around it, and break its sight.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.advice.arc: An archer. Easy now. Do not run in a straight line, there is a dear. Weave a little.
Bow in hand. Get close, or get behind a wall, and a blessing of speed will help you do either.
It is taking aim at you, little one. Steady hands, steady feet. Move when it draws.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.advice.cre: A creeper, little one. Easy now. Back away slowly. It cannot hurt what it cannot reach.
That quiet hiss is not a friendly sound. Step back, breathe, and give it room.
Do not hurry it. A little patience, a little distance, and it is nothing at all.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.advice.arm: That one wears a great deal of iron, little one. Strength will serve you better than speed here.
Armoured. Be patient. Find the gaps in the plate. There are always gaps.
Do not waste your breath on the iron, dear. Wait for it to tire, and strike when it does.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.advice.man: Oh, so many of them. Keep your back to a wall, little one, and stay light on your feet.
A crowd. Do not let them circle you. Step back, a little at a time, and let me ward you.
Quite a gathering. Breathe, little one. One at a time, and quickly, before they surround you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.advice.big: That is a large one. Large things are slow, little one. Keep your distance and your temper.
Big fellow. Do not trade blows with it. Strike, step away, and strike again.
Mind the size of its reach, dear. Patience wins against anything that big.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.advice.foe: Something means you harm, little one. Face it calmly. I am right behind you.
Easy now. Watch its hands, not its face. Hands tell you what comes next.
Another one. Do not rush. The skeleton is not going anywhere, and neither am I.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.unseen.los: Something unseen plucks the item from your off hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.unseen.not: There is nothing there for the unseen hand to take.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.unlock.bey: This lock is beyond Thessaly. She must be at least level %s to open it.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.wake.1: Ah. Awake at last. Good morning, dear. Do sit up straight, we have a great deal of reading to get through.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.wake.2: There we are. Fingers, thumbs, a perfectly serviceable glove. Now, how much of the Elementary Theory do you remember? None. Splendid, we shall begin at the top.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.wake.3: Oh, it is you. You have been pulling at my page-marker for days, dear. Fetch me a chair, will you? No? Then we shall stand.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.summon.1: Yes, yes, dear, I am coming. Do mind the margins of your aura, they are most untidy.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.summon.2: Called again! I was in the middle of a footnote. Well, what is it this time?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.summon.3: Out I come. Hands where I can see them, dear, and no mumbling the incantations.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.dismiss.1: Back to my library, then. Read something, dear. Anything. The labels on the potions will do.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.dismiss.2: Off I go. Do not touch the glowing things, and do not, I beg, try to pronounce anything on your own.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.dismiss.3: Very well. I shall be in the footnotes should you require a grown-up.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.tired.1: You are quite dry, dear. A scholar cannot work on an empty well. Sit down and drink something.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.tired.2: No more mana, no more magic. It is in chapter one, dear. Chapter one! Rest.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.tired.3: I must withdraw. Even the learned have limits, and you have found mine. Do eat something.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.kill.1: Dead. Tidy enough, though your footwork was dreadful. We shall practise.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.kill.2: Well. That is one less interruption. Do not look so pleased with yourself, dear.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.kill.3: Hm, yes, that will do. I shall give it a B. A generous B.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.hurt.1: You are bleeding, dear. It is on the carpet. Well, the grass. Do hold still.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.hurt.2: Ow! No, not me. You. Do try to put your guard up, dear, it is on page eleven.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.hurt.3: Careful! That sort of thing is perfectly avoidable with a little reading.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.low.1: Dear, you are rather more hole than person just now. Retreat. Heal. Immediately.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.low.2: I did not spend all this time on your education to see it end in a ditch. Back away!
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.low.3: One more blow and I shall have to take notes on your funeral. Please do not make me.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.idle.1: Did you know that the third Archmage of Vael wrote nine hundred pages on sleeping? You might read one.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.idle.2: That was a fireball, dear, not a 'fire thingy'. Again, and mind your wrist.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.idle.3: Quiet at last. Shall we review the vowels of the Old Tongue? No? Pity. They are lovely vowels.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.bond.1: We are getting along rather well, dear. I shall note it in the margin. In pencil, mind.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.bond.2: You are, I admit, an improving student. Do not let it go to your head, it is a small head.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.bond.3: I find I have grown used to your company. Good marks for effort, dear. Not for spelling.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.level.1: Ah, I feel better read already. Do not suppose it was your doing, dear. Well, a little.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.level.2: A new chapter opens. Try to retain this one, dear. There will be a quiz.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.level.3: Promoted, as it were. Stronger fingers, longer reach. Do use them for something improving.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.act.1: Arrow, dear! Honestly, did you not hear it? It was whistling quite clearly.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.act.2: There. Caught it. A scholar's hands are quicker than they look. Do say thank you.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.act.3: Not on my watch, dear. I have not finished your education yet.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.loot.1: There is a chest behind that wall, dear. No, the other wall.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.loot.2: I do not wish to interfere, but there is a chest not far from here that you have not opened. Observe more, dear.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.loot.3: Mm, a chest, just there, with something in it. I had it down as the first thing a keeper notices. Page four.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.release.1: So that is the end of our lessons. You were a middling student, dear, but mine. Mind your pronunciation.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.release.2: Gone, then. I shall return to my books. Do not cast anything you cannot spell.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.release.3: Very well, dear. Class dismissed. Why does the library feel so quiet?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.move.1: Fingers together, dear, and lead with the wrist. There. Pretty, isn't it?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.move.2: Properly done, that. I shall want you to write it out a hundred times.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.move.3: The word is 'manus', dear, not 'mah-nuss'. Still, the hand worked.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.sick.1: ...hm? A student, already? Do forgive me, I am not dressed for lessons yet.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.sick.2: ...I can hear you, dear. Do stop fretting about it so loudly. It is very hard to concentrate.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.sick.3: ...nearly there. Just a moment while I find my spectacles. Sit up, there's a good child.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.sick.4: ...ah, a young one. Quite young. They always send the young ones. Where is my ink?
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.sick.5: ...open your eyes, dear. Thessaly the Learned, at your service. We have such a lot to get through.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.advice.ca: A caster, dear. Interrupt the incantation, a rule I set down in chapter seven. Break its line of sight or strike it down mid-word.
Robes, a staff, a smug look. A spellcaster. Do not stand and admire the sparks, close the distance.
Its hands are glowing, dear, and that is never good. Move out of its line, then cut it short.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.advice.ar: A bowman has you. Do not run in a straight line, dear, it is the most tedious thing a target can do. Weave.
Arrows incoming. Get behind something solid or leave me to catch them. I do so love catching things.
Archer. Close the gap in a zigzag, dear. A zigzag. Z, not S.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.advice.cr: A creeper, dear. It hisses before it bursts: a fact of natural philosophy. Back away, quickly.
That green thing is about to disprove your continued existence. Distance, dear! Distance!
Do not hit it and stand there. Hit it and retreat. Hit and retreat. I have drawn a diagram.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.advice.ar: Plate on that one, dear. Do not waste your strength on iron, it is not clever. Wait for a gap, or let a trap do the work.
Armoured. A glyph on the ground might pin it nicely, dear, if you can lure it onto one.
Steel will shrug off your pokes. Use your head, dear. It has always been the best tool you have. Marginally.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.advice.ma: Far too many, dear. Do not fight them in the open. Find a wall, lay a rune or two, and let them come.
A crowd. Back to a corner and sweep wide, or juggle a few of the little ones. Think, dear, think!
Count them. No, do not count them, dear, move. Corners are lovely things.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.advice.bi: That is a very large specimen. Keep your distance, dear, and do not stand where it can step. Lay a rune.
Big. Slow, probably, and strong, certainly. Circle it, dear. Circles are friendly.
The bigger they are, dear, the more they have to think about. Bring it somewhere with a glyph, and strike when it stumbles.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.advice.fo: Something wishes you ill, dear. Face it properly. Feet apart, guard up, as I have shown you.
A foe. Do not rush, dear, think. Where is the nearest wall? Where is the nearest exit? Good.
Something hostile. Keep calm and recite the three rules of battle. What are they? Never mind, I shall remind you as we go.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.mirror.non: There is no room to step.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.silent.non: Nothing weak enough is within reach.
message.jaymoskingdoms.spirit.execute.no: No one lies helpless within reach.
Hah. Forty years of steel and you thought to out-shove me? Sit down, whelp.
Locked arms, was it? I've broken better wrists than that over my knee.
Done. Now stop gawping and sharpen something.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.grimsby.clash.lose: Bah! My grip slipped, that's all. Don't you dare say otherwise.
Out-pushed by a ghost with a hobby. Wonderful. I'm too old for this.
Fine, fine, they were stronger. Next time you tap faster, lad.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.clash.win.1: The line holds, and theirs breaks. Pick yourself up, keeper, we march on.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.clash.win.2: Gate's down. That is how a siege is won: one push at a time.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.clash.win.3: Victory. Mark it in the ledger and tell the cooks we eat well tonight.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.clash.lose.1: Fall back! Regroup! We lost the ground, not the war.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.clash.lose.2: A breach in our line. Note it, learn from it, and never let it happen twice.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.varro.clash.lose.3: They out-pressed us. Good. Now we know how hard they push.
There, there, child. No harm meant. I only wished to keep you safe.
Well pushed, little one. The old walls still stand, you see.
Gently now. Strength is for guarding, never for gloating.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.ambrose.clash.lose: Ah, I was bested. How very good for my humility.
Mind your bruises, dear one. A warden may yield and still watch over you.
They pushed true. Come, we shall rest, and try again when the dawn is kind.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.clash.win: Fascinating! The force of will alone decided it. I must write this down.
Observe: two wills, one outcome. A tidy result, and a lovely bit of data.
We prevailed! Do remind me to note exactly how.
spirit.jaymoskingdoms.thessaly.clash.los: Oh, how curious. We lost, and I wonder precisely why.
A most instructive defeat. I shall want to study that grip.
Hm. My hypothesis was wrong. Delightful. We try again.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.pirate.0: Keep your hands off the hold. That's crew's share.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.pirate.1: Wind's fair, sea's empty. Means nobody to rob.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.pirate.2: Saw a navy sail at dawn. The captain only laughed.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.pirate.3: Rum's watered again. I know who did it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.pirate.4: There's a chest of Spanish gold on %s somewhere. Nobody's found it yet.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.pirate.5: I'd sooner hang than go back to farming.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.pirate.6: Cutlass needs an edge. So does the cook.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.pirate.7: Ever seen a man walk the plank? Quiet, after the splash.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.navy.0: For the crown, and the sea lanes clear.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.navy.1: Pirates spotted off the point last week. We'll have them yet.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.navy.2: Keep clear of the guns, if you please.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.navy.3: Polish, drill, watch. Polish, drill, watch.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.navy.4: My father served on %s's old namesake. Sank under him.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.navy.5: The armour's no help if you go over the side. Mind your footing.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.navy.6: Steady sea today. The gunners will be bored.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.navy.7: Orders are to patrol and wait. So we patrol, and we wait.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.merchant.0: Cargo's dry and the hold's sound. Good trip so far.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.merchant.1: Every pirate on the coast wants what we carry.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.merchant.2: We'll make harbour by nightfall if the wind holds.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.merchant.3: Wool, sugar, paper, honey. Half the realm's in our hold.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.merchant.4: The captain counts every barrel twice.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.merchant.5: I've sailed %s for years. She's slow but she's honest.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.merchant.7: If you see black sails, shout. Loudly.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.whaler.0: Keep the harpoons clear, they're sharp as sin.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.whaler.1: Thar's oil in these waters. You can smell it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.whaler.2: A great whale can stove a boat with one swing of its tail.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.whaler.3: Nobody gets rich whaling. We just get by and smell of it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.whaler.4: Tryworks fire's the warmest place aboard.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.whaler.5: I've seen a whale the size of a church.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.whaler.6: When the boats go down, pull hard and pray.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.whaler.7: %s has a hold full of empty barrels. Not for long.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.monkey.1: I'm quick. Quickest on the ship.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.monkey.2: The guns are loud. I like it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.monkey.3: When I'm grown I'll have my own ship.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.monkey.4: The cook says I'm too small for a cutlass. I'm not.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.monkey.5: Don't tell the captain I was asleep.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.monkey.6: I can climb to the top of the mast. Want to see?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.monkey.7: Gunpowder smells better than the bilge.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.captain.pirat: %s answers to me, and the sea answers to no one.
Every ship we sight is a purse we've not opened yet.
Loyal hands get a share. Disloyal ones get the plank.
Navy thinks they rule these waters. Let 'em think it.
%s keeps these waters safe for honest folk.
My crew are the finest in the realm. They'd better be.
State your business aboard, and keep out of the gunners' way.
We fly the realm's colours. Pirates know what that means.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.captain.merch: Fair winds and a full hold, that's all I ask.
Trade keeps the realms at peace, more than any army.
If there's trouble, we run. %s was built for speed, not fighting.
Every barrel is counted, and every barrel is paid for.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.captain.whale: One good whale fills %s with oil and her crew with coin.
We hunt the great ones. It's honest work, if bloody.
Watch the water for spouts. First to sight one gets a bonus.
Lower the boats on my word and not before.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.welcome.pirat: Well now, a visitor on %s. Mind you stay friendly.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.welcome.navy: Welcome aboard %s. Stay clear of the guns.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.welcome.whale: Welcome aboard %s. Mind the blubber, it's slippery.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.welcome.hand: Back aboard %1$s, %2$s? Good. Stow your gear and lend a hand.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.to_hand.0: Oi, %1$s! Coil that line before someone trips on it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.to_hand.1: Keep your eyes on the water, %1$s. First to sight a spout gets an extra share.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.to_hand.2: You're doing all right for a new %1$s. Don't let it go to your head.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.to_hand.3: %1$s! Fetch a bucket, this deck won't scrub itself.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.to_hand.4: Stay off the tryworks when they're lit, %1$s, unless you fancy losing your eyebrows.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.to_hand.5: Every hand on %2$s pulls their weight. That means you too, %1$s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.man_down.2: Someone's hurt! Stay down, I'm on my way!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.man_down.3: Don't you die on this deck! I'm coming!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.up.0: Up you get, %s. Nobody dies on my watch.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.up.1: There. You'll live, %s. Try not to do that again.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.up.2: Easy now, %s. Lean on me till your legs come back.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.up.3: You owe me a drink for that, %s.
story.jaymoskingdoms.mate.2: If the mate catches you idling, %s, it's the bilges for you. What do you want?
story.jaymoskingdoms.mate.4: Make it quick, %s, there's work to do.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.city.0: New in the city, are you? You've the look of someone who's spent their last coin.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.city.1: I saw you sleeping in the gutter by the market. Things are hard here if you've no purse.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.city.2: %s is a fine place if you're rich. You don't look rich, friend.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.banished.0: I know your face. You're the one %s threw out. You've some nerve showing it here.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.banished.1: Word came from %s about you. Banished, they said. I'd keep moving if I were you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.banished.2: The exile from %s! Whatever you did, it must have been bad.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.cave.0: Gods, you look half dead. Did you crawl out of a cave?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.cave.1: There's cave dust all over you, and that bite looks nasty. You should rest.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.cave.2: We heard someone went down into the caves and didn't come up. Was that you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.shipwreck.0: You're from the wreck on the shore, aren't you? I didn't think anyone lived through that.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.shipwreck.1: Still dripping seawater, I see. Was it a storm that sank you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.shipwreck.2: The tide's been washing planks and barrels up all morning. Yours, I take it?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.sworn.0: You're the new one sworn to %s. Serve it well and it'll look after you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.sworn.1: So you're %s's latest recruit. Don't let the old hands push you around.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.sworn.2: I heard you took the oath to %s. Not everyone means it, you know.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.village.0: You're the newcomer! Looking for work? There's always something that needs doing.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.village.1: Starting over here, are you? Plenty have. Nobody asks too many questions.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.village.2: Welcome to the village. Settle in, and keep your tools sharp.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.monolith.0: You came from the monolith, didn't you? Nobody goes near that stone if they can help it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.monolith.1: There's a look in your eyes, like the ones the stone calls. Be careful.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.monolith.2: That old stone has been humming since you turned up. I don't like it.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.wild.0: You've been out in the wild a while, by the look of you. Not many come this way alone.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.wild.1: Out of the woods at last! You look like you've been sleeping rough.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.wild.2: A traveller on foot, and alone? You're either brave or lost.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.skyfall.0: Something fell out of the sky last night and left a crater. Wait, that was you?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.skyfall.1: I saw a light come down over the hills. And here you are, without a scratch.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.skyfall.2: Folk are saying a stranger dropped from the clouds. You don't look like an angel.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.timelost.0: You talk strangely, and your clothes are stranger still. Where are you from?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.timelost.1: You keep looking around as if nothing's where it should be. Are you well?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.timelost.2: You look lost, and not the kind of lost a map would help with.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.burned.0: You smell of smoke. You're from the village that burned, aren't you? I'm sorry.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.burned.1: We saw the smoke for miles. Did anyone else get out?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.burned.2: There's ash in your hair. The fire, was it raiders?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.snowed.0: You came down from the pass? In this cold? You're lucky you've still got your fingers.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.snowed.1: Get by a fire, you're blue to the bone. The pass is no place to be caught by snow.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.snowed.2: Snowed in up on the peaks, were you? Most who are don't come down.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.captive.0: Those marks on your wrists, you've been in chains. Did you get away from the camp?
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.captive.1: Keep your head down. If the raiders lost a captive, they'll come looking.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.captive.2: You ran from the raiders' camp? Brave. Or mad. Either way, they won't forget you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.whalers.0: You're one of the new hands on the whaler, aren't you? Mind the harpoons.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.whalers.1: Signed on with the whalers, eh? Come back rich, or don't come back at all.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.whalers.2: Whaling's hard work and the sea doesn't care. Good luck out there, sailor.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.unarmed.0: That old wound of yours has healed well. You manage, I see.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.unarmed.1: Don't mind the children staring. They've not seen anyone get by short a limb before.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.unarmed.2: You've been through something, that's plain. Still on your feet, though.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.fate.0: You turned up out of nowhere. Some say that's an omen.
story.jaymoskingdoms.met.fate.1: I had a dream about a stranger last night. And here you are.
