story.jaymoskingdoms.met.fate.2: Funny, I feel like I've been expecting you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.kindhe: Anyone falls overboard, I'll be the first one in after them.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.cheerf: Lovely day on the water, isn't it?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.devout: The sea's in higher hands than ours. I pray every watch.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.dutifu: Orders are orders. I do my watch and I do it well.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.brave: Storm or broadside, I don't flinch.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.proud: Best hand on this ship, and everyone knows it.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.greedy: What's in it for me? Always ask that, at sea.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.suspic: Don't know you. Don't trust you. Keep your hands where I can see them.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.timid: I hope we don't meet any pirates. Or storms. Or whales.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.hothea: Say one more word about my knots and you'll swim home.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.spitef: The last fellow who crossed me tripped over the rail. Shame.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.temper.gloomy: The sea takes everyone in the end.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.crew.title: Captain
standing.jaymoskingdoms.crew.hover.pirat: A pirate ship of %s: she hunts anything that isn't a pirate
standing.jaymoskingdoms.crew.hover.navy: A warship of %s: she hunts pirates, and the realm's enemies
standing.jaymoskingdoms.crew.hover.merch: A merchantman of %s, bound for another realm's harbour: she runs from pirates
standing.jaymoskingdoms.crew.hover.whale: A whaler of %s, out after the great whales
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.signs_on.0: Count me in for the next one. The sea's in my blood.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.signs_on.1: Put my name down again. %s won't sail without me.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.signs_on.2: One more voyage. Then I'll think about land.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.signs_on.3: Ashore's too quiet. I'll be at the pier when she fits out.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.leaves.0: That's my lay, and that's me done with whales. Farewell, %s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.leaves.1: A full purse and dry boots. I'm staying ashore.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.leaves.2: I've seen enough blubber for a lifetime. I'll find work in town.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.crew.leaves.3: Don't wait for me. I'm going to spend every emerald of this.
message.jaymoskingdoms.whaler.paid_off: %1$s's crew are paid off: %2$s sign on for her next voyage, %3$s go ashore with their pay.
standing.jaymoskingdoms.crew.in_port.hov: Signed on again: they wait about the harbour and go out with the realm's next whaler
history.jaymoskingdoms.for.revived_you: getting them back on their feet
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.nothing.1: You're welcome, I suppose. Whatever it was.
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.late.soft.0: Oh, that? It's been days! Don't give it another thought.
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.late.soft.1: I wondered if you'd remember. You're welcome, truly.
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.late.hard.0: Took you long enough. But you're welcome.
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.late.hard.1: Days later, and now you say it? Hmph. Fine.
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.revived_you: Thank the stars you're all right. You gave me such a fright, lying there.
Don't thank me, just keep that bandage clean. And be careful, %1$s!
Anyone would have done the same. Keep the wound clean.
You're welcome. Try to stay on your feet this time.
Don't make a habit of it. I've better things to do than kneel in the dirt.
Yes, yes. Next time watch yourself, and spare me the trouble.
Thanks are nice. Coin is nicer. Remember that next time you're bleeding.
You owe me, %1$s. I'll be sure to remember it, even if you don't.
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.led_you.sof: My pleasure. I hope the audience went well!
Glad to help. Not everyone gets that far, you know.
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.led_you.pla: Just doing my duty. Mind your manners at court.
That's what the post is for. You're welcome.
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.led_you.har: I didn't do it for you. Orders are orders.
Save your thanks. Just don't make me regret it.
history.jaymoskingdoms.thank.led_you.gre: A thank-you. How generous. A coin wouldn't have hurt.
Next time you want walking somewhere, bring something shiny.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.nothing.0: Sorry? For what? We're fine, you and I.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.nothing.1: I can't think what you'd need to be sorry for.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.kin.0: Sorry? %2$s is in the ground, and you're sorry? Get away from me.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.kin.1: Words won't bring %2$s back. Nothing you say ever will.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.taken.sof: Oh, thank you for saying so. Let's put it behind us.
That means a lot. All's forgiven, %1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.taken.pla: Well. Fair enough. We'll say no more about it.
Apology accepted. Just don't let it happen again.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.taken.har: Hmph. I didn't expect that from you. Fine, it's forgotten.
You've got some spine to come and say it. All right. Done.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.spurned.s: I want to believe you. I just... can't, not yet.
It still hurts. Give me time, %1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.spurned.p: Sorry doesn't undo it. I'll remember either way.
Easy to say. Show me, don't tell me.
history.jaymoskingdoms.apology.spurned.h: Keep your sorry. I don't want it.
Sorry? You'll be sorry. Get out of my sight.
history.jaymoskingdoms.air.nothing.0: Clear the air? It's clear enough, isn't it?
history.jaymoskingdoms.air.nothing.1: I don't know what you mean. We're fine.
history.jaymoskingdoms.air.shoved_you.so: About that shove... I'm sorry. I was told to, and I didn't like doing it.
I've felt bad about shoving you ever since. No hard feelings, I hope?
history.jaymoskingdoms.air.shoved_you.pl: Nothing personal. You were too close, and that's my job.
I'd do it again if I had to. But I hold nothing against you.
history.jaymoskingdoms.air.shoved_you.ha: You were in the way. Stay out of it and it won't happen again.
You want an apology? Ha. Next time I'll shove harder.
I'm sorry about going through your things. I hate that part of the job.
That search... I knew you weren't a thief. Forgive me?
Every stranger gets searched. You were a stranger. Simple as that.
Orders. If it helps, I search everyone the same.
You don't like being searched? Then don't look like you've something to hide.
I'll search you again tomorrow if I please. Get used to it.
history.jaymoskingdoms.air.halted_you.so: I'm sorry I stopped you like that. We get so few strangers, I was nervous.
I didn't mean to make you feel unwelcome. You are welcome here.
history.jaymoskingdoms.air.halted_you.pl: I ask everyone their business. Now I know yours.
It's the job. Don't take it to heart.
history.jaymoskingdoms.air.halted_you.ha: I'll stop whoever I like, whenever I like. That's what I'm for.
Still sore about it? You'll live.
history.jaymoskingdoms.ask_after.nothing: I'm well enough, thank you for asking.
history.jaymoskingdoms.ask_after.keepsak: I never did thank you properly. Here, take this: %2$s. It's the least I can do.
I've been keeping this for you, in case you came by. %2$s. Please, take it.
history.jaymoskingdoms.ask_after.saved.0: Alive, thanks to you. I think of it every morning.
history.jaymoskingdoms.ask_after.saved.1: Better than I'd be in the ground. I owe you that, %1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.ask_after.freed.0: I still dream of those ropes. But I'm free, and that's your doing.
history.jaymoskingdoms.ask_after.freed.1: Better, now. I jump at shadows less every day.
history.jaymoskingdoms.ask_after.home.0: Home, with my own, and glad of every day of it. Thanks to you.
history.jaymoskingdoms.ask_after.home.1: My family can't stop fussing over me. I don't mind one bit.
Not a scar to show for it. Whatever you did, it worked.
Good as new. I still don't understand how you did it.
Oh... you're the one I shoved. I'm %1$s. I'm so sorry about that.
Ah. Um. %1$s. We've, er, sort of met. Sorry about the shove.
We've met, sort of. I'm the one who shoved you. %1$s.
%1$s. Last time we were this close I was pushing you away. Funny.
My name? You know my hands well enough already. %1$s.
%1$s. Remember it, and keep your distance this time.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.searched_yo: This is awkward... I'm %1$s. I went through your pack. Sorry.
I know more of your things than your name. I'm %1$s, by the way.
%1$s. I've seen inside your pack, might as well know my name.
We've met. I searched you. %1$s, since you ask.
%1$s. And I'll know if you've anything in that pack you shouldn't.
Name's %1$s. Don't think that makes us friends. I'll still search you.
I'm %1$s. Sorry for stopping you the way I did, before.
Oh, it's you! I asked your business and never gave you my name. %1$s.
I asked yours first, more or less. %1$s.
The stranger I stopped. I'm %1$s. Now we're square.
I ask the questions round here. But fine: %1$s.
%1$s. I've still got my eye on you.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.revived_you: Last time you saw me you were bleeding in the mud. I'm %1$s.
%1$s. I bandaged you, remember? Well, you probably don't.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.led_you.0: I walked you all the way to court and never said. %1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.led_you.1: %1$s. I'm the one who took you in to see the ruler.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.struck.0: You hit me, and now you want my name? ...%1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.struck.1: %1$s. Most people ask before they swing. Just so you know.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.rude.0: After how you spoke to me? ...%1$s. Try being polite.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.rude.1: %1$s. Funny, you weren't so friendly before.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.crime.0: I saw what you did, you know. ...%1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.crime.1: %1$s. And I know what you are, so don't try anything.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.robbed.0: You had your hand in my pocket before you had my name. %1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.robbed.1: %1$s. Keep your hands where I can see them.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.saved.0: You don't know my name? You saved my life! I'm %1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.saved.1: %1$s. I've wanted to tell you since the day you saved me.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.freed.0: You cut my ropes and never asked my name. %1$s. Thank you.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.freed.1: I'm %1$s. The one you freed. I'll never forget it.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.home.0: You brought me home and I never even told you. %1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.home.1: %1$s. My family would want me to say: thank you, for everything.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.mended.0: You healed me, stranger, and I never thanked you. I'm %1$s.
history.jaymoskingdoms.intro.mended.1: %1$s. Whatever magic that was, I owe you for it.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.revived_you.0: On your feet again, %1$s? You had me worried.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.revived_you.1: How's the wound, %1$s? Keep that bandage clean.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.revived_you.2: Back up and about, %1$s. Try not to need me again.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.divine.gift: Gift: a halo and gold-touched skin; you mend faster (+1 health every 4 seconds); your blows hit the wicked (the undead, illagers, barbarians, Rogues, the corrupted) 25% harder; healing magic heals 30% more and costs 25% less mana; ki sense and scouters can't find you
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.divine.flaw: Flaw: the light burns bright: hunger drains 25% faster
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.divine.desc: Born of the high places, where the light is thick and the old shrines still hum. You are warm to the touch and quick to mend, and the wicked know you for what you are.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt.gift: Gift: a made body that grows: press the heritage key on anyone downed or crippled close by (a leg broken or cut off), monster, villager or player, unless they are Dawnborn or Divine, and your tail arcs over your head, swallows them whole and draws them down into you over 5 s (press again, or be hurt, and it lets go), taking a share of their health and their worth; at 4 and at 12 worth your body remakes itself: the grotesque, tailed Imperfect form, then the towering Semi-Perfect, then the Perfect, the strongest and steadiest (more health, armour and harder blows each time; as a Z Fighter more ki, fists and ki regen, and the Perfect form heals itself with ki); your blows drain 8%, then 12%, then 18% of their harm back as life; every one absorbed stores a charge (up to 4); in the Perfect form press the heritage key (on no one) to bud up to two small copies of yourself that fight for you for 45 seconds, each spending a charge
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt.flaw: Flaw: the first form is frail (2 fewer hearts); lightning and magic hurt you 50% more
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt.desc: Made by the Mad Tinkerer from the blood of every heritage but the Dawnborn and the Divine, and never quite finished. You were made to become more, and you will, one fallen body at a time.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk.gift: Gift: pink and stretchy: +1 block of reach; lost limbs grow back (one every 20 seconds); press the heritage key on a small weak foe, or any downed one that isn't huge, to swallow it for a heal and take on what it had (half its health, blow and armour, its pace, and fireproofing, water breathing, a soft fall, night eyes or a spring if it had them; only the last thing swallowed, lost on death) (your hand goes to it and it shrinks away over 3 s; press again, or be hurt, and it stops); its body stays in you, and sneak + the heritage key pukes it back up under a mound of pink that melts away (and what you took from it goes with it); a downed player you swallow stays alive inside you, wounded, and can fight their way out by hitting your heart, lungs and stomach, or be digested if they go down in there; cookies, pie, honey, berries, melon and cake mend 2 hearts, Kitchen's tarts, pies and brownies 3
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk.flaw: Flaw: fire burns you 60% longer; arrows and spines hurt you 25% more
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk.desc: Soft, bright and bendy, born at the fairs where the strangest folk gather. You take a knock and bounce, grow back what's lost, and never turn down a cake.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.divine_base.desc: Gold filigree up the forearms and a gem on the brow.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.divine_base.trait: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.starlit.desc: Born under clear peaks: pale blue skin scattered with stars that wake at night, and eyes like cold light.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.seraphic.desc: Rows of white feathers down the arms, gold at their tips, and a cream skin that sheds soft motes.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.seraphic.trait: Trait: lands from 2 blocks higher unhurt
variant.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt_base.des: Dark seams ring the forearms; amber nodes glow in them, and the plating spreads as the form grows.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.biobuilt_base.tra: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.brassbound.desc: Copper plates riveted over a warm bronze skin, a gear's teeth at the wrist and amber nodes in the plates.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.opaline.desc: A pearly shell of mint and lilac plates over pale skin, edged in a fine light that wakes in dark places.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk_base.d: Pink all through, with a wet-looking gloss down the arms and on the knuckles.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.rubberfolk_base.t: Trait: none beyond the heritage's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.candystripe.desc: A paler pink with cream stripes slanting round the arms, like something from a sweet shop.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.berrygloss.desc: A deep berry pink dotted with glossy spots, the colour of jam on a warm day.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_divin: Divine-born, %1$s. Don't mind the glow; it's a family habit.
My people keep the old hilltop shrines. We've never needed a lantern in them.
I eat twice what I look like I should. Light is thirsty work.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_biobu: Bio-built, %1$s. Yes, the seams are real, and no, it doesn't hurt.
My makers are long gone. I like to think I turned out better than the plan.
Thunder makes my teeth ache, %1$s. Something in the metal, they say.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_rubbe: Rubber-folk, %1$s! Go on, poke me. Everyone does.
Lost a finger once. It was back by the weekend, and so was my appetite for pie.
Keep me away from the campfire and the archers, and I'll be the best company you've had.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.flaw: Flaw: no realm will have one of them
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.goblin.desc: Short, green and warty, all ears and nose, born only to their own in the goblin villages. Greedy, sly, and never far from someone else's gold.
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.orc.gift: Gift: bigger and broader than any man
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.orc.flaw: Flaw: no realm will have one of them
heritage.jaymoskingdoms.orc.desc: Grey-green, tusked and scarred, born only to their own in the orc war camps. They live for the fight, and fight harder the more they bleed.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_base.desc: Lime to bog green, warty and blotched.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_base.trait: Trait: none beyond the brood's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.boggart.desc: A sickly yellow-green from the swamps, smelling of them too.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.cavegrub.desc: Pale as a grub from living under the hills, grey-green and pasty.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.orc_base.desc: The colour of old moss on a stone, scarred all over.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.orc_base.trait: Trait: none beyond the brood's own
variant.jaymoskingdoms.ashskin.desc: Near black, as if burnt in the hot lands they come from.
variant.jaymoskingdoms.bloodtusk.desc: A red-brown green from the badlands, the colour of dried blood.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_gobli: Goblin, yes. What of it? Shiny thing on you, %1$s. Very shiny.
Big folk think we're ugly. We think big folk are slow.
King gets the gold, we get the rest. Mostly the rest is mushrooms.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_orc/1: Orc. Born in the camp, will die in a fight. Good.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_orc/2: You want to know about my tusks, %1$s? Come closer.
dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.blood_orc/3: Every scar is a story. Most of them end with the other one dead.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.shrine: A hilltop shrine above the clouds
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.shrine.tale: You were born at a shrine so high the clouds were underfoot, and the first thing you remember is the light.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.vats: A workshop's vats, and no mother to name
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.vats.tale: You were grown in a workshop's vats, stitched and tested, and let out into the world with a name someone chose for you.
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.fair: A travelling fair, among the strange folk
story.jaymoskingdoms.born.fair.tale: You were born in a wagon of a travelling fair, among the acrobats and the oddities, where bending the rules was the act.
message.jaymoskingdoms.absorb_hurt: Hurt, you lose your hold on it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.absorbed: Absorbed. %s more worth to your next form.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.absorbed_last: Absorbed. Nothing left to grow into.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.form.1: Your body splits and remakes itself: Semi-Perfect. You stand taller, heavier, the tail shorter and thicker.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.form.2: Your body remakes itself one last time: Perfect. Steady, sleek, the strongest you will be. You could bud copies of yourself now (the heritage key, on no one).
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.bud_locked: You aren't grown enough to bud.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.bud_wait: Your body is still knitting: %s seconds.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.bud_weak: Too weak or too hungry to bud.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bio.bud_empty: Nothing stored to bud with: absorb a foe first.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.adopted: You take on the %s: %s. (Your next swallow replaces it.)
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.adopted_pe: You swallow %s whole and take on their build: %s. (Your next swallow replaces it.)
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.regrown: A lost limb stretches back into place.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.brought_up: You retch, and puke your last swallow back up. What you took from it goes with it.
You puke it all back up, but there's nothing left of it to see. What you took from it goes with it.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.holding: %s is inside you, still kicking. They'll be digested if they go down in there. (Sneak + heritage key pukes them back up.)
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.swallowed: %s swallowed you whole! Hit their insides (heart, lungs, stomach) to fight your way out before you're digested.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.digested.h: %s is digested. Their body stays in you until you bring it up.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.spat: You're puked back up, dripping pink.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.let_out: You slide out of them, dripping pink.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.burst.hold: You puke %s back up. Your insides ache.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.organ.hear: %s pummels your heart. It skips and stutters!
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.organ.left: %s knocks the breath out of a lung!
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.organ.righ: %s knocks the breath out of a lung!
message.jaymoskingdoms.rubber.organ.stom: %s churns your stomach. You feel sick!
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.invite: %s invites you to their party. It lapses in %s seconds. %s %s
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.not_leader: Only the party's leader can do that.
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.full: The party is full (%s at most).
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.cannot_join: That party can't take you now.
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.kicked: You were put out of the party.
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.kick_none: No one called %s is in your party (or that is you).
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.none: You are in no party. Shake hands with someone, or /party invite <player>, to start one.
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.pvp_on: Fighting between party members is allowed.
message.jaymoskingdoms.party.pvp_off: Party members can't hurt each other.
message.jaymoskingdoms.larder: %s: %s food in store (wants %s), meals at %s%% of the usual price, %s eateries, %s cooks, %s visitors in town
meals.jaymoskingdoms.home.2: Supper's on, and none of it bought.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.home.3: My mother's recipe, more or less.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.eatery.3: Hot and filling, can't ask more.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.market.3: No cookhouse here, so the stalls it is.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.dear.0: They want how much for a bowl?
meals.jaymoskingdoms.dear.1: Prices like these, I'll be skin and bone.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.dear.2: Someone's getting rich off our bellies.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.cheap.0: Cheap and plenty, the way it should be.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.cheap.2: Hardly costs a thing these days.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.none.0: Nothing to eat, not a crumb.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.visitor.1: Worth the walk for this alone.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.visitor.2: We'll come back for the cooking.
meals.jaymoskingdoms.hired.0: Me, the cook? I'll take it!
meals.jaymoskingdoms.hired.1: Someone has to feed this town.
visitors.jaymoskingdoms.arrive.0: Fine day for it. We've come from %s.
visitors.jaymoskingdoms.arrive.1: All the way from %s, and my feet know it.
visitors.jaymoskingdoms.arrive_afar.2: What a town! We're from far off.%s
visitors.jaymoskingdoms.leave.1: Long road back, best be off.
visitors.jaymoskingdoms.leave.2: Farewell, it's been a fine day.

message.jaymoskingdoms.no_home: %s has no home yet. Set one from the command wheel.

gift.jaymoskingdoms.destrier.2: Takes a killing blow for you (every 5 min).

gift.jaymoskingdoms.draft.2: Animals within 16 blocks drift after it.

gift.jaymoskingdoms.steppe_pony.2: Snorts monsters away (4.5 blocks, every 5 s).

handbook.jaymoskingdoms.1.title: Taming and trust
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.1.body: Tame a horse by riding it until it stops bucking. After that it learns to trust you: feed it, brush it, water it and ride it well. Trust opens everything else: at 40 it takes orders, at 50 it fights for you, and a Rider's breed gift grows at 40 and again at 100. A horse you neglect grows hungry, thirsty and wary.
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.2.title: Tack
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.2.body: Open a tamed horse's screen and press Tack. Down the left: saddle (plain, war or racing), bridle, blanket and barding, and a banner. The blanket keeps it warm and dry; a carpet in its place is just for show, in the carpet's colour. A banner flies from a pole behind the saddle. Use horseshoes on it to shoe it, and a hoof pick to keep bare hooves sound.
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.3.title: Gaits and stamina
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.3.body: In the saddle the scroll wheel shifts gait: walk, trot, canter, gallop. Sprint at the gallop for a burst. Stamina drains as it runs; a blown horse drops to a trot until it gets its wind back (the mark on the bar). Double-tap forward to ride on without holding it; back stops.
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.4.title: The command wheel
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.4.body: Tap N to whistle your horses over. Hold N for the command wheel, point and let go. Orders go to the horse you're looking at, or the one you ride: let be, follow, stay, wander here, make this home, go home. Your horses opens the roster: every horse you own and where it is. Call brings one to you from anywhere; Home sends it back.
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.5.title: Riding further
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.5.body: A ridden horse steps up a block and a half (an elephant two), pushes through leaves, and swims with you instead of throwing you in deep water. A friend can climb up behind you on a saddled horse. Gallop to build a charge (the thin bar under stamina): once it glows, the horse runs down monsters in its way, harder the faster it goes and the heavier its barding.
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.6.title: Mares and stallions
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.6.body: Every horse is a mare or a stallion (the symbol by its name), and a foal is a filly or a colt. Breeding takes one of each. A foal takes after both its parents.
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.7.title: Your horse fights for you
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.7.body: When something hurts you, horses of yours close by that trust you at 50 or more turn on it: they rear, kick and trample until it's dead or gone. A timid horse shies away instead. War training makes them hit harder.
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.8.title: For Riders
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.8.body: Riders read a wild horse at a glance: hold a saddle and look at it to see its breed, sex and stats. Each breed also gives its Rider a gift, which grows at trust 40 and 100: the destrier shields you from a killing blow, the courser bursts, the palfrey keeps road pace, the desert horse starts quick, the draft horse herds, the steppe pony snorts monsters away, the nightmare sees in the dark, the bat horse lands softly, the elephant calms angry beasts, and the mammoth walks on powder snow.
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.9.title: Wagons and coaches
handbook.jaymoskingdoms.9.body: With Jaymo's Kitchen, horses pull carts. A wagon carries goods and picks up animals and villagers it passes. The six-seat coach is too heavy for anything but a draft horse. Sneak and use a cart to let its passengers out.
